files.name: Assets
files.source:
--[[
	Assets - the texture catalogue behind every preset, plus runtime
	validation for textures the developer adds themselves.

	Three engine-shipped textures are guaranteed to exist on every client and
	are used as the backbone of the preset library. The rest are sample
	textures published in Roblox's own documentation; the Asset Manager
	validates them on demand and reports anything that fails to load instead
	of silently emitting invisible particles.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local Assets = {}

Assets.groups = { "Fire", "Smoke", "Magic", "Energy", "Utility" }

-- `key` is what presets use (tex = "fire"); `id` is the canonical asset uri.
Assets.textures = {
	{
		id = "builtin_fire",
		key = "fire",
		name = "Fire Flame",
		uri = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds",
		group = "Fire",
		builtin = true,
		tags = { "flame", "heat", "ember" },
	},
	{
		id = "builtin_smoke",
		key = "smoke",
		name = "Smoke Puff",
		uri = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",
		group = "Smoke",
		builtin = true,
		tags = { "cloud", "dust", "fog" },
	},
	{
		id = "builtin_sparkle",
		key = "sparkle",
		name = "Sparkle",
		uri = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
		group = "Magic",
		builtin = true,
		tags = { "star", "glint", "shimmer" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_glow",
		key = "glow",
		name = "Soft Glow",
		uri = "rbxassetid://6823766871",
		group = "Energy",
		tags = { "circle", "soft", "light" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_square",
		key = "square",
		name = "Soft Square",
		uri = "rbxassetid://2282042320",
		group = "Utility",
		tags = { "quad", "block", "pixel" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_puff",
		key = "puff",
		name = "Cloud Puff",
		uri = "rbxassetid://1084981840",
		group = "Smoke",
		tags = { "cloud", "soft", "billow" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_star",
		key = "star",
		name = "Star Spark",
		uri = "rbxassetid://2273547790",
		group = "Magic",
		tags = { "star", "sparkle", "twinkle" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_electric",
		key = "electric",
		name = "Electric Spark",
		uri = "rbxassetid://6101261905",
		group = "Energy",
		tags = { "lightning", "zap", "arc" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_blast",
		key = "blast",
		name = "Explosion Cloud",
		uri = "rbxassetid://5860841663",
		group = "Fire",
		tags = { "explosion", "boom", "blast" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_spark",
		key = "spark",
		name = "Spark",
		uri = "rbxassetid://5833323391",
		group = "Energy",
		tags = { "spark", "hot", "trail" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_debris",
		key = "debris",
		name = "Debris Chunk",
		uri = "rbxassetid://6711256324",
		group = "Utility",
		tags = { "rock", "chunk", "impact" },
	},
	{
		id = "doc_dust",
		key = "dust",
		name = "Dust Mote",
		uri = "rbxassetid://14302399641",
		group = "Smoke",
		tags = { "mote", "ambient", "spore" },
	},
}

Assets.byKey = {}
Assets.byId = {}
Assets.byUri = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.textures) do
	Assets.byKey[entry.key] = entry
	Assets.byId[entry.id] = entry
	Assets.byUri[entry.uri] = entry
end

Assets.defaultUri = Assets.byKey.sparkle.uri

--- Resolves a preset shorthand ("fire"), a full uri, or an asset id string.
function Assets.resolve(value: any): string
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
		return Assets.defaultUri
	end
	local entry = Assets.byKey[string.lower(value)] or Assets.byId[value] or Assets.byUri[value]
	if entry then
		return entry.uri
	end
	if string.match(value, "^%d+$") then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. value
	end
	return value
end

function Assets.describe(uri: string): string
	local entry = Assets.byUri[uri]
	if entry then
		return entry.name
	end
	local id = string.match(uri or "", "rbxassetid://(%d+)")
	if id then
		return "Asset " .. id
	end
	if string.find(uri or "", "rbxasset://", 1, true) then
		return (string.match(uri, "([^/]+%.%w+)$") or uri)
	end
	return uri
end

function Assets.isBuiltin(uri: string): boolean
	local entry = Assets.byUri[uri]
	return entry ~= nil and entry.builtin == true
end

--- True when the uri points at a user-published asset that can disappear.
function Assets.isRemote(uri: string): boolean
	return type(uri) == "string" and string.find(uri, "rbxassetid://", 1, true) ~= nil
end

--- Asset ids the developer saved themselves (persisted by the store).
Assets.custom = {}
Assets.customById = {}

function Assets.setCustom(list: { any })
	Assets.custom = {}
	Assets.customById = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(list or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.uri) == "string" and entry.uri ~= "" then
			local record = {
				id = entry.id or Util.uuid("asset"),
				name = entry.name or Assets.describe(entry.uri),
				uri = entry.uri,
				group = entry.group or "Utility",
				tags = entry.tags or {},
				custom = true,
			}
			table.insert(Assets.custom, record)
			Assets.customById[record.id] = record
			Assets.byId[record.id] = record
			Assets.byUri[record.uri] = record
		end
	end
end

function Assets.all(): { any }
	local list = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.textures) do
		table.insert(list, entry)
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.custom) do
		table.insert(list, entry)
	end
	return list
end

--- Search across name, group and tags.
function Assets.search(query: string): { any }
	local trimmed = Util.trim(query or "")
	if trimmed == "" then
		return Assets.all()
	end
	local results = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.all()) do
		local haystack = table.concat({ entry.name, entry.group, table.concat(entry.tags or {}, " ") }, " ")
		if Util.contains(haystack, trimmed) or Util.contains(entry.uri, trimmed) then
			table.insert(results, entry)
		end
	end
	return results
end

local statusCache: { [string]: string } = {}

--- Validates a texture against the content provider. Yields.
--- Returns "ok", "missing" or "unknown". `host` is any GUI parent.
function Assets.validate(uri: string, host: Instance?): string
	if type(uri) ~= "string" or uri == "" then
		return "missing"
	end
	if statusCache[uri] then
		return statusCache[uri]
	end
	if not host or uri:sub(1, 10) == "rbxasset:/" then
		-- rbxasset:// ships with the client; nothing to fetch.
		statusCache[uri] = if uri:sub(1, 10) == "rbxasset:/" then "ok" else "unknown"
		return statusCache[uri]
	end

	local probe = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	probe.Image = uri
	probe.Visible = false
	probe.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
	probe.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	probe.Parent = host

	local status = "unknown"
	local ok = pcall(function()
		Util.ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ probe }, function(_, fetchStatus)
			if fetchStatus == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
				status = "ok"
			elseif fetchStatus == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.TimedOut then
				status = "unknown"
			else
				status = "missing"
			end
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		status = "unknown"
	end
	probe:Destroy()

	-- Only cache definitive answers so a "TimedOut" can be retried.
	if status ~= "unknown" then
		statusCache[uri] = status
	end
	return status
end

function Assets.forget(uri: string)
	statusCache[uri] = nil
end

return Assets

files.name: Compiler
files.source:
--[[
	Compiler - turns a VFX spec into real Roblox instances, and keeps those
	instances in sync while the developer edits.

	Effect hierarchy (what gets exported):

		Model "Inferno Core"          attributes: VFXSpec, VFXStudio, ...
			Part "Rig"                invisible anchored host
				Attachment "Core"
					ParticleEmitter "Core"
				Attachment "Arc_A"
				Attachment "Arc_B"
					Beam "Arc"
				Part "Shockwave"       mesh/visual parts
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Format = require(script.Parent.Format)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Assets)

local Compiler = {}

Compiler.SCHEMA_VERSION = 2
Compiler.RIG_NAME = "Rig"

local function clamp01(value: any): number
	local parsed = tonumber(value) or 0
	return math.clamp(parsed, 0, 1)
end

local function positive(value: any, fallback: number): number
	local parsed = tonumber(value)
	if parsed == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	return math.max(0, parsed)
end

local function safeName(name: any): string
	local text = tostring(name or "Effect")
	text = text:gsub("[%c]", "")
	if #text > 80 then
		text = text:sub(1, 80)
	end
	if text == "" then
		text = "Effect"
	end
	return text
end

local function uniqueName(model: Instance, base: string): string
	if not model:FindFirstChild(base, true) then
		return base
	end
	local index = 2
	while model:FindFirstChild(base .. " " .. index, true) do
		index += 1
	end
	return base .. " " .. index
end

function Compiler.rigOf(model: Instance): Part?
	local rig = model:FindFirstChild(Compiler.RIG_NAME)
	if rig and rig:IsA("BasePart") then
		return rig
	end
	return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- property application
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyParticle(emitter: ParticleEmitter, comp: any)
	Util.apply(emitter, {
		Texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture),
		Color = Format.colorSequence(comp.color),
		Transparency = Format.transparency(comp.transparency),
		Size = Format.numberSequence(comp.size),
		Lifetime = Format.numberRange(comp.lifetime, 1),
		Speed = Format.numberRange(comp.speed, 0),
		SpreadAngle = Format.vector2(comp.spread, 0),
		Rotation = Format.numberRange(comp.rotation, 0),
		RotSpeed = Format.numberRange(comp.rotSpeed, 0),
		Drag = positive(comp.drag, 0),
		Acceleration = Format.vector3(comp.acceleration),
		Rate = positive(comp.rate, 0),
		LightEmission = clamp01(comp.lightEmission),
		LightInfluence = clamp01(comp.lightInfluence),
		Shape = Format.enum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, comp.shape, "Sphere"),
		ShapeStyle = Format.enum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle, comp.shapeStyle, "Volume"),
		ShapeInOut = Format.enum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, comp.shapeInOut, "Outward"),
		ShapePartial = clamp01(comp.shapePartial),
		EmissionDirection = Format.enum(Enum.NormalId, comp.emissionDirection, "Top"),
		ZOffset = tonumber(comp.zOffset) or 0,
		Squash = NumberSequence.new(clamp01(comp.squash)),
		WindAffectsDrag = comp.windAffectsDrag == true,
		Orientation = Format.enum(Enum.ParticleOrientation, comp.orientation, "FacingCamera"),
		FlipbookLayout = Format.enum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout, comp.flipbookLayout, "None"),
		FlipbookFramerate = Format.numberRange(comp.flipbookFramerate, 30),
		FlipbookStartRandom = comp.flipbookRandom ~= false,
		LockedToPart = comp.lockedToPart == true,
		VelocityInheritance = clamp01(comp.velocityInheritance),
		TimeScale = math.max(0.05, tonumber(comp.timeScale) or 1),
	})
	emitter.Enabled = positive(comp.rate, 0) > 0
end

local function applyBeam(beam: Beam, comp: any)
	Util.apply(beam, {
		Texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture),
		Color = Format.colorSequence(comp.color),
		Transparency = Format.transparency(comp.transparency),
		Width0 = positive(comp.width0, 0.2),
		Width1 = positive(comp.width1, 0.2),
		CurveSize0 = math.clamp(tonumber(comp.curveSize0) or 0, -5, 5),
		CurveSize1 = math.clamp(tonumber(comp.curveSize1) or 0, -5, 5),
		Segments = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(comp.segments) or 10), 1, 100),
		Brightness = positive(comp.brightness, 1),
		LightEmission = clamp01(comp.lightEmission),
		LightInfluence = clamp01(comp.lightInfluence),
		TextureLength = math.max(0.01, tonumber(comp.textureLength) or 1),
		TextureSpeed = tonumber(comp.textureSpeed) or 0,
		TextureMode = Format.enum(Enum.TextureMode, comp.textureMode, "Stretch"),
		FaceCamera = comp.faceCamera ~= false,
		ZOffset = tonumber(comp.zOffset) or 0,
	})
end

local function applyTrail(trail: Trail, comp: any)
	Util.apply(trail, {
		Texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture),
		Color = Format.colorSequence(comp.color),
		Transparency = Format.transparency(comp.transparency),
		Lifetime = math.clamp(tonumber(comp.lifetime) or 0.5, 0, 20),
		MinLength = positive(comp.minLength, 0),
		WidthScale = positive(comp.widthScale, 1),
		LightEmission = clamp01(comp.lightEmission),
		FaceCamera = comp.faceCamera ~= false,
	})
end

local function applyLight(light: PointLight, comp: any)
	Util.apply(light, {
		Color = Util.hex(comp.color),
		Brightness = positive(comp.brightness, 1),
		Range = math.max(0, tonumber(comp.range) or 16),
		Shadows = comp.shadows == true,
	})
end

local function applyPart(part: BasePart, comp: any)
	local size = Format.vector3(comp.size)
	Util.apply(part, {
		Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.05, size.X), math.max(0.05, size.Y), math.max(0.05, size.Z)),
		Color = Util.hex(comp.color),
		Transparency = math.clamp(tonumber(comp.transparency) or 0, 0, 1),
		Material = Format.enum(Enum.Material, comp.material, "Neon"),
		Shape = Format.enum(Enum.PartType, comp.shape, "Ball"),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(Format.vector3(comp.offset))
			* CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad(tonumber((comp.rotation :: any)[1]) or 0),
				math.rad(tonumber((comp.rotation :: any)[2]) or 0),
				math.rad(tonumber((comp.rotation :: any)[3]) or 0)
			),
	})
	if comp.shape == "Cylinder" then
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	elseif comp.shape == "Wedge" then
		-- Wedge is a different class; keep Ball/Block/Cylinder safe.
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	end
end

--- Applies the visual properties of a component to its created instances.
function Compiler.apply(entry: any, comp: any)
	if comp.kind == "particle" then
		if entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			applyParticle(entry.primary, comp)
		end
		if entry.attachment then
			entry.attachment.Position = Format.vector3(comp.offset)
		end
	elseif comp.kind == "beam" then
		if entry.primary:IsA("Beam") then
			applyBeam(entry.primary, comp)
		end
		if entry.attachmentA and entry.attachmentB then
			entry.attachmentA.Position = Format.vector3(comp.offset0)
			entry.attachmentB.Position = Format.vector3(comp.offset1)
			entry.primary.Attachment0 = entry.attachmentA
			entry.primary.Attachment1 = entry.attachmentB
		end
	elseif comp.kind == "trail" then
		if entry.primary:IsA("Trail") then
			applyTrail(entry.primary, comp)
		end
		if entry.attachmentA and entry.attachmentB then
			entry.attachmentA.Position = Format.vector3(comp.offset0)
			entry.attachmentB.Position = Format.vector3(comp.offset1)
			entry.primary.Attachment0 = entry.attachmentA
			entry.primary.Attachment1 = entry.attachmentB
		end
	elseif comp.kind == "light" then
		if entry.primary:IsA("PointLight") then
			applyLight(entry.primary, comp)
		end
		if entry.attachment then
			entry.attachment.Position = Format.vector3(comp.offset)
		end
	elseif comp.kind == "part" then
		if entry.primary:IsA("BasePart") then
			applyPart(entry.primary, comp)
		end
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- instance creation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function markInstances(entry: any, comp: any)
	local name = safeName(comp.name)
	for _, inst in ipairs(entry.all or {}) do
		inst:SetAttribute("VFXComponent", name)
		inst:SetAttribute("VFXKind", comp.kind)
	end
end

local function newAttachment(rig: BasePart, name: string, position: Vector3): Attachment
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = name
	attachment.Position = position
	attachment.Visible = false
	attachment.Parent = rig
	return attachment
end

local function createComponent(model: Instance, rig: BasePart, comp: any): any
	local name = safeName(comp.name)
	if comp.kind == "particle" then
		local attachment = newAttachment(rig, name, Format.vector3(comp.offset))
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Name = name
		emitter.Parent = attachment
		local entry = { primary = emitter, attachment = attachment, all = { attachment, emitter }, kind = comp.kind, name = name }
		markInstances(entry, comp)
		return entry
	elseif comp.kind == "beam" or comp.kind == "trail" then
		local a = newAttachment(rig, name .. "_A", Format.vector3(comp.offset0))
		local b = newAttachment(rig, name .. "_B", Format.vector3(comp.offset1))
		local fx
		if comp.kind == "beam" then
			fx = Instance.new("Beam")
		else
			fx = Instance.new("Trail")
		end
		fx.Name = name
		fx.Parent = rig
		local entry = { primary = fx, attachmentA = a, attachmentB = b, all = { a, b, fx }, kind = comp.kind, name = name }
		markInstances(entry, comp)
		if fx:IsA("Beam") then
			fx.Attachment0 = a
			fx.Attachment1 = b
		elseif fx:IsA("Trail") then
			fx.Attachment0 = a
			fx.Attachment1 = b
		end
		return entry
	elseif comp.kind == "light" then
		local attachment = newAttachment(rig, name, Format.vector3(comp.offset))
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Name = name
		light.Parent = attachment
		local entry = { primary = light, attachment = attachment, all = { attachment, light }, kind = comp.kind, name = name }
		markInstances(entry, comp)
		return entry
	elseif comp.kind == "part" then
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = name
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.Parent = model
		local entry = { primary = part, all = { part }, kind = comp.kind, name = name }
		markInstances(entry, comp)
		return entry
	elseif comp.kind == "tween" then
		-- Timeline tracks are data only; the player interprets them.
		local entry = { primary = rig, kind = comp.kind, name = name, all = {}, virtual = true }
		return entry
	end
	return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- public API
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Builds a fresh effect model. Does not parent to the DataModel unless asked.
function Compiler.build(spec: any, parent: Instance?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = safeName(spec.name)

	local rig = Instance.new("Part")
	rig.Name = Compiler.RIG_NAME
	rig.Anchored = true
	rig.CanCollide = false
	rig.CanQuery = false
	rig.CanTouch = false
	rig.CastShadow = false
	rig.Massless = true
	rig.Locked = true
	rig.Transparency = 1
	rig.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	rig.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	rig.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	rig.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	rig.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	rig.Parent = model

	local bindings = {}
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		local entry = createComponent(model, rig, comp)
		if entry then
			Compiler.apply(entry, comp)
			bindings[entry.name] = entry
		end
	end

	model:SetAttribute("VFXStudio", true)
	model:SetAttribute("VFXSchema", Compiler.SCHEMA_VERSION)
	Compiler.writeSpecAttribute(model, spec)

	if parent then
		model.Parent = parent
	end
	return model
end

function Compiler.writeSpecAttribute(model: Instance, spec: any)
	local json = Format.jsonEncode({
		name = spec.name,
		category = spec.category,
		tags = spec.tags,
		description = spec.description,
		duration = spec.duration,
		loop = spec.loop,
		components = spec.components,
	})
	if json then
		model:SetAttribute("VFXSpec", json)
	end
	model:SetAttribute("VFXCategory", tostring(spec.category or ""))
	model:SetAttribute("VFXTags", table.concat(spec.tags or {}, ", "))
	model:SetAttribute("VFXDuration", tonumber(spec.duration) or 1)
	model:SetAttribute("VFXPresetId", tostring(spec.id or ""))
	model:SetAttribute("VFXComponentCount", #(spec.components or {}))
end

--- Collects the existing component instances of a compiled model.
function Compiler.resolve(model: Instance): { [string]: any }
	local bindings = {}
	local rig = Compiler.rigOf(model)
	local attachments: { [string]: Attachment } = {}
	if rig then
		for _, descendant in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Attachment") then
				attachments[descendant.Name] = descendant
			end
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		local name = descendant:GetAttribute("VFXComponent")
		local kind = descendant:GetAttribute("VFXKind")
		if name and kind then
			local entry = bindings[name]
			if not entry then
				entry = { name = name, kind = kind, all = {} }
				bindings[name] = entry
			end
			table.insert(entry.all, descendant)
			if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or descendant:IsA("Beam") or descendant:IsA("Trail") or descendant:IsA("PointLight") then
				entry.primary = descendant
				entry.attachment = descendant.Parent
			elseif descendant:IsA("Attachment") then
				if string.sub(descendant.Name, -2) == "_A" then
					entry.attachmentA = descendant
				elseif string.sub(descendant.Name, -2) == "_B" then
					entry.attachmentB = descendant
				else
					entry.attachment = descendant
				end
			elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant ~= rig then
				entry.primary = descendant
			end
		end
	end

	-- Beam/trail attachments were created with a "_A"/"_B" suffix so a
	-- component owns exactly one pair; reconstruct them by name if needed.
	for name, entry in pairs(bindings) do
		if entry.kind == "beam" or entry.kind == "trail" then
			entry.attachmentA = entry.attachmentA or attachments[name .. "_A"]
			entry.attachmentB = entry.attachmentB or attachments[name .. "_B"]
		end
		if entry.kind == "tween" then
			entry.primary = rig
			entry.virtual = true
		end
	end
	return bindings
end

--- Brings an existing model up to date with `spec`, recreating only the
--- components whose structure changed (keeps particle continuity while
--- tweaking properties, which matters for live preview).
function Compiler.reconcile(model: Model, spec: any): { [string]: any }
	local rig = Compiler.rigOf(model)
	if not rig then
		error("VFX Studio: model has no Rig part")
	end

	local existing = Compiler.resolve(model)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local bindings: { [string]: any } = {}

	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		local name = safeName(comp.name)
		wanted[name] = true
		local entry = existing[name]
		if entry and entry.kind == comp.kind and comp.kind ~= "tween" then
			Compiler.apply(entry, comp)
			entry.name = name
			markInstances(entry, comp)
			-- Keep the display name in sync when the component was renamed in
			-- place (same entry) - skip, rename creates a new entry.
			bindings[name] = entry
		elseif comp.kind == "tween" then
			local tweenEntry = entry or { name = name, kind = "tween", all = {}, virtual = true }
			tweenEntry.primary = rig
			bindings[name] = tweenEntry
		else
			if entry then
				for _, inst in ipairs(entry.all) do
					inst:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local created = createComponent(model, rig, comp)
			if created then
				Compiler.apply(created, comp)
				bindings[name] = created
			end
		end
	end

	-- Remove components that no longer exist in the spec.
	for name, entry in pairs(existing) do
		if not wanted[name] then
			for _, inst in ipairs(entry.all) do
				if inst and inst.Parent then
					inst:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	model.Name = safeName(spec.name)
	Compiler.writeSpecAttribute(model, spec)
	return bindings
end

--- Returns the spec stored on a compiled/exported model, if any.
function Compiler.readSpec(model: Instance): any?
	local json = model:GetAttribute("VFXSpec")
	local decoded = Format.jsonDecode(if type(json) == "string" then json else nil)
	if type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.components) == "table" then
		return decoded
	end
	return nil
end

--- Positions an effect model at a CFrame (used by preview and insertion).
function Compiler.place(model: Model, cframe: CFrame)
	local rig = Compiler.rigOf(model)
	if rig then
		rig.CFrame = cframe
	end
end

return Compiler

files.name: Decompiler
files.source:
--[[
	Decompiler - turns existing instances in the place back into an editable VFX
	spec. Used by "Import from selection", so any ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail
	behaviour a developer already built can be opened in the studio, retuned,
	saved as a preset and exported again.

	Effects exported by VFX Studio carry their spec in the VFXSpec attribute,
	so those round-trip losslessly. Third-party effects are reconstructed from
	real Roblox properties.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Format = require(script.Parent.Format)
local Compiler = require(script.Parent.Compiler)

local Decompiler = {}

local function colorKeypoints(sequence: ColorSequence): { any }
	local points = {}
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		table.insert(points, { Util.round(keypoint.Time, 3), Util.toHex(keypoint.Value) })
	end
	if #points == 0 then
		return { { 0, "#ffffff" }, { 1, "#ffffff" } }
	end
	return points
end

local function numberKeypoints(sequence: NumberSequence): { any }
	local points = {}
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		table.insert(points, { Util.round(keypoint.Time, 3), Util.round(keypoint.Value, 4) })
	end
	if #points == 0 then
		return { { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }
	end
	return points
end

local function rangeOf(numberRange: NumberRange): { number }
	return { Util.round(numberRange.Min, 3), Util.round(numberRange.Max, 3) }
end

local function vectorToTable(vector: Vector3): { number }
	return { Util.round(vector.X, 3), Util.round(vector.Y, 3), Util.round(vector.Z, 3) }
end

local function relativePosition(a: Vector3?): { number }
	local offset = a or Vector3.new()
	return { Util.round(offset.X, 3), Util.round(offset.Y, 3), Util.round(offset.Z, 3) }
end

local function uniqueName(used: { [string]: boolean }, base: string): string
	local name = base
	if name == "" then
		name = "Component"
	end
	local suffix = 2
	while used[name] do
		name = base .. " " .. suffix
		suffix += 1
	end
	used[name] = true
	return name
end

local function squashOf(emitter: ParticleEmitter): number
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return emitter.Squash.Keypoints[1].Value
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "number" then
		return Util.round(value, 3)
	end
	return 0
end

local function decompileParticle(emitter: ParticleEmitter, used: { [string]: boolean }): any
	return {
		kind = "particle",
		name = uniqueName(used, emitter.Name),
		offset = relativePosition(emitter.Parent and emitter.Parent:IsA("Attachment") and emitter.Parent.Position or nil),
		startTime = 0,
		duration = math.max(0.2, (emitter.Lifetime.Min + emitter.Lifetime.Max) * 0.5 * 2.4),
		texture = emitter.Texture,
		color = colorKeypoints(emitter.Color),
		transparency = numberKeypoints(emitter.Transparency),
		size = numberKeypoints(emitter.Size),
		lifetime = rangeOf(emitter.Lifetime),
		speed = rangeOf(emitter.Speed),
		spread = { Util.round(emitter.SpreadAngle.X, 1), Util.round(emitter.SpreadAngle.Y, 1) },
		rotation = rangeOf(emitter.Rotation),
		rotSpeed = rangeOf(emitter.RotSpeed),
		drag = Util.round(emitter.Drag, 3),
		acceleration = vectorToTable(emitter.Acceleration),
		rate = Util.round(emitter.Rate, 2),
		burst = 0,
		repeats = 1,
		lightEmission = Util.round(emitter.LightEmission, 3),
		lightInfluence = Util.round(emitter.LightInfluence, 3),
		shape = emitter.Shape.Name,
		shapeStyle = emitter.ShapeStyle.Name,
		shapeInOut = emitter.ShapeInOut.Name,
		shapePartial = Util.round(emitter.ShapePartial, 3),
		emissionDirection = emitter.EmissionDirection.Name,
		zOffset = Util.round(emitter.ZOffset, 3),
		squash = squashOf(emitter),
		windAffectsDrag = emitter.WindAffectsDrag,
		orientation = emitter.Orientation.Name,
		flipbookLayout = emitter.FlipbookLayout.Name,
		flipbookFramerate = rangeOf(emitter.FlipbookFramerate),
		flipbookRandom = emitter.FlipbookStartRandom,
		lockedToPart = emitter.LockedToPart,
		velocityInheritance = Util.round(emitter.VelocityInheritance, 3),
		timeScale = 1,
	}
end

local function decompileBeam(beam: Beam, used: { [string]: boolean }): any
	local a = beam.Attachment0
	local b = beam.Attachment1
	return {
		kind = "beam",
		name = uniqueName(used, beam.Name),
		offset0 = relativePosition(a and a.Position),
		offset1 = relativePosition(b and b.Position),
		startTime = 0,
		duration = 1,
		texture = beam.Texture,
		color = colorKeypoints(beam.Color),
		transparency = numberKeypoints(beam.Transparency),
		width0 = Util.round(beam.Width0, 3),
		width1 = Util.round(beam.Width1, 3),
		curveSize0 = Util.round(beam.CurveSize0, 3),
		curveSize1 = Util.round(beam.CurveSize1, 3),
		segments = beam.Segments,
		brightness = Util.round(beam.Brightness, 2),
		lightEmission = Util.round(beam.LightEmission, 3),
		lightInfluence = Util.round(beam.LightInfluence, 3),
		textureLength = Util.round(beam.TextureLength, 3),
		textureSpeed = Util.round(beam.TextureSpeed, 3),
		textureMode = beam.TextureMode.Name,
		faceCamera = beam.FaceCamera,
		zOffset = Util.round(beam.ZOffset, 3),
	}
end

local function decompileTrail(trail: Trail, used: { [string]: boolean }): any
	local a = trail.Attachment0
	local b = trail.Attachment1
	return {
		kind = "trail",
		name = uniqueName(used, trail.Name),
		offset0 = relativePosition(a and a.Position),
		offset1 = relativePosition(b and b.Position),
		startTime = 0,
		duration = 1,
		texture = trail.Texture,
		color = colorKeypoints(trail.Color),
		transparency = numberKeypoints(trail.Transparency),
		lifetime = Util.round(trail.Lifetime, 3),
		minLength = Util.round(trail.MinLength, 3),
		widthScale = Util.round(trail.WidthScale, 3),
		faceCamera = trail.FaceCamera,
		lightEmission = Util.round(trail.LightEmission, 3),
	}
end

local function decompileLight(light: PointLight, used: { [string]: boolean }): any
	return {
		kind = "light",
		name = uniqueName(used, light.Name),
		offset = relativePosition(light.Parent and light.Parent:IsA("Attachment") and light.Parent.Position or nil),
		startTime = 0,
		duration = 1,
		color = Util.toHex(light.Color),
		brightness = Util.round(light.Brightness, 2),
		range = Util.round(light.Range, 1),
		shadows = light.Shadows,
	}
end

local function decompilePart(part: BasePart, origin: CFrame, used: { [string]: boolean }): any
	local offset = origin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame).Position
	return {
		kind = "part",
		name = uniqueName(used, part.Name),
		offset = { Util.round(offset.X, 3), Util.round(offset.Y, 3), Util.round(offset.Z, 3) },
		startTime = 0,
		duration = 1,
		size = { Util.round(part.Size.X, 3), Util.round(part.Size.Y, 3), Util.round(part.Size.Z, 3) },
		color = Util.toHex(part.Color),
		transparency = Util.round(part.Transparency, 3),
		material = part.Material.Name,
		shape = if part:IsA("Part") and part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then "Ball" elseif part:IsA("Part") and part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then "Cylinder" else "Block",
		rotation = { 0, 0, 0 },
		spin = { 0, 0, 0 },
		float = 0,
	}
end

--- Returns true when the instance tree contains anything VFX Studio can read.
function Decompiler.canImport(root: Instance): boolean
	if Compiler.readSpec(root) then
		return true
	end
	if root:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or root:IsA("Beam") or root:IsA("Trail") or root:IsA("PointLight") then
		return true
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or descendant:IsA("Beam") or descendant:IsA("Trail") or descendant:IsA("PointLight") then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--- Converts a selected instance (or model) into a spec.
function Decompiler.fromInstance(root: Instance): any?
	if not root then
		return nil
	end

	-- Fast path: effects exported by VFX Studio keep their spec.
	local stored = Compiler.readSpec(root)
	if stored then
		return {
			id = "imported_" .. Util.slug(root.Name),
			name = tostring(stored.name or root.Name),
			category = "Custom",
			tags = { "imported" },
			description = "Imported from " .. root:GetFullName() .. ".",
			duration = tonumber(stored.duration) or 1.5,
			loop = stored.loop == true,
			components = stored.components,
		}
	end

	local origin: CFrame
	if root:IsA("BasePart") then
		origin = root.CFrame
	else
		local rig = Compiler.rigOf(root)
		origin = rig and rig.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	end

	local used: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local components = {}
	local maxLifetime = 0.6

	local function consider(instance: Instance)
		local ok, comp = pcall(function()
			if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				return decompileParticle(instance, used)
			elseif instance:IsA("Beam") then
				return decompileBeam(instance, used)
			elseif instance:IsA("Trail") then
				return decompileTrail(instance, used)
			elseif instance:IsA("PointLight") then
				return decompileLight(instance, used)
			end
			return nil
		end)
		if ok and comp then
			if comp.kind == "particle" then
				maxLifetime = math.max(maxLifetime, tonumber(comp.lifetime[2]) or 0.6)
			end
			table.insert(components, comp)
		elseif not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] could not import " .. instance:GetFullName() .. ": " .. tostring(comp))
		end
	end

	consider(root)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		consider(descendant)
	end

	-- Include decorative mesh parts (non-Rig, visible geometry) as components.
	local rootPart = if root:IsA("BasePart") then root else Compiler.rigOf(root)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant ~= rootPart and descendant.Transparency < 1 then
			local ok, comp = pcall(decompilePart, descendant, origin, used)
			if ok and comp then
				table.insert(components, comp)
			end
		end
	end

	if #components == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return {
		id = "imported_" .. Util.slug(root.Name),
		name = tostring(root.Name ~= "" and root.Name or "Imported Effect"),
		category = "Custom",
		tags = { "imported" },
		description = "Imported from " .. root:GetFullName() .. " with " .. #components .. " component(s).",
		duration = math.clamp(maxLifetime * 2.2, 0.8, 8),
		loop = false,
		components = components,
	}
end

--- Imports every effect found inside a selection, merging them into one spec.
function Decompiler.fromSelection(): { any }
	local imported = {}
	for _, instance in ipairs(Util.Selection:Get()) do
		local ok, spec = pcall(Decompiler.fromInstance, instance)
		if ok and spec then
			table.insert(imported, spec)
		end
	end
	return imported
end

return Decompiler

files.name: Exporter
files.source:
--[[
	Exporter - writes real effects into the place and keeps Studio's undo
	history intact.

	An export is a Model containing:
	  * the compiled rig (parts, attachments, emitters, beams, trails, lights)
	  * a "VFXController" ModuleScript that plays it at runtime
	  * the full spec as a VFXSpec attribute (re-importable and editable)
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Compiler = require(script.Parent.Compiler)
local ScriptGenerator = require(script.Parent.ScriptGenerator)
local Performance = require(script.Parent.Performance)
local History = require(script.Parent.History)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Assets)

local Exporter = {}

Exporter.DESTINATIONS = {
	{ name = "ReplicatedStorage", label = "ReplicatedStorage", service = "ReplicatedStorage" },
	{ name = "ServerStorage", label = "ServerStorage", service = "ServerStorage" },
	{ name = "Workspace", label = "Workspace", service = "Workspace" },
}

function Exporter.destination(name: string): Instance
	for _, entry in ipairs(Exporter.DESTINATIONS) do
		if entry.name == name then
			return game:GetService(entry.service)
		end
	end
	return game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
end

--- Pre-flight checks. Returns a list of { severity, message }.
function Exporter.validate(spec: any): { any }
	local issues = {}
	if type(spec) ~= "table" or type(spec.components) ~= "table" or #spec.components == 0 then
		table.insert(issues, { severity = "high", message = "The effect has no components." })
		return issues
	end

	local report = Performance.analyze(spec)
	if report.alive > 2000 then
		table.insert(issues, {
			severity = "high",
			message = string.format("About %d concurrent particles - well above the 2000 budget.", math.floor(report.alive)),
		})
	elseif report.alive > 900 then
		table.insert(issues, {
			severity = "medium",
			message = string.format("About %d concurrent particles - consider optimising.", math.floor(report.alive)),
		})
	end

	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components) do
		if comp.kind == "particle" and type(comp.texture) ~= "string" then
			table.insert(issues, { severity = "high", message = tostring(comp.name) .. " has no texture." })
		elseif comp.kind == "particle" and Assets.isRemote(tostring(comp.texture)) then
			table.insert(issues, {
				severity = "low",
				message = tostring(comp.name) .. " uses a marketplace texture; verify it is still owned by the experience.",
			})
		end
	end

	if #issues == 0 then
		table.insert(issues, { severity = "ok", message = "All checks passed." })
	end
	return issues
end

local function uniqueModelName(parent: Instance, base: string): string
	local name = base
	local index = 2
	while parent:FindFirstChild(name) do
		name = base .. " (" .. index .. ")"
		index += 1
	end
	return name
end

--- Compiles and parents an effect model, wrapping the change in undo history.
--- `options`: { destination = "ReplicatedStorage"|"ServerStorage"|"Workspace",
---              name = string, withController = boolean, parent = Instance }
function Exporter.export(spec: any, options: any?): (Model?, string?)
	local opts = options or {}
	local destination = opts.parent or Exporter.destination(opts.destination or "ReplicatedStorage")
	if not destination then
		return nil, "No destination selected."
	end

	local requestedName = Util.trim(tostring(opts.name or spec.name or "VFX Effect"))
	if requestedName == "" then
		requestedName = "VFX Effect"
	end

	local recording = History.beginRecording("VFX Studio Export")
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local model = Compiler.build(spec, nil)
		model.Name = uniqueModelName(destination, requestedName)
		model.Parent = destination

		if opts.withController ~= false then
			local controller = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
			controller.Name = "VFXController"
			controller.Source = ScriptGenerator.generate(spec)
			controller.Parent = model
		end

		-- A short README so the exported folder is self-explanatory.
		local readme = Instance.new("StringValue")
		readme.Name = "README"
		readme.Value = table.concat({
			"VFX Studio export: " .. tostring(spec.name),
			"Controller: VFXController (ModuleScript)",
			"  local VFX = require(script.Parent.VFXController)",
			"  local handle = VFX.play(CFrame.new(0, 5, 0))",
			"  handle:Play() / handle:Pause() / handle:Destroy()",
			"Re-import this model with VFX Studio to keep editing it.",
		}, "\n")
		readme.Parent = model

		return model
	end)

	if not ok then
		History.endRecording(recording, false)
		return nil, "Export failed: " .. tostring(result)
	end

	History.endRecording(recording, true)
	return result, nil
end

--- Saves the effect as a .rbxm model file on disk via Studio's save dialog.
function Exporter.saveToFile(spec: any, pluginInstance: Plugin?): (boolean, string?)
	local model = Compiler.build(spec, nil)
	local controller = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
	controller.Name = "VFXController"
	controller.Source = ScriptGenerator.generate(spec)
	controller.Parent = model
	model.Parent = nil

	local previous = Util.Selection:Get()
	Util.Selection:Set({ model })
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if pluginInstance and pluginInstance.PromptSaveSelection then
			pluginInstance:PromptSaveSelection((spec.name or "VFX Effect") .. ".rbxm")
		elseif pluginInstance and pluginInstance.SaveSelectedToFile then
			pluginInstance:SaveSelectedToFile((spec.name or "VFX Effect") .. ".rbxm")
		else
			error("this Studio build does not expose PromptSaveSelection")
		end
	end)
	Util.Selection:Set(previous)
	model:Destroy()

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end
	return true, nil
end

--- Places the effect at the camera/selection for an immediate look.
function Exporter.insertIntoWorkspace(spec: any): (Model?, string?)
	return Exporter.export(spec, { destination = "Workspace", withController = false })
end

--- Re-inserts an imported spec so the user can compare before/after.
function Exporter.replaceModel(spec: any, existing: Instance?): (Model?, string?)
	if not existing or not existing.Parent then
		return Exporter.insertIntoWorkspace(spec)
	end
	local parent = existing.Parent
	local name = existing.Name
	local recording = History.beginRecording("VFX Studio Replace")
	existing:Destroy()
	local model, err = Exporter.export(spec, { parent = parent, name = name })
	History.endRecording(recording, true)
	return model, err
end

return Exporter

files.name: Format
files.source:
--[[
	Format - converts between the plain, JSON-safe VFX spec format and real
	Roblox datatypes. Every value a preset stores is a number, string, boolean
	or array, which keeps presets serialisable, copy/paste-able and diffable.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Format = {}

local MAX_KEYPOINTS = 20

local function clamp01(value: number): number
	if value ~= value then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
end

--- Colour keypoints are stored as { {time, "#rrggbb"}, ... }.
--- Returns a valid ColorSequence (0 and 1 endpoints guaranteed).
function Format.colorSequence(keypoints: any): ColorSequence
	local fallback = ColorSequence.new(Util.hex("#ffffff"))
	if type(keypoints) ~= "table" or #keypoints == 0 then
		return fallback
	end

	local points = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(keypoints) do
		local time, hex
		if type(kp) == "table" then
			time = tonumber(kp[1]) or 0
			hex = kp[2] or kp.color or kp.value
		elseif type(kp) == "string" then
			time = (#points) / math.max(1, #keypoints - 1)
			hex = kp
		end
		if type(hex) == "string" then
			table.insert(points, { clamp01(time), Util.hex(hex) })
		end
	end

	if #points == 0 then
		return fallback
	end
	if #points == 1 then
		return ColorSequence.new(points[1][2])
	end

	table.sort(points, function(a, b)
		return a[1] < b[1]
	end)

	if points[1][1] > 0 then
		table.insert(points, 1, { 0, points[1][2] })
	end
	if points[#points][1] < 1 then
		table.insert(points, { 1, points[#points][2] })
	end

	-- Roblox requires strictly increasing keypoint times.
	local cleaned = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do
		if #cleaned > 0 and point[1] <= cleaned[#cleaned][1] then
			cleaned[#cleaned] = point
		else
			table.insert(cleaned, point)
		end
	end
	if cleaned[1][1] > 0 then
		cleaned[1] = { 0, cleaned[1][2] }
	end
	if cleaned[#cleaned][1] < 1 then
		cleaned[#cleaned] = { 1, cleaned[#cleaned][2] }
	end
	while #cleaned > MAX_KEYPOINTS do
		table.remove(cleaned, math.floor(#cleaned / 2))
	end

	local keypointsOut = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(cleaned) do
		table.insert(keypointsOut, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(keypointsOut)
end

--- Number keypoints are stored as { {time, value}, ... }.
function Format.numberSequence(keypoints: any): NumberSequence
	if type(keypoints) == "number" then
		return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
	end
	if type(keypoints) ~= "table" or #keypoints == 0 then
		return NumberSequence.new(1)
	end

	local points = {}
	for index, kp in ipairs(keypoints) do
		local time, value
		if type(kp) == "table" then
			time = tonumber(kp[1]) or 0
			value = tonumber(kp[2]) or 0
		elseif type(kp) == "number" then
			time = (index - 1) / math.max(1, #keypoints - 1)
			value = kp
		end
		if value then
			table.insert(points, { clamp01(time), math.max(0, value) })
		end
	end

	if #points == 0 then
		return NumberSequence.new(1)
	end
	if #points == 1 then
		return NumberSequence.new(points[1][2])
	end

	table.sort(points, function(a, b)
		return a[1] < b[1]
	end)
	if points[1][1] > 0 then
		table.insert(points, 1, { 0, points[1][2] })
	end
	if points[#points][1] < 1 then
		table.insert(points, { 1, points[#points][2] })
	end

	local cleaned = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do
		if #cleaned > 0 and point[1] <= cleaned[#cleaned][1] then
			cleaned[#cleaned] = point
		else
			table.insert(cleaned, point)
		end
	end
	if cleaned[1][1] > 0 then
		cleaned[1] = { 0, cleaned[1][2] }
	end
	if cleaned[#cleaned][1] < 1 then
		cleaned[#cleaned] = { 1, cleaned[#cleaned][2] }
	end
	while #cleaned > MAX_KEYPOINTS do
		table.remove(cleaned, math.floor(#cleaned / 2))
	end

	local keypointsOut = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(cleaned) do
		table.insert(keypointsOut, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keypointsOut)
end

--- Transparency is stored as increasing opacity values (0 = opaque).
function Format.transparency(value: any): NumberSequence
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return NumberSequence.new(clamp01(value))
	end
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return NumberSequence.new(0)
	end
	local points = {}
	for index, v in ipairs(value) do
		if type(v) == "table" then
			table.insert(points, { clamp01(tonumber(v[1]) or 0), clamp01(tonumber(v[2]) or 0) })
		else
			table.insert(points, { (index - 1) / math.max(1, #value - 1), clamp01(tonumber(v) or 0) })
		end
	end
	return Format.numberSequence(points)
end

function Format.numberRange(value: any, default: number?): NumberRange
	local fallback = default or 1
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return NumberRange.new(value)
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		local min = tonumber(value[1]) or fallback
		local max = tonumber(value[2]) or min
		if max < min then
			min, max = max, min
		end
		return NumberRange.new(min, max)
	end
	return NumberRange.new(fallback)
end

function Format.vector2(value: any, defaultY: number?): Vector2
	if type(value) == "table" then
		return Vector2.new(tonumber(value[1]) or 0, tonumber(value[2]) or defaultY or 0)
	elseif type(value) == "number" then
		return Vector2.new(value, value)
	end
	return Vector2.new(0, defaultY or 0)
end

function Format.vector3(value: any): Vector3
	if type(value) == "table" then
		return Vector3.new(tonumber(value[1]) or 0, tonumber(value[2]) or 0, tonumber(value[3]) or 0)
	elseif type(value) == "number" then
		return Vector3.new(value, value, value)
	end
	return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

--- Enum lookup that degrades to a default instead of erroring on older clients.
function Format.enum(enumType: Enum, name: any, defaultName: string): EnumItem
	local safeName = if type(name) == "string" then name else defaultName
	local ok, item = pcall(function()
		return (enumType :: any)[safeName]
	end)
	if ok and item then
		return item
	end
	local okDefault, fallback = pcall(function()
		return (enumType :: any)[defaultName]
	end)
	if okDefault and fallback then
		return fallback
	end
	local okItems, items = pcall(function()
		return enumType:GetEnumItems()
	end)
	if okItems and items and items[1] then
		return items[1]
	end
	error("VFX Studio: empty enum " .. tostring(enumType))
end

function Format.jsonEncode(value: any): string?
	local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(value)
	end)
	if ok then
		return encoded
	end
	warn("[VFX Studio] JSON encode failed: " .. tostring(encoded))
	return nil
end

function Format.jsonDecode(text: string?): any
	if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(text)
	end)
	if ok then
		return decoded
	end
	return nil
end

--- True when a stored keypoint list is flat (needed by the curve editor).
function Format.isFlat(list: any): boolean
	if type(list) ~= "table" then
		return true
	end
	local first = list[1]
	for _, value in ipairs(list) do
		if type(value) == "table" then
			if value ~= first then
				return false
			end
		elseif value ~= first then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

return Format

files.name: History
files.source:
--[[
	History - two undo systems, because VFX Studio mutates two different things:

	1. The working spec (pure data). Tracked with an in-memory stack so slider
	   and field edits can be undone without touching the DataModel.
	2. Real instances in the place (export, insert, optimize). Tracked with
	   ChangeHistoryService recordings so Studio's own Ctrl+Z handles them.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local History = {}
History.__index = History

type Entry = { label: string, snapshot: any };

function History.new(maxEntries: number?)
	return setmetatable({
		undoStack = {} :: { Entry },
		redoStack = {} :: { Entry },
		max = maxEntries or 64,
	}, History)
end

--- Records the state *before* a mutation. Call right before changing the spec.
function History:record(label: string, snapshot: any)
	table.insert(self.undoStack, { label = label, snapshot = Util.deepCopy(snapshot) })
	while #self.undoStack > self.max do
		table.remove(self.undoStack, 1)
	end
	self.redoStack = {}
end

--- Returns the previous snapshot, plus the label of the action undone.
function History:undo(current: any): (any?, string?)
	local entry = table.remove(self.undoStack)
	if not entry then
		return nil, nil
	end
	table.insert(self.redoStack, { label = entry.label, snapshot = Util.deepCopy(current) })
	return entry.snapshot, entry.label
end

function History:redo(current: any): (any?, string?)
	local entry = table.remove(self.redoStack)
	if not entry then
		return nil, nil
	end
	table.insert(self.undoStack, { label = entry.label, snapshot = Util.deepCopy(current) })
	return entry.snapshot, entry.label
end

function History:canUndo(): boolean
	return #self.undoStack > 0
end

function History:canRedo(): boolean
	return #self.redoStack > 0
end

function History:peekUndo(): string?
	local entry = self.undoStack[#self.undoStack]
	return entry and entry.label or nil
end

function History:peekRedo(): string?
	local entry = self.redoStack[#self.redoStack]
	return entry and entry.label or nil
end

function History:clear()
	self.undoStack = {}
	self.redoStack = {}
end

--- Wraps DataModel mutations in a ChangeHistoryService recording.
function History.beginRecording(name: string): any
	if ChangeHistoryService.TryBeginRecording then
		local ok, recording = pcall(function()
			return ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording(name)
		end)
		if ok and recording then
			return recording
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function History.endRecording(recording: any, commit: boolean?)
	if recording and ChangeHistoryService.FinishRecording then
		local operation = Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit
		if commit == false then
			operation = Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel
		end
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, operation)
		end)
	elseif commit ~= false then
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("VFX Studio")
		end)
	end
end

return History

files.name: Performance
files.source:
--[[
	Performance - budget analysis for effects. Works on both the live spec
	(while editing) and arbitrary instances in the place (Analyzer panel).

	The numbers are estimates of *concurrent particles*, which is the metric
	that actually costs frame time: steady-state emissions are rate x lifetime,
	bursts add their count on top.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Compiler = require(script.Parent.Compiler)

local Performance = {}

local SEVERITY_WEIGHT = { high = 20, medium = 11, low = 5 }

local function addIssue(report: any, severity: string, title: string, detail: string, fix: string?)
	table.insert(report.issues, {
		severity = severity,
		title = title,
		detail = detail,
		fix = fix,
	})
end

local function emptyReport(): any
	return {
		score = 100,
		grade = "A",
		alive = 0,
		burstPeak = 0,
		emitters = 0,
		beams = 0,
		trails = 0,
		lights = 0,
		parts = 0,
		textures = 0,
		remoteTextures = 0,
		components = 0,
		issues = {},
	}
end

local function finalize(report: any)
	for _, issue in ipairs(report.issues) do
		report.score -= SEVERITY_WEIGHT[issue.severity] or 4
	end
	if report.alive > 400 then
		report.score -= math.min(25, report.alive / 220)
	end
	report.score = math.clamp(math.floor(report.score + 0.5), 1, 100)
	if report.score >= 90 then
		report.grade = "A"
	elseif report.score >= 75 then
		report.grade = "B"
	elseif report.score >= 58 then
		report.grade = "C"
	else
		report.grade = "D"
	end
	return report
end

--- Analyzes a preset spec.
function Performance.analyze(spec: any): any
	local report = emptyReport()
	local components = spec and spec.components or {}
	report.components = #components
	local seenTextures: { [string]: boolean } = {}

	for _, comp in ipairs(components) do
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			report.emitters += 1
			local rate = math.max(0, tonumber(comp.rate) or 0)
			local lifetime = tonumber((comp.lifetime :: any)[1]) or 1
			local lifetimeMax = tonumber((comp.lifetime :: any)[2]) or lifetime
			local alive = rate * ((lifetime + lifetimeMax) * 0.5)
			report.alive += alive
			report.burstPeak += math.max(0, tonumber(comp.burst) or 0) * math.max(1, tonumber(comp.repeats) or 1)
			if alive > 700 then
				addIssue(
					report,
					"high",
					"Emitter \"" .. tostring(comp.name) .. "\" is heavy",
					string.format("about %d particles alive at once (rate %d x lifetime %s)", math.floor(alive + 0.5), rate, Util.pretty(lifetime)),
					"Lower the rate or use a longer lifetime with a lower rate."
				)
			elseif alive > 350 then
				addIssue(
					report,
					"medium",
					"Emitter \"" .. tostring(comp.name) .. "\" is warm",
					string.format("%d concurrent particles", math.floor(alive + 0.5)),
					"Consider trimming the rate below 350/lifetime."
				)
			end
			if (tonumber(comp.rate) or 0) <= 0 and (tonumber(comp.burst) or 0) <= 0 then
				addIssue(report, "low", "Emitter \"" .. tostring(comp.name) .. "\" never emits", "Rate and burst are both zero.", "Set a rate or a burst count.")
			end
			if tonumber(comp.zOffset) and math.abs(tonumber(comp.zOffset) or 0) > 40 then
				addIssue(report, "low", "Extreme ZOffset", "Large ZOffset values fight depth sorting on low-end devices.", "Keep ZOffset within +/- 20.")
			end
			local texture = tostring(comp.texture or "")
			if not seenTextures[texture] then
				seenTextures[texture] = true
				report.textures += 1
				if string.find(texture, "rbxassetid://", 1, true) then
					report.remoteTextures += 1
				end
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "beam" then
			report.beams += 1
			if (tonumber(comp.segments) or 0) > 30 then
				addIssue(report, "low", "Beam \"" .. tostring(comp.name) .. "\" has many segments", "Segments above 30 cost geometry for very little visual gain.", "Reduce segments to 24 or fewer.")
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "trail" then
			report.trails += 1
			if (tonumber(comp.lifetime) or 0) > 4 then
				addIssue(report, "low", "Long trail lifetime", "Trail \"" .. tostring(comp.name) .. "\" keeps geometry for a long time.", "Lower lifetime to ~1.5s.")
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "light" then
			report.lights += 1
			if comp.shadows == true then
				addIssue(report, "medium", "Shadow-casting light", "Shadowed PointLights are expensive per frame.", "Disable Shadows for effect lights.")
			end
			if (tonumber(comp.range) or 0) > 40 then
				addIssue(report, "low", "Large light range", "Range above 40 keeps the light relevant to many parts.", "Reduce range to ~24 studs.")
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "part" then
			report.parts += 1
			if (tonumber(comp.transparency) or 0) < 0.05 and tostring(comp.material) ~= "Neon" then
				addIssue(report, "low", "Opaque effect part", "Solid parts inside VFX hide the effect behind them.", "Increase transparency or use Neon.")
			end
		end
	end

	if report.lights > 4 then
		addIssue(report, "medium", "Many dynamic lights", string.format("%d PointLights in one effect", report.lights), "Cap effect lights at 4, or bake the glow into particles.")
	end
	if report.alive > 1500 then
		addIssue(report, "high", "Particle budget exceeded", string.format("%d concurrent particles in one effect", math.floor(report.alive + 0.5)), "Split the effect or lower the heaviest rates.")
	end
	if report.remoteTextures > 6 then
		addIssue(report, "low", "Many remote textures", string.format("%d asset textures to download", report.remoteTextures), "Reuse textures across emitters; each unique asset is a download.")
	end
	if report.components > 14 then
		addIssue(report, "medium", "Very complex effect", string.format("%d components", report.components), "Consolidate emitters that share settings.")
	end

	return finalize(report)
end

--- Analyzes real instances (selection, folder, model).
function Performance.analyzeInstances(root: Instance): any
	local report = emptyReport()
	local seenTextures: { [string]: boolean } = {}

	local function scan(inst: Instance)
		if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			report.emitters += 1
			report.components += 1
			local lifetime = (inst.Lifetime.Min + inst.Lifetime.Max) * 0.5
			report.alive += inst.Rate * lifetime
			if inst.Rate * lifetime > 700 then
				addIssue(report, "high", "Heavy emitter: " .. inst:GetFullName(), string.format("%d concurrent particles", math.floor(inst.Rate * lifetime + 0.5)), "Reduce Rate or Lifetime.")
			end
			local texture = inst.Texture
			if not seenTextures[texture] then
				seenTextures[texture] = true
				report.textures += 1
				if string.find(texture, "rbxassetid://", 1, true) then
					report.remoteTextures += 1
				end
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Beam") then
			report.beams += 1
			report.components += 1
			if inst.Segments > 30 then
				addIssue(report, "low", "High segment beam: " .. inst.Name, inst.Segments .. " segments", "Reduce Segments to 24.")
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Trail") then
			report.trails += 1
			report.components += 1
		elseif inst:IsA("PointLight") then
			report.lights += 1
			report.components += 1
			if inst.Shadows then
				addIssue(report, "medium", "Shadowed light: " .. inst.Name, "Shadows enabled on an effect light.", "Disable Shadows.")
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Transparency < 1 and inst.Name ~= "Rig" then
			report.parts += 1
			report.components += 1
		end
	end

	scan(root)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		scan(descendant)
	end

	if report.lights > 4 then
		addIssue(report, "medium", "Many dynamic lights", string.format("%d PointLights", report.lights), "Cap effect lights at 4.")
	end
	return finalize(report)
end

--- Produces an optimized copy of the spec plus a human readable change list.
function Performance.optimize(spec: any): (any, { string })
	local optimized = Util.deepCopy(spec)
	local changes = {}

	for _, comp in ipairs(optimized.components or {}) do
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			local rate = tonumber(comp.rate) or 0
			if rate > 60 then
				comp.rate = 60
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: rate %d -> 60", comp.name, math.floor(rate)))
			end
			local lifetimeMax = tonumber((comp.lifetime :: any)[2]) or 1
			if lifetimeMax > 3 then
				comp.lifetime = { 0.4, 3 }
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: lifetime capped at 3s", comp.name))
			end
			if (tonumber(comp.repeats) or 1) > 3 then
				comp.repeats = 3
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: repeats capped at 3", comp.name))
			end
			if math.abs(tonumber(comp.zOffset) or 0) > 20 then
				comp.zOffset = math.clamp(tonumber(comp.zOffset) or 0, -20, 20)
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: ZOffset clamped", comp.name))
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "beam" then
			if (tonumber(comp.segments) or 0) > 24 then
				comp.segments = 24
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: segments -> 24", comp.name))
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "light" then
			if comp.shadows == true then
				comp.shadows = false
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: shadows disabled", comp.name))
			end
			if (tonumber(comp.range) or 0) > 32 then
				comp.range = 32
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: range -> 32", comp.name))
			end
		elseif comp.kind == "part" then
			if (tonumber(comp.transparency) or 0) < 0.05 then
				comp.transparency = 0.15
				table.insert(changes, string.format("%s: transparency raised", comp.name))
			end
		end
	end

	if #changes == 0 then
		table.insert(changes, "Nothing to optimize - this effect is already within budget.")
	end
	return optimized, changes
end

--- Live particle estimate for a single component (used by the properties panel).
function Performance.componentCost(comp: any): number
	if comp.kind ~= "particle" then
		return 0
	end
	local rate = math.max(0, tonumber(comp.rate) or 0)
	local min = tonumber((comp.lifetime :: any)[1]) or 1
	local max = tonumber((comp.lifetime :: any)[2]) or min
	return rate * ((min + max) * 0.5) + math.max(0, tonumber(comp.burst) or 0)
end

function Performance.analyzeModel(model: Instance): any
	return Performance.analyzeInstances(model)
end

function Performance.analyzeSpec(spec: any): any
	return Performance.analyze(spec)
end

function Performance.fromModel(model: Instance): any
	local spec = Compiler.readSpec(model)
	if spec then
		return Performance.analyze(spec)
	end
	return Performance.analyzeInstances(model)
end

return Performance

files.name: Player
files.source:
--[[
	Player - the timeline runtime. Drives a compiled effect model through its
	emission windows, bursts, loops and tween tracks.

	The same semantics are emitted into generated controller scripts, so what
	the viewport previews is what ships in the game.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Format = require(script.Parent.Format)
local Compiler = require(script.Parent.Compiler)

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = {}
Player.__index = Player

local function clamp01(value: any): number
	return math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 0, 0, 1)
end

function Player.new(model: Model, spec: any?)
	local resolvedSpec = spec or Compiler.readSpec(model)
	if not resolvedSpec then
		error("VFX Studio: cannot play an effect without a spec")
	end
	local self = setmetatable({
		model = model,
		spec = resolvedSpec,
		bindings = Compiler.resolve(model),
		playing = false,
		token = 0,
		speed = 1,
		loop = resolvedSpec.loop == true,
		tweens = {} :: { Tween },
		_onStateChange = nil,
	}, Player)
	return self
end

function Player:SetSpeed(speed: number)
	self.speed = math.clamp(speed or 1, 0.1, 4)
end

function Player:IsPlaying(): boolean
	return self.playing
end

function Player:_entryFor(comp: any): any?
	return self.bindings[comp.name]
end

--- Creates a tween that is cancelled automatically when playback stops.
function Player:_tweenTo(instance: Instance, info: TweenInfo, props: any): Tween
	local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, info, props)
	table.insert(self.tweens, tween)
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		for index, item in ipairs(self.tweens) do
			if item == tween then
				table.remove(self.tweens, index)
				break
			end
		end
	end)
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

function Player:_cancelTweens()
	for _, tween in ipairs(self.tweens) do
		pcall(function()
			tween:Cancel()
		end)
	end
	self.tweens = {}
end

function Player:_resetOne(comp: any)
	local entry = self:_entryFor(comp)
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	if comp.kind == "particle" and entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		entry.primary.Enabled = false
		entry.primary:Clear()
	elseif comp.kind == "beam" and entry.primary:IsA("Beam") then
		entry.primary.Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "trail" and entry.primary:IsA("Trail") then
		entry.primary.Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "light" and entry.primary:IsA("PointLight") then
		entry.primary.Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "part" and entry.primary:IsA("BasePart") then
		entry.primary.Transparency = 1
	end
end

function Player:Reset()
	self:_cancelTweens()
	for _, comp in ipairs(self.spec.components or {}) do
		self:_resetOne(comp)
	end
end

function Player:_burst(comp: any)
	local entry = self:_entryFor(comp)
	if not entry or not entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		return
	end
	local count = math.floor(tonumber(comp.burst) or 0)
	if count > 0 then
		entry.primary:Emit(count)
	end
end

function Player:_activate(comp: any)
	local entry = self:_entryFor(comp)
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	if comp.kind == "particle" then
		if not entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			return
		end
		local emitter = entry.primary :: ParticleEmitter
		if (tonumber(comp.burst) or 0) > 0 then
			emitter:Emit(math.floor(tonumber(comp.burst) or 0))
		end
		if (tonumber(comp.rate) or 0) > 0 then
			emitter.Enabled = true
		end
	elseif comp.kind == "beam" and entry.primary:IsA("Beam") then
		(entry.primary :: Beam).Enabled = true
	elseif comp.kind == "trail" and entry.primary:IsA("Trail") then
		(entry.primary :: Trail).Enabled = true
	elseif comp.kind == "light" and entry.primary:IsA("PointLight") then
		(entry.primary :: PointLight).Enabled = true
	elseif comp.kind == "part" and entry.primary:IsA("BasePart") then
		local part = entry.primary :: BasePart
		part.Transparency = 1
		Util.tween(part, { Transparency = clamp01(comp.transparency) }, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local base = CFrame.new(Format.vector3(comp.offset))
		if (tonumber(comp.float) or 0) ~= 0 then
			local duration = math.max(0.05, tonumber(comp.duration) or 1)
			part.CFrame = base
			Util.tween(part, { CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, tonumber(comp.float) or 0, 0) }, duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		end
	end
end

function Player:_deactivate(comp: any)
	local entry = self:_entryFor(comp)
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	if comp.kind == "particle" and entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		(entry.primary :: ParticleEmitter).Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "beam" and entry.primary:IsA("Beam") then
		(entry.primary :: Beam).Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "trail" and entry.primary:IsA("Trail") then
		(entry.primary :: Trail).Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "light" and entry.primary:IsA("PointLight") then
		(entry.primary :: PointLight).Enabled = false
	elseif comp.kind == "part" and entry.primary:IsA("BasePart") then
		local part = entry.primary :: BasePart
		local tween = Util.tween(part, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		tween.Completed:Once(function()
			if part.Parent then
				part.CFrame = CFrame.new(Format.vector3(comp.offset))
			end
		end)
	end
end

function Player:_runTween(comp: any)
	local targetName = tostring(comp.target or "rig")
	local target: Instance? = nil
	if targetName == "rig" then
		target = self.model:FindFirstChild(Compiler.RIG_NAME)
	else
		local entry = self.bindings[targetName]
		if entry then
			target = entry.primary
		end
	end
	if not target then
		return
	end

	local style = Format.enum(Enum.EasingStyle, comp.easing, "Quad")
	local direction = Format.enum(Enum.EasingDirection, comp.direction, "Out")
	local duration = math.max(0.05, (tonumber(comp.duration) or 1) / self.speed)
	local repeatCount = math.floor(tonumber(comp.repeatCount) or 0)
	local reverse = comp.reverse == true
	local info = TweenInfo.new(duration, style, direction, repeatCount, reverse)

	local from = tonumber(comp.from) or 0
	local to = tonumber(comp.to) or 0
	local property = tostring(comp.property or "spin")

	if property == "spin" or property == "float" then
		local rig = self.model:FindFirstChild(Compiler.RIG_NAME)
		if not rig or not rig:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		local base = rig.CFrame
		local goal: CFrame
		if property == "spin" then
			goal = base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(to), 0)
			rig.CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(from), 0)
		else
			goal = base * CFrame.new(0, to, 0)
			rig.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, from, 0)
		end
		self:_tweenTo(rig, info, { CFrame = goal })
		return
	elseif property == "brightness" and target:IsA("PointLight") then
		target.Brightness = from
		self:_tweenTo(target, info, { Brightness = to })
		return
	elseif property == "transparency" and target:IsA("BasePart") then
		target.Transparency = clamp01(from)
		self:_tweenTo(target, info, { Transparency = clamp01(to) })
		return
	elseif property == "scale" and target:IsA("BasePart") then
		local baseSize = target.Size
		target.Size = baseSize * math.max(0.01, from)
		self:_tweenTo(target, info, { Size = baseSize * math.max(0.01, to) })
		return
	elseif property == "color" and target:IsA("PointLight") then
		target.Color = Util.hex(tostring(comp.fromColor or "#ffffff"))
		self:_tweenTo(target, info, { Color = Util.hex(tostring(comp.toColor or "#ffffff")) })
		return
	end
end

--- Plays the effect. Returns self.
function Player:Play(options: any?)
	local opts = options or {}
	self:Stop(false)
	self.token += 1
	local token = self.token
	self.playing = true
	if opts.loop ~= nil then
		self.loop = opts.loop == true
	end
	if self._onStateChange then
		self._onStateChange(true)
	end

	self:Reset()

	local total = math.max(0.1, tonumber(self.spec.duration) or 1)
	local components = self.spec.components or {}

	local function alive(): boolean
		return self.token == token
	end

	local function runComponent(comp: any)
		local start = math.max(0, tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0) / self.speed
		if start > 0 then
			task.wait(start)
		end
		if not alive() then
			return
		end

		if comp.kind == "tween" then
			self:_runTween(comp)
			return
		end

		local duration = math.max(0, tonumber(comp.duration) or 0) / self.speed
		local repeats = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(comp.repeats) or 1))
		local isBurst = (tonumber(comp.burst) or 0) > 0
		local isContinuous = (tonumber(comp.rate) or 0) > 0

		if isBurst and repeats > 1 and duration > 0 then
			local interval = duration / repeats
			for index = 1, repeats do
				if not alive() then
					return
				end
				self:_burst(comp)
				if index < repeats then
					task.wait(math.max(0.02, interval))
				end
			end
			if isContinuous then
				self:_deactivate(comp)
			end
			return
		end

		self:_activate(comp)
		if duration > 0 then
			task.wait(duration)
		end
		if not alive() then
			return
		end
		self:_deactivate(comp)
	end

	local function cycle()
		for _, comp in ipairs(components) do
			task.spawn(runComponent, comp)
		end
		task.wait(total / self.speed)
		if not alive() then
			return
		end
		if self.loop then
			self:Reset()
			cycle()
		else
			for _, comp in ipairs(components) do
				self:_deactivate(comp)
			end
			self.playing = false
			if self._onStateChange then
				self._onStateChange(false)
			end
		end
	end

	task.spawn(cycle)
	return self
end

function Player:Stop(notify: boolean?)
	self.token += 1
	self.playing = false
	self:_cancelTweens()
	for _, comp in ipairs(self.spec.components or {}) do
		self:_deactivate(comp)
		self:_resetOne(comp)
	end
	if notify ~= false and self._onStateChange then
		self._onStateChange(false)
	end
end

function Player:Destroy()
	self:Stop(false)
	self._onStateChange = nil
end

function Player:OnStateChange(callback: ((boolean) -> ())?)
	self._onStateChange = callback
end

return Player

files.name: ScriptGenerator
files.source:
--[[
	ScriptGenerator - writes the Luau controller that ships with every exported
	effect.

	The generated ModuleScript is self-contained: it embeds the effect's
	timeline and drives the real instances with the same semantics as the
	editor's preview (enabled windows, bursts, repeats, loops and tween tracks).
]]

local Format = require(script.Parent.Format)

local ScriptGenerator = {}

local RUNTIME_TEMPLATE = [==[
--!nonstrict
--[[
	VFX Studio controller for "{{NAME}}"
	Generated {{VERSION}} - do not edit the timeline table by hand; re-export
	from the studio instead.

	Usage (client or server):
		local VFX = require(script.Parent)          -- this ModuleScript
		local handle = VFX.play(CFrame.new(0, 5, 0))
		handle:Pause()      -- stop emitting, let live particles fade
		handle:Play()       -- resume
		handle:Destroy()    -- clean up

		VFX.attach(workspace.SomePart)              -- follow a part
		VFX.playOnce()                              -- fire and forget
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local TIMELINE = {{TIMELINE}}
local DURATION = {{DURATION}}
local LOOPING = {{LOOP}}
local PRESET_NAME = "{{NAME}}"

local Effect = script.Parent
local VFX = {}
VFX.presetName = PRESET_NAME
VFX.duration = DURATION
VFX.looping = LOOPING

local function resolveRig(model)
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name == "Rig" then
			return child
		end
	end
	return model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

local function bindingsOf(model)
	local map = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		local name = descendant:GetAttribute("VFXComponent")
		if name then
			map[name] = map[name] or {}
			table.insert(map[name], descendant)
			if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
				or descendant:IsA("Beam")
				or descendant:IsA("Trail")
				or descendant:IsA("PointLight")
				or (descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name ~= "Rig")
			then
				map[name].primary = descendant
			end
		end
	end
	return map
end

local function setEnabled(entry, enabled)
	if not entry or not entry.primary then
		return
	end
	local target = entry.primary
	if target:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or target:IsA("Beam") or target:IsA("Trail") or target:IsA("PointLight") then
		target.Enabled = enabled
	end
end

local function fireBurst(entry, count)
	if not entry or not entry.primary or not entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		return
	end
	if count > 0 then
		entry.primary:Emit(count)
	end
end

local function resetAll(model, bindings)
	for _, comp in ipairs(TIMELINE) do
		local entry = bindings[comp.name]
		if entry and entry.primary then
			if entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				entry.primary.Enabled = false
				entry.primary:Clear()
			elseif entry.primary:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				entry.primary.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function runComponent(model, bindings, comp, token, state)
	local entry = bindings[comp.name]
	if not entry then
		return
	end

	if comp.kind == "tween" then
		local target = model:FindFirstChild("Rig")
		if comp.target ~= "rig" and bindings[comp.target] then
			target = bindings[comp.target].primary
		end
		if target then
			local style = Enum.EasingStyle[comp.easing] or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
			local direction = Enum.EasingDirection[comp.direction] or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
			local info = TweenInfo.new(comp.duration, style, direction, comp.repeatCount, comp.reverse)
			if comp.property == "spin" and target:IsA("BasePart") then
				local base = target.CFrame
				target.CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(comp.from), 0)
				local tween = TweenService:Create(target, info, { CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(comp.to), 0) })
				tween:Play()
				table.insert(state.tweens, tween)
			elseif comp.property == "float" and target:IsA("BasePart") then
				local base = target.CFrame
				target.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, comp.from, 0)
				local tween = TweenService:Create(target, info, { CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, comp.to, 0) })
				tween:Play()
				table.insert(state.tweens, tween)
			elseif comp.property == "brightness" and target:IsA("PointLight") then
				target.Brightness = comp.from
				local tween = TweenService:Create(target, info, { Brightness = comp.to })
				tween:Play()
				table.insert(state.tweens, tween)
			elseif comp.property == "transparency" and target:IsA("BasePart") then
				target.Transparency = comp.from
				local tween = TweenService:Create(target, info, { Transparency = comp.to })
				tween:Play()
				table.insert(state.tweens, tween)
			elseif comp.property == "scale" and target:IsA("BasePart") then
				local base = target.Size
				target.Size = base * math.max(0.01, comp.from)
				local tween = TweenService:Create(target, info, { Size = base * math.max(0.01, comp.to) })
				tween:Play()
				table.insert(state.tweens, tween)
			end
		end
		return
	end

	local start = math.max(0, comp.startTime) / state.speed
	if start > 0 then
		task.wait(start)
	end
	if token ~= state.token then
		return
	end

	local duration = math.max(0, comp.duration) / state.speed
	local repeats = math.max(1, math.floor(comp.repeats or 1))
	local isBurst = (comp.burst or 0) > 0
	local isContinuous = (comp.rate or 0) > 0

	if isBurst and repeats > 1 and duration > 0 then
		local interval = duration / repeats
		for index = 1, repeats do
			if token ~= state.token then
				return
			end
			fireBurst(entry, math.floor(comp.burst))
			if index < repeats then
				task.wait(math.max(0.02, interval))
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if isBurst then
		fireBurst(entry, math.floor(comp.burst))
	end
	if isContinuous then
		setEnabled(entry, true)
	end
	if duration > 0 then
		task.wait(duration)
	end
	if token ~= state.token then
		return
	end
	if isContinuous then
		setEnabled(entry, false)
	end
end

local Handle = {}
Handle.__index = Handle

function Handle:Play()
	if self.destroyed or self.playing then
		return self
	end
	self.playing = true
	self.token += 1
	local token = self.token
	local state = self.state
	state.token = token
	local model = self.model
	local bindings = self.bindings

	resetAll(model, bindings)

	for _, comp in ipairs(TIMELINE) do
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(runComponent, model, bindings, comp, token, state)
			if not ok then
				warn("[VFX] " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)
	end

	task.delay(DURATION / state.speed, function()
		if token ~= self.token or self.destroyed then
			return
		end
		if LOOPING then
			self.playing = false
			self:Play()
		else
			self.playing = false
		end
	end)
	return self
end

function Handle:Pause()
	self.token += 1
	self.playing = false
	for _, comp in ipairs(TIMELINE) do
		local entry = self.bindings[comp.name]
		if entry then
			setEnabled(entry, false)
		end
	end
	return self
end

function Handle:Destroy()
	self.destroyed = true
	self.token += 1
	self.playing = false
	for _, tween in ipairs(self.state.tweens) do
		pcall(function()
			tween:Cancel()
		end)
	end
	if self.connection then
		self.connection:Disconnect()
	end
	if self.model and self.model.Parent then
		self.model:Destroy()
	end
	return self
end

local function spawn(cframe, parent)
	local model = Effect:Clone()
	local rig = resolveRig(model)
	if rig then
		rig.CFrame = cframe
	end
	model.Parent = parent or workspace
	local handle = setmetatable({
		model = model,
		bindings = bindingsOf(model),
		state = { token = 0, speed = 1, tweens = {} },
		playing = false,
		destroyed = false,
		token = 0,
	}, Handle)
	return handle
end

function VFX.play(cframe, parent)
	return spawn(cframe or CFrame.new(), parent)
end

function VFX.playOnce(cframe, parent)
	local handle = spawn(cframe or CFrame.new(), parent)
	handle:Play()
	return handle
end

function VFX.attach(part)
	local handle = spawn(part.CFrame, part)
	local rig = resolveRig(handle.model)
	if rig then
		handle.connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not part.Parent then
				handle:Destroy()
				return
			end
			rig.CFrame = part.CFrame
		end)
	end
	return handle
end

return VFX
]==]

ScriptGenerator.VERSION = "VFX Studio 1.0"

--- Serialises only what the controller needs at runtime.
function ScriptGenerator.timeline(spec: any): string
	local rows = {}
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		table.insert(rows, string.format(
			'{ name = "%s", kind = "%s", startTime = %s, duration = %s, rate = %s, burst = %s, repeats = %s, target = "%s", property = "%s", from = %s, to = %s, easing = "%s", direction = "%s", repeatCount = %s, reverse = %s }',
			tostring(comp.name):gsub('"', "'"),
			tostring(comp.kind),
			tostring(tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0),
			tostring(tonumber(comp.duration) or 0),
			tostring(tonumber(comp.rate) or 0),
			tostring(tonumber(comp.burst) or 0),
			tostring(math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(comp.repeats) or 1))),
			tostring(comp.target or "rig"),
			tostring(comp.property or ""),
			tostring(tonumber(comp.from) or 0),
			tostring(tonumber(comp.to) or 0),
			tostring(comp.easing or "Quad"),
			tostring(comp.direction or "Out"),
			tostring(math.floor(tonumber(comp.repeatCount) or 0)),
			tostring(comp.reverse == true)
		))
	end
	return "{\n\t" .. table.concat(rows, ",\n\t") .. "\n}"
end

--- Produces the text of the controller ModuleScript for a spec.
function ScriptGenerator.generate(spec: any): string
	local source = RUNTIME_TEMPLATE
