	source = string.gsub(source, "{{NAME}}", (tostring(spec.name or "Effect"):gsub('"', "'")))
	source = string.gsub(source, "{{VERSION}}", ScriptGenerator.VERSION)
	source = string.gsub(source, "{{TIMELINE}}", ScriptGenerator.timeline(spec))
	source = string.gsub(source, "{{DURATION}}", tostring(math.max(0.1, tonumber(spec.duration) or 1.5)))
	source = string.gsub(source, "{{LOOP}}", tostring(spec.loop == true))
	return source
end

--- Short usage snippet shown next to the generated script in the UI.
function ScriptGenerator.usage(spec: any, modulePath: string?): string
	local path = modulePath or "ReplicatedStorage.VFXPresets." .. (spec.name or "Effect")
	local lines = {
		"-- Insert the effect, then control it from any script:",
		"local VFX = require(" .. path .. ")",
		"",
		"local handle = VFX.play(CFrame.new(0, 5, 0))",
		"handle:Play()      -- start",
		"handle:Pause()     -- stop emitting",
		"handle:Destroy()   -- remove the clone",
		"",
		"-- Or attach it to a moving part:",
		"VFX.attach(workspace.SomePart)",
	}
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

return ScriptGenerator

files.name: Signals
files.source:
--[[
	Signals - a tiny synchronous event bus. Panels subscribe to store events
	instead of polling, which keeps the editor responsive.
]]

local Signals = {}
Signals.__index = Signals

type Handler = (any) -> ();

function Signals.new()
	return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} :: { [string]: { Handler } } }, Signals)
end

function Signals:on(event: string, handler: Handler): { disconnect: () -> () }
	local list = self._handlers[event]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		self._handlers[event] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, handler)

	local connection = {
		disconnect = function()
			local current = self._handlers[event]
			if not current then
				return
			end
			for index, item in ipairs(current) do
				if item == handler then
					table.remove(current, index)
					break
				end
			end
		end,
	}
	return connection
end

function Signals:fire(event: string, payload: any)
	local list = self._handlers[event]
	if not list then
		return
	end
	-- Copy so a handler may unsubscribe while we iterate.
	local snapshot = table.clone(list)
	for _, handler in ipairs(snapshot) do
		local ok, err = pcall(handler, payload)
		if not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] handler error on '" .. event .. "': " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

function Signals:clear()
	self._handlers = {}
end

return Signals

files.name: Store
files.source:
--[[
	Store - the editor's single source of truth.

	Holds the working spec, selection, undo stack, favourites and the
	developer's saved custom presets, and persists the parts that should
	survive a Studio restart through plugin settings.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Signals = require(script.Parent.Signals)
local History = require(script.Parent.History)
local Format = require(script.Parent.Format)
local DSL = require(script.Parent.Parent.Presets.DSL)

local Store = {}
Store.__index = Store

local SETTING_KEY = "VFXStudio.state.v2"
local SAVE_DEBOUNCE = 0.6

function Store.new(pluginInstance: Plugin, presets: any)
	local self = setmetatable({
		plugin = pluginInstance,
		presets = presets,
		signals = Signals.new(),
		history = History.new(80),
		spec = Util.deepCopy(presets.all[1]),
		selection = 1,
		favorites = {} :: { [string]: boolean },
		custom = {} :: { any },
		prefs = {
			speed = 1,
			loop = false,
			autoPlay = true,
			background = "studio",
			leftWidth = 286,
			rightWidth = 322,
			lastPresetId = "",
			lastCategory = "All",
		},
		saveToken = 0,
	}, Store)

	self:load()
	return self
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- validation / normalisation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local COMPONENT_DEFAULTS = {
	particle = function(name: string)
		return DSL.P({ name = name })
	end,
	beam = function(name: string)
		return DSL.B({ name = name })
	end,
	trail = function(name: string)
		return DSL.T({ name = name })
	end,
	light = function(name: string)
		return DSL.L({ name = name })
	end,
	part = function(name: string)
		return DSL.M({ name = name })
	end,
	tween = function(name: string)
		return DSL.A({ name = name })
	end,
}

--- Fills in any missing field on a custom/imported component so the inspector
--- can always render it, without discarding values a newer version added.
function Store.normalizeComponent(comp: any): any
	if type(comp) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local kind = comp.kind
	local factory = COMPONENT_DEFAULTS[kind]
	if not factory then
		return nil
	end
	local base = factory(tostring(comp.name or kind))
	for key, value in pairs(comp) do
		base[key] = value
	end
	base.kind = kind
	return base
end

function Store.normalizeSpec(spec: any): any
	local normalized = {
		id = spec.id or ("custom_" .. Util.slug(tostring(spec.name or "effect"))),
		name = tostring(spec.name or "Custom Effect"),
		category = tostring(spec.category or "Custom"),
		tags = type(spec.tags) == "table" and spec.tags or { "custom" },
		description = spec.description,
		duration = math.max(0.1, tonumber(spec.duration) or 1.5),
		loop = spec.loop == true,
		components = {},
	}
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		local fixed = Store.normalizeComponent(comp)
		if fixed then
			table.insert(normalized.components, fixed)
		end
	end
	if #normalized.components == 0 then
		table.insert(normalized.components, DSL.P({ name = "Particles" }))
	end
	return normalized
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- persistence
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Store:load()
	local raw = self.plugin:GetSetting(SETTING_KEY)
	local data = Format.jsonDecode(if type(raw) == "string" then raw else nil)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if type(data.favorites) == "table" then
		for id, enabled in pairs(data.favorites) do
			if enabled == true and type(id) == "string" then
				self.favorites[id] = true
			end
		end
	end

	if type(data.custom) == "table" then
		for _, entry in ipairs(data.custom) do
			local ok, normalized = pcall(Store.normalizeSpec, entry)
			if ok and normalized then
				normalized.category = "Custom"
				table.insert(self.custom, normalized)
			end
		end
	end

	if type(data.prefs) == "table" then
		for key, value in pairs(data.prefs) do
			if self.prefs[key] ~= nil or key == "lastPresetId" then
				self.prefs[key] = value
			end
		end
	end
end

function Store:save()
	local payload = {
		favorites = self.favorites,
		custom = self.custom,
		prefs = self.prefs,
	}
	local encoded = Format.jsonEncode(payload)
	if encoded then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			self.plugin:SetSetting(SETTING_KEY, encoded)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] could not save settings: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

function Store:scheduleSave()
	self.saveToken += 1
	local token = self.saveToken
	task.delay(SAVE_DEBOUNCE, function()
		if token == self.saveToken then
			self:save()
		end
	end)
end

function Store:getPref(key: string, fallback: any): any
	local value = self.prefs[key]
	if value == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	return value
end

function Store:setPref(key: string, value: any, options: any?)
	self.prefs[key] = value
	self:scheduleSave()
	if not options or options.silent ~= true then
		self.signals:fire("pref", { key = key, value = value })
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- working spec
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Store:_snapshot(): any
	return {
		spec = Util.deepCopy(self.spec),
		selection = self.selection,
	}
end

function Store:_restore(snapshot: any)
	if not snapshot or not snapshot.spec then
		return
	end
	self.spec = Util.deepCopy(snapshot.spec)
	self.selection = math.clamp(snapshot.selection or 1, 1, math.max(1, #self.spec.components))
	self.signals:fire("spec")
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
	self.signals:fire("history")
end

function Store:working(): any
	return self.spec
end

function Store:currentComponent(): any?
	return self.spec.components[self.selection]
end

function Store:pushHistory(label: string)
	self.history:record(label, self:_snapshot())
	self.signals:fire("history")
end

function Store:undo()
	local snapshot, label = self.history:undo(self:_snapshot())
	if snapshot then
		self:_restore(snapshot)
		self.signals:fire("status", "Undid " .. tostring(label):lower())
	end
end

function Store:redo()
	local snapshot, label = self.history:redo(self:_snapshot())
	if snapshot then
		self:_restore(snapshot)
		self.signals:fire("status", "Redid " .. tostring(label):lower())
	end
end

function Store:applyPreset(spec: any, label: string?)
	local copy = Util.deepCopy(spec)
	copy = Store.normalizeSpec(copy)
	copy.id = spec.id
	copy.category = spec.category
	copy.tags = spec.tags
	copy.description = spec.description
	copy.loop = spec.loop
	self:pushHistory(label or ("Load " .. tostring(spec.name)))
	self.spec = copy
	self.selection = 1
	self.prefs.lastPresetId = spec.id or ""
	self:scheduleSave()
	self.signals:fire("spec")
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
	self.signals:fire("history")
end

function Store:select(index: number)
	local count = #self.spec.components
	if count == 0 then
		self.selection = 1
	else
		self.selection = math.clamp(index, 1, count)
	end
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
end

--- Mutates a single field without rebuilding the whole editor.
--- `record` pushes an undo entry first (used by discrete controls).
function Store:setField(index: number, key: string, value: any, record: boolean?)
	local comp = self.spec.components[index]
	if not comp then
		return
	end
	if record then
		self:pushHistory("Change " .. tostring(key))
	end
	comp[key] = value
	self.signals:fire("field", { index = index, key = key, value = value })
end

function Store:setSpecField(key: string, value: any, record: boolean?)
	if record then
		self:pushHistory("Change " .. tostring(key))
	end
	self.spec[key] = value
	self.signals:fire("spec")
end

function Store:addComponent(kind: string): number
	local factory = COMPONENT_DEFAULTS[kind]
	if not factory then
		return 0
	end
	self:pushHistory("Add " .. kind)
	local count = #self.spec.components + 1
	local name = kind:sub(1, 1):upper() .. kind:sub(2) .. " " .. count
	local used = {}
	for _, comp in ipairs(self.spec.components) do
		used[comp.name] = true
	end
	local attempt = 1
	while used[name] do
		attempt += 1
		name = kind:sub(1, 1):upper() .. kind:sub(2) .. " " .. count .. " (" .. attempt .. ")"
	end
	local comp = factory(name)
	comp.name = name
	table.insert(self.spec.components, comp)
	self.selection = #self.spec.components
	self.signals:fire("spec")
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
	return self.selection
end

function Store:removeComponent(index: number)
	local comp = self.spec.components[index]
	if not comp then
		return
	end
	self:pushHistory("Delete " .. tostring(comp.name))
	table.remove(self.spec.components, index)
	self.selection = math.clamp(self.selection, 1, math.max(1, #self.spec.components))
	self.signals:fire("spec")
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
end

function Store:duplicateComponent(index: number)
	local comp = self.spec.components[index]
	if not comp then
		return
	end
	self:pushHistory("Duplicate " .. tostring(comp.name))
	local copy = Util.deepCopy(comp)
	local base = copy.name .. " Copy"
	local used = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(self.spec.components) do
		used[item.name] = true
	end
	local name = base
	local suffix = 2
	while used[name] do
		name = base .. " " .. suffix
		suffix += 1
	end
	copy.name = name
	table.insert(self.spec.components, index + 1, copy)
	self.selection = index + 1
	self.signals:fire("spec")
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
end

function Store:moveComponent(from: number, to: number)
	local count = #self.spec.components
	if from < 1 or from > count or to < 1 or to > count or from == to then
		return
	end
	self:pushHistory("Reorder components")
	local comp = table.remove(self.spec.components, from)
	table.insert(self.spec.components, to, comp)
	self.selection = to
	self.signals:fire("spec")
	self.signals:fire("selection", self.selection)
end

function Store:renameComponent(index: number, newName: string)
	local comp = self.spec.components[index]
	if not comp then
		return
	end
	local trimmed = Util.trim(newName)
	if trimmed == "" or trimmed == comp.name then
		return
	end
	self:pushHistory("Rename component")
	comp.name = trimmed
	self.signals:fire("spec")
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- favourites
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Store:isFavorite(id: string): boolean
	return self.favorites[id] == true
end

function Store:toggleFavorite(id: string)
	if not id or id == "" then
		return
	end
	if self.favorites[id] then
		self.favorites[id] = nil
	else
		self.favorites[id] = true
	end
	self:scheduleSave()
	self.signals:fire("favorites", id)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- custom presets
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Store:customPresets(): { any }
	return self.custom
end

function Store:findCustom(id: string): any?
	for _, spec in ipairs(self.custom) do
		if spec.id == id then
			return spec
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Store:saveCustomPreset(name: string, description: string?): any
	local trimmed = Util.trim(name)
	if trimmed == "" then
		trimmed = "My Effect"
	end
	local copy = Store.normalizeSpec(Util.deepCopy(self.spec))
	copy.name = trimmed
	copy.category = "Custom"
	copy.description = description or ("Custom effect saved from " .. tostring(self.spec.name) .. ".")
	copy.id = "custom_" .. Util.slug(trimmed)
	local suffix = 2
	while self:findCustom(copy.id) do
		copy.id = "custom_" .. Util.slug(trimmed) .. "_" .. suffix
		suffix += 1
	end
	copy.tags = table.clone(self.spec.tags or {})
	if #copy.tags == 0 then
		copy.tags = { "custom" }
	end
	table.insert(self.custom, copy)
	self.prefs.lastPresetId = copy.id
	self:scheduleSave()
	self.signals:fire("custom")
	self.signals:fire("status", "Saved preset \"" .. trimmed .. "\"")
	return copy
end

function Store:updateCustomPreset(id: string, name: string?): any?
	local spec = self:findCustom(id)
	if not spec then
		return nil
	end
	self:pushHistory("Update custom preset")
	local copy = Store.normalizeSpec(Util.deepCopy(self.spec))
	copy.id = spec.id
	copy.name = name or spec.name
	copy.category = "Custom"
	copy.description = spec.description
	copy.tags = table.clone(self.spec.tags or {})
	spec.name = copy.name
	spec.components = copy.components
	spec.duration = copy.duration
	spec.tags = copy.tags
	self:scheduleSave()
	self.signals:fire("custom")
	self.signals:fire("status", "Updated \"" .. tostring(spec.name) .. "\"")
	return spec
end

function Store:deleteCustomPreset(id: string): boolean
	for index, spec in ipairs(self.custom) do
		if spec.id == id then
			table.remove(self.custom, index)
			self.favorites[id] = nil
			self:scheduleSave()
			self.signals:fire("custom")
			self.signals:fire("status", "Deleted \"" .. tostring(spec.name) .. "\"")
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- library access helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Store:search(query: string?, options: any?): { any }
	local opts = options or {}
	opts.favorites = self.favorites
	-- "Favourites" and "Custom" are store-level views, not preset categories.
	if opts.category == "Favorites" or opts.category == "Custom" then
		opts.category = "All"
	end
	local results = self.presets.search(query, opts)
	if not opts.category or opts.category == "All" or opts.category == "Custom" or opts.category == "Favorites" then
		local customResults = {}
		local terms = Util.trim(string.lower(query or ""))
		for _, spec in ipairs(self.custom) do
			local include = true
			if opts.favoritesOnly and not self.favorites[spec.id] then
				include = false
			end
			if opts.category == "Favorites" and not self.favorites[spec.id] then
				include = false
			end
			if opts.category == "Custom" and not self:findCustom(spec.id) then
				include = false
			end
			if opts.category ~= "Custom" and opts.category ~= "Favorites" and opts.category ~= "All" then
				include = false
			end
			if include and terms ~= "" then
				local haystack = string.lower(spec.name .. " " .. table.concat(spec.tags or {}, " ") .. " custom")
				if not string.find(haystack, terms, 1, true) then
					include = false
				end
			end
			if include then
				table.insert(customResults, spec)
			end
		end
		for _, spec in ipairs(customResults) do
			table.insert(results, 1, spec)
		end
	end
	return results
end

function Store:categories(): { any }
	local list = {
		{ name = "All", label = "All Effects", count = #self.presets.all + #self.custom },
		{ name = "Favorites", label = "Favourites", count = Util.count(Util.fromSet(self.favorites)) },
		{ name = "Custom", label = "My Presets", count = #self.custom },
	}
	for _, category in ipairs(self.presets.categories) do
		table.insert(list, category)
	end
	return list
end

function Store:destroy()
	self.signals:clear()
end

return Store

files.source:
--[[
	Theme - the single source of truth for VFX Studio's visual language.
	Deep charcoal surfaces, layered blues, one accent colour, generous
	spacing. Everything in the UI reads from here so restyling is one edit.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local Theme = {}

Theme.color = {
	bg0 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 11, 16),
	bg1 = Color3.fromRGB(13, 16, 23),
	bg2 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 32),
	bg3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 29, 41),
	bg4 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 40, 55),
	bg5 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 53, 71),

	line = Color3.fromRGB(38, 47, 63),
	lineSoft = Color3.fromRGB(27, 34, 46),
	lineBright = Color3.fromRGB(58, 71, 94),

	text = Color3.fromRGB(233, 238, 247),
	textDim = Color3.fromRGB(154, 166, 188),
	textMuted = Color3.fromRGB(108, 120, 141),
	textFaint = Color3.fromRGB(79, 89, 107),

	accent = Color3.fromRGB(58, 128, 246),
	accentBright = Color3.fromRGB(104, 169, 255),
	accentDeep = Color3.fromRGB(31, 88, 205),
	accentSoft = Color3.fromRGB(32, 55, 96),

	good = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153),
	goodSoft = Color3.fromRGB(20, 63, 50),
	warn = Color3.fromRGB(250, 190, 68),
	warnSoft = Color3.fromRGB(66, 51, 20),
	bad = Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113),
	badSoft = Color3.fromRGB(68, 30, 33),

	white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	black = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	shadow = Color3.fromRGB(3, 5, 9),
}

Theme.font = {
	display = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
	title = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	bold = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	medium = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	body = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	mono = Enum.Font.Code,
}

Theme.radius = {
	xs = UDim.new(0, 3),
	sm = UDim.new(0, 5),
	md = UDim.new(0, 7),
	lg = UDim.new(0, 10),
	xl = UDim.new(0, 14),
	pill = UDim.new(1, 0),
}

Theme.space = {
	xxs = 2,
	xs = 4,
	sm = 6,
	md = 9,
	lg = 13,
	xl = 18,
	xxl = 26,
}

Theme.text = {
	hero = 21,
	title = 15,
	subtitle = 13,
	body = 12,
	small = 11,
	tiny = 10,
}

function Theme.corner(inst: Instance, radius: UDim?): UICorner
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = radius or Theme.radius.md
	corner.Parent = inst
	return corner
end

function Theme.stroke(inst: Instance, color: Color3?, thickness: number?, transparency: number?): UIStroke
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = color or Theme.color.line
	stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
	stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Parent = inst
	return stroke
end

function Theme.padding(inst: Instance, top: number, right: number?, bottom: number?, left: number?): UIPadding
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, top)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, right or top)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bottom or top)
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, left or right or top)
	padding.Parent = inst
	return padding
end

function Theme.linearGradient(inst: Instance, from: Color3, to: Color3, rotation: number?): UIGradient
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(from, to)
	gradient.Rotation = rotation or 90
	gradient.Parent = inst
	return gradient
end

function Theme.mix(a: Color3, b: Color3, alpha: number): Color3
	return a:Lerp(b, math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1))
end

--- Scales a colour towards black (positive) or white (negative).
function Theme.shade(color: Color3, amount: number): Color3
	if amount >= 0 then
		return color:Lerp(Theme.color.black, math.clamp(amount, 0, 1))
	end
	return color:Lerp(Theme.color.white, math.clamp(-amount, 0, 1))
end

function Theme.surface(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }?): Frame
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	if props then
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			(frame :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	frame.Parent = parent
	return frame
end

function Theme.label(parent: Instance, text: string, props: { [string]: any }?): TextLabel
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Theme.color.text
	label.Font = Theme.font.body
	label.TextSize = Theme.text.body
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.RichText = false
	if props then
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			(label :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

--- Palette used for the generated thumbnail art of a preset.
function Theme.paletteFromKeypoints(colorKeypoints: { any }?): (Color3, Color3)
	if not colorKeypoints or #colorKeypoints == 0 then
		return Theme.color.accent, Theme.color.accentDeep
	end
	local function at(index: number): Color3
		local kp = colorKeypoints[math.clamp(index, 1, #colorKeypoints)]
		if type(kp) == "table" then
			local value = kp[2] or kp.value or kp[1]
			if type(value) == "string" then
				return Util.hex(value)
			end
		elseif type(kp) == "string" then
			return Util.hex(kp)
		end
		return Theme.color.accent
	end
	return at(1), at(#colorKeypoints)
end

return Theme

files.name: Updater
files.source:
--[[
	Updater - release-synced self-update, entirely inside Roblox Studio.

	Flow:
	  1. Ask GitHub for the latest release (falls back to the manifest on the
	     main branch before the first release exists).
	  2. Download `manifest.json`, which carries every module's real source.
	  3. Validate it hard (sizes, classes, paths, top-level folders).
	  4. Hot-swap the running plugin's Core/Presets/UI folders for freshly
	     created ModuleScripts and verify the new App module loads. On any
	     failure the previous folders are restored untouched.
	  5. Offer "Save plugin file" so the update survives a Studio restart:
	     Studio has no API for writing plugin files, so this selects the rebuilt
	     model and opens Studio's own save dialog.

	Studio allows plugin HTTP per-domain; the user is prompted once for
	api.github.com / github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com. HttpEnabled is
	irrelevant to plugins.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

local Version = require(script.Parent.Version)
local Format = require(script.Parent.Format)
local Signals = require(script.Parent.Signals)

local Updater = {}
Updater.__index = Updater

local SETTING_KEY = "VFXStudio.update.v2"
local CONTAINER_FOLDER = "VFXStudio"

function Updater.new(pluginInstance: Plugin, root: Instance?)
	local self = setmetatable({
		plugin = pluginInstance,
		root = root,
		signals = Signals.new(),
		state = "idle",
		info = nil,
		lastError = nil,
		appliedManifest = nil,
		appliedVersion = nil,
		tempHolder = nil,
		cache = {},
	}, Updater)
	self:loadCache()
	return self
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- state + cache
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Updater:setState(state: string, message: string?)
	self.state = state
	self.stateMessage = message
	self.lastError = if state == "error" then message else nil
	self.signals:fire("state", { state = state, message = message })
end

function Updater:loadCache()
	local raw = self.plugin and self.plugin:GetSetting(SETTING_KEY)
	local decoded = Format.jsonDecode(if type(raw) == "string" then raw else nil)
	if type(decoded) == "table" then
		self.cache = decoded
	end
end

function Updater:saveCache()
	local encoded = Format.jsonEncode(self.cache)
	if not encoded or not self.plugin then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		self.plugin:SetSetting(SETTING_KEY, encoded)
	end)
end

function Updater:isAutoCheckEnabled(): boolean
	return self.cache.autoCheck ~= false
end

function Updater:setAutoCheck(enabled: boolean)
	self.cache.autoCheck = enabled == true
	self:saveCache()
	self.signals:fire("state", { state = self.state, message = self.stateMessage })
end

function Updater:shouldAutoCheck(): boolean
	if not self:isAutoCheckEnabled() then
		return false
	end
	local last = tonumber(self.cache.checkedAt) or 0
	return (os.time() - last) >= Version.MIN_CHECK_INTERVAL
end

function Updater:markChecked(version: string)
	self.cache.checkedAt = os.time()
	self.cache.latest = version
	self.cache.installed = Version.VERSION
	self:saveCache()
end

function Updater:installedVersion(): string
	return self.appliedVersion or Version.VERSION
end

function Updater:hasUpdate(): boolean
	return self.info ~= nil and Version.isNewer(self.info.version, self:installedVersion())
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- http
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Updater.explainHttpError(message: string): string
	local lower = string.lower(message)
	if string.find(lower, "not enabled", 1, true) or string.find(lower, "http requests are not", 1, true) then
		return "Studio blocked web requests for this plugin. Open Plugins → Manage Plugins, allow HTTP access for github.com, then retry."
	elseif string.find(lower, "permission", 1, true) or string.find(lower, "denied", 1, true) or string.find(lower, "not permitted", 1, true) then
		return "Studio denied this plugin's web access. Allow it under Plugins → Manage Plugins, then press Check again."
	elseif string.find(lower, "timeout", 1, true) or string.find(lower, "timed out", 1, true) then
		return "GitHub did not respond in time. Check your connection and retry."
	elseif string.find(lower, "not allowed to access", 1, true) then
		return "Studio blocked that domain for plugins. Allow it in Plugin Management and retry."
	end
	return message
end

--- Returns (body, nil) or (nil, message). `notfound` is returned for 404.
function Updater:httpGet(url: string, accept: string?): (string?, string?)
	local ok, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = {
				["User-Agent"] = "VFX-Studio/" .. Version.VERSION,
				["Accept"] = accept or "application/json",
			},
			Timeout = Version.HTTP_TIMEOUT,
		})
	end)
	if not ok then
		return nil, Updater.explainHttpError(tostring(response))
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Studio returned no response for " .. url
	end
	if not response.Success then
		local status = tonumber(response.StatusCode) or 0
		if status == 404 then
			return nil, "notfound"
		elseif status == 403 then
			return nil, "GitHub rate limit reached (60 checks/hour). Try again later."
		elseif status == 0 then
			return nil, "Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and plugin HTTP permissions."
		end
		return nil, string.format("GitHub returned HTTP %d for %s", status, url)
	end
	return response.Body or "", nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- manifest validation / construction
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function splitPath(value: string): { string }
	local list = {}
	for part in string.gmatch(value .. "/", "(.-)/") do
		table.insert(list, part)
	end
	return list
end

local function safeNodeName(value: any): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or #value > 80 then
		return false
	end
	if string.find(value, "[%c]") then
		return false
	end
	if string.find(value, "%.%.") or string.find(value, "[/\\]") then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

--- Hard validation of a downloaded manifest. Returns (true) or (false, message).
function Updater.validateManifest(manifest: any): (boolean, string?)
	if type(manifest) ~= "table" then
		return false, "The manifest is not a JSON object."
	end
	if type(manifest.version) ~= "string" or Version.parse(manifest.version) == nil then
		return false, "The manifest has no valid version."
	end
	if type(manifest.files) ~= "table" then
		return false, "The manifest has no file list."
	end
	local count = #manifest.files
	if count < 1 or count > Version.MAX_FILES then
		return false, string.format("The manifest lists %d files (expected 1-%d).", count, Version.MAX_FILES)
	end

	local total = 0
	local roots: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, file in ipairs(manifest.files) do
		if type(file) ~= "table" then
			return false, "A manifest entry is not an object."
		end
		if type(file.path) ~= "string" or file.path == "" or string.find(file.path, "..", 1, true) then
			return false, "A manifest entry has an unsafe path."
		end
		if file.class ~= "ModuleScript" and file.class ~= "Script" then
			return false, "Unsupported class '" .. tostring(file.class) .. "' in " .. file.path
		end
		if not safeNodeName(file.name) then
			return false, "Unsafe instance name in " .. file.path
		end
		if type(file.source) ~= "string" then
			return false, "Missing source for " .. file.path
		end
		local size = #file.source
		if size > Version.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES then
			return false, "File too large: " .. file.path
		end
		total += size
		local segments = splitPath(file.path)
		if #segments < 1 then
			return false, "Path is empty: " .. file.path
		end
		roots[segments[1]] = true
	end

	if total > Version.MAX_TOTAL_BYTES then
		return false, string.format("The manifest is too large (%.1f MB).", total / (1024 * 1024))
	end
	for _, required in ipairs({ "Core", "Presets", "UI" }) do
		if not roots[required] then
			return false, "The manifest is missing the " .. required .. " folder."
		end
	end
	return true, nil
end

--- Builds a detached Folder tree from a validated manifest.
function Updater.buildTree(manifest: any): Folder
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = CONTAINER_FOLDER

	local folders: { [string]: Folder } = {}
	local function folderAt(segments: { string }): Folder
		local parent = root
		local key = ""
		for _, segment in ipairs(segments) do
			key = key .. "/" .. segment
			local existing = folders[key]
			if not existing then
				existing = Instance.new("Folder")
				existing.Name = segment
				existing.Parent = parent
				folders[key] = existing
			end
			parent = existing
		end
		return parent
	end

	for _, file in ipairs(manifest.files) do
		local segments = splitPath(file.path)
		table.remove(segments)
		local parent = folderAt(segments)
		local instance = Instance.new(file.class)
		instance.Name = file.name
		instance.Source = file.source
		instance.Parent = parent
	end
	return root
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- checking
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function releaseNotes(value: any): string
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return ""
	end
	local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "%s+$", "")
	if #trimmed > 4000 then
		trimmed = string.sub(trimmed, 1, 4000) .. "\n\n..."
	end
	return trimmed
end

local function manifestAssetUrl(release: any): string?
	if type(release.assets) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, asset in ipairs(release.assets) do
		if type(asset) == "table" and asset.name == Version.MANIFEST_ASSET and type(asset.browser_download_url) == "string" then
			return asset.browser_download_url
		end
	end
	return nil
end

--- Checks for a newer build. Yields while requesting. Returns the release info.
function Updater:check(): any?
	if self.state == "checking" or self.state == "downloading" or self.state == "applying" then
		return self.info
	end
	self:setState("checking", "Contacting GitHub...")

	local body, err = self:httpGet(Version.API_URL, "application/vnd.github+json")
	if body then
		local release = Format.jsonDecode(body)
		if type(release) == "table" and (release.tag_name or release.name) then
			local version = Version.clean(release.tag_name or release.name)
			if Version.parse(version) then
				self.info = {
					version = version,
					notes = releaseNotes(release.body),
					url = if type(release.html_url) == "string" then release.html_url else Version.RELEASES_URL,
					publishedAt = release.published_at,
					manifestUrl = manifestAssetUrl(release) or Version.MANIFEST_URL,
					source = "release",
				}
				self:markChecked(version)
				self:setState("idle", nil)
				return self.info
			end
			err = "The latest release tag is not a version number."
		else
			err = "GitHub returned an unexpected release payload."
		end
	end

	-- No releases yet (or the API is blocked): fall back to the manifest that
	-- is published from the main branch.
	self:setState("checking", "No release found - checking the main branch manifest...")
	local fallbackBody, fallbackErr = self:httpGet(Version.FALLBACK_MANIFEST_URL)
	if fallbackBody then
		local manifest = Format.jsonDecode(fallbackBody)
		local valid, problem = Updater.validateManifest(manifest)
		if valid then
			self.info = {
				version = Version.clean(manifest.version),
				notes = "Build from the main branch (no tagged release yet).",
				url = Version.RELEASES_URL,
				publishedAt = manifest.generatedAt,
				manifestUrl = Version.FALLBACK_MANIFEST_URL,
				source = "main",
			}
			self:markChecked(self.info.version)
			self:setState("idle", nil)
			return self.info
		end
		self:setState("error", problem)
		return nil
	end

	local message = err
	if message == nil or message == "notfound" then
		message = "No published builds yet. Tag a commit with v" .. Version.VERSION .. " to publish one."
	end
	if fallbackErr and fallbackErr ~= "notfound" then
		message = tostring(message) .. "\n" .. tostring(fallbackErr)
	end
	self:setState("error", message)
	return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- applying
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Updater:downloadManifest(url: string?): (any?, string?)
	local target = url or (self.info and self.info.manifestUrl)
	if not target then
		return nil, "Check for updates first."
	end
	self:setState("downloading", "Downloading the new build...")
	local body, err = self:httpGet(target)
	if not body then
		self:setState("error", err or "Download failed.")
		return nil, err
	end
	local manifest = Format.jsonDecode(body)
	local valid, problem = Updater.validateManifest(manifest)
	if not valid then
		self:setState("error", problem)
		return nil, problem
	end
	if not Version.isNewer(manifest.version, self:installedVersion()) then
		local message = string.format("The downloaded build (v%s) is not newer than v%s.", Version.clean(manifest.version), self:installedVersion())
		self:setState("error", message)
		return nil, message
	end
	self:setState("downloading", "Downloaded v" .. Version.clean(manifest.version) .. ".")
	return manifest, nil
end

--- Swaps the running plugin's folders for the downloaded sources.
function Updater:apply(manifest: any): (boolean, string?)
	if not self.root then
		return false, "The plugin root folder is unavailable."
	end
	self:setState("applying", "Installing v" .. Version.clean(manifest.version) .. "...")

	local preview = Updater.buildTree(manifest)
	local swapped = {}

	local function rollback()
		for _, item in ipairs(swapped) do
			pcall(function()
				item.new:Destroy()
			end)
			item.old.Name = item.name
		end
		if preview.Parent == nil then
			preview:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _, name in ipairs({ "Core", "Presets", "UI" }) do
		local newFolder = preview:FindFirstChild(name)
		local oldFolder = self.root:FindFirstChild(name)
		if not newFolder then
			rollback()
			return false, "The build is missing the " .. name .. " folder."
		end
		if not oldFolder then
			rollback()
			return false, "The installed plugin is missing the " .. name .. " folder."
		end
		oldFolder.Name = name .. "__previous"
		newFolder.Name = name
		newFolder.Parent = self.root
		table.insert(swapped, { old = oldFolder, new = newFolder, name = name })
	end

	-- Verify the new build actually loads before deleting the old one.
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local ui = self.root:FindFirstChild("UI")
		return require(ui.App)
	end)
	if not ok then
		rollback()
		local message = "The new build failed to load: " .. tostring(err)
		self:setState("error", message)
		return false, message
	end

	for _, item in ipairs(swapped) do
		item.old:Destroy()
	end
	preview:Destroy()

	self.appliedManifest = manifest
	self.appliedVersion = Version.clean(manifest.version)
	self:setState("ready", "Updated to v" .. self.appliedVersion .. ".")
	return true, nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- persistence
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--- Rebuilds the model and opens Studio's save dialog. Studio has no API that
--- writes plugin files directly, so this is the only persistence path.
function Updater:saveToDisk(manifest: any): (boolean, string?)
	local target = manifest or self.appliedManifest
	if not target then
		return false, "Update first, or check for updates."
	end
	if self.tempHolder then
		self:cleanupTemp()
	end

	local tree = Updater.buildTree(target)
	local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
	holder.Name = "VFXStudio Update (delete after saving)"
	tree.Parent = holder
	holder.Parent = ServerStorage
	self.tempHolder = holder

	local previous = Selection:Get()
	Selection:Set({ tree })

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if self.plugin and self.plugin.PromptSaveSelection then
			self.plugin:PromptSaveSelection(Version.MODEL_ASSET)
		elseif self.plugin and self.plugin.SaveSelectedToFile then
			self.plugin:SaveSelectedToFile(Version.MODEL_ASSET)
		else
			error("this Studio build has no save-selection API")
		end
	end)
	Selection:Set(previous)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end
	return true, nil
end

function Updater:cleanupTemp()
	if self.tempHolder then
		pcall(function()
			self.tempHolder:Destroy()
		end)
		self.tempHolder = nil
	end
end

function Updater:destroy()
	self:cleanupTemp()
	self.signals:clear()
end

return Updater

--!strict
--[[
	Util - small, dependency-free helpers shared by every VFX Studio module.
]]

local Util = {}

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local function warnProps(inst: Instance, key: string, err: string)
	warn(("[VFX Studio] could not set %s.%s: %s"):format(inst.ClassName, key, err))
end

--- Creates an instance and applies properties safely, parenting last.
function Util.new(className: string, props: { [string]: any }?, children: { Instance }?): Instance
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	if props then
		local parent = props.Parent
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			if key ~= "Parent" then
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					(inst :: any)[key] = value
				end)
				if not ok then
					warnProps(inst, tostring(key), tostring(err))
				end
			end
		end
		if parent then
			inst.Parent = parent
		end
	end
	if children then
		for _, child in ipairs(children) do
			child.Parent = inst
		end
	end
	return inst
end

--- Applies properties that might not exist on every client version.
function Util.apply(inst: Instance, props: { [string]: any })
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			(inst :: any)[key] = value
		end)
		if not ok then
			warnProps(inst, tostring(key), tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

function Util.hex(value: string): Color3
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	local digits = value:gsub("#", "")
	if #digits == 3 then
		digits = digits:sub(1, 1):rep(2) .. digits:sub(2, 2):rep(2) .. digits:sub(3, 3):rep(2)
	end
	local number = tonumber(digits, 16)
	if not number then
		return Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(
		bit32.band(bit32.rshift(number, 16), 255),
		bit32.band(bit32.rshift(number, 8), 255),
		bit32.band(number, 255)
	)
end

function Util.toHex(color: Color3): string
	local function channel(v: number): string
		local n = math.clamp(math.floor(v * 255 + 0.5), 0, 255)
		return string.format("%02x", n)
	end
	return "#" .. channel(color.R) .. channel(color.G) .. channel(color.B)
end

function Util.clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number
	if value < min then
		return min
	elseif value > max then
		return max
	end
	return value
end

function Util.lerp(a: number, b: number, alpha: number): number
	return a + (b - a) * alpha
end

function Util.round(value: number, decimals: number?): number
	local mult = 10 ^ (decimals or 0)
	return math.floor(value * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

--- Compact number formatting used by sliders / cost readouts.
function Util.pretty(value: number): string
	if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
		return "0"
	end
	local abs = math.abs(value)
	if abs >= 1e6 then
		return string.format("%.1fM", value / 1e6)
	elseif abs >= 1e4 then
		return string.format("%.1fk", value / 1e3)
	elseif abs >= 100 then
		return string.format("%d", math.floor(value + 0.5))
	elseif abs >= 10 then
		return string.format("%.1f", value)
	elseif abs >= 1 then
		return (string.format("%.2f", value):gsub("%.?0+$", ""))
	end
	return (string.format("%.3f", value):gsub("%.?0+$", ""))
end

function Util.deepCopy<T>(value: T): T
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for key, item in pairs(value :: any) do
		if type(key) == "table" then
			copy[Util.deepCopy(key)] = Util.deepCopy(item)
		else
			copy[key] = Util.deepCopy(item)
		end
	end
	return (copy :: any) :: T
end

function Util.deepEqual(a: any, b: any): boolean
	if a == b then
		return true
	end
	if type(a) ~= "table" or type(b) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for key, value in pairs(a) do
		if not Util.deepEqual(value, b[key]) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for key in pairs(b) do
		if a[key] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Util.tween(inst: Instance, props: { [string]: any }, duration: number?, style: Enum.EasingStyle?, direction: Enum.EasingDirection?): Tween
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		duration or 0.15,
		style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	)
	local tweenInstance = TweenService:Create(inst, info, props)
	tweenInstance:Play()
	return tweenInstance
end

function Util.destroyChildren(parent: Instance)
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		child:Destroy()
	end
end

function Util.clear(parent: Instance)
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		child:Destroy()
	end
end

function Util.sortStrings(list: { string })
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a:lower() < b:lower()
	end)
end

function Util.slug(value: string): string
	local slug = string.lower(value):gsub("[^%w]+", "_"):gsub("^_+", ""):gsub("_+$", "")
	return slug
end

function Util.trim(value: string): string
	return (string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
end

function Util.contains(haystack: string, needle: string): boolean
	return string.find(string.lower(haystack), string.lower(needle), 1, true) ~= nil
end

local idCounter = 0
function Util.uuid(prefix: string?): string
	idCounter += 1
	return string.format("%s_%d_%d", prefix or "id", os.time(), idCounter)
end

function Util.descendantOf(inst: Instance, ancestor: Instance): boolean
	local current: Instance? = inst
	while current do
		if current == ancestor then
			return true
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return false
end

function Util.closestAnchor(): Instance?
	local selection = Selection:Get()
	if #selection > 0 then
		return selection[1]
	end
	return nil
end

function Util.formatDuration(seconds: number): string
	if seconds < 1 then
		return string.format("%d ms", math.floor(seconds * 1000 + 0.5))
	end
	return (string.format("%.2fs", seconds):gsub("%.00s", "s"))
end

function Util.toArraySet(list: { string }): { [string]: boolean }
	local set = {}
	for _, value in ipairs(list or {}) do
		set[value] = true
	end
	return set
end

function Util.fromSet(set: { [string]: boolean }): { string }
	local list = {}
	for key, enabled in pairs(set) do
		if enabled then
			table.insert(list, key)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

function Util.count(list: { any }): number
	return #list
end

Util.TweenService = TweenService
Util.Selection = Selection
Util.ContentProvider = ContentProvider

return Util

files.name: Version
files.source:
--[[
	Version - the single source of truth for the plugin version and the
	release endpoints the updater talks to.

	`VERSION` must match package.json; tools/manifest.js fails the build when
	the two disagree, so a release can never ship a stale version number.
]]

local Version = {}

Version.VERSION = "1.0.1"

Version.REPO = "itriedcoding/VFX"
Version.RELEASES_URL = "https://github.com/itriedcoding/VFX/releases"
Version.API_URL = "https://api.github.com/repos/itriedcoding/VFX/releases/latest"

-- Stable URL that always points at the newest published release.
Version.MANIFEST_URL = "https://github.com/itriedcoding/VFX/releases/latest/download/manifest.json"
Version.MODEL_URL = "https://github.com/itriedcoding/VFX/releases/latest/download/VFXStudio.rbxmx"

-- Fallback used until the first GitHub release exists (and as a canary for
-- builds that have landed on main but have not been tagged yet).
Version.FALLBACK_MANIFEST_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itriedcoding/VFX/main/dist/manifest.json"

Version.MANIFEST_ASSET = "manifest.json"
Version.MODEL_ASSET = "VFXStudio.rbxmx"
Version.MIN_CHECK_INTERVAL = 6 * 60 * 60
Version.HTTP_TIMEOUT = 20

Version.MAX_FILES = 400
Version.MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
Version.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 512 * 1024

function Version.clean(value: any): string
	local text = tostring(value or "")
	text = string.gsub(text, "^%s*[vV]%s*", "")
	return (string.gsub(text, "%s+$", ""))
end

--- Parses "1.2.3", "v1.2.3" or "1.2.3-beta.1" into comparable parts.
function Version.parse(value: any): any?
	local text = Version.clean(value)
	if text == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local major, minor, patch, prerelease = string.match(text, "^(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)%-?([%w%.%-]*)$")
	if not major then
		major, minor, patch = string.match(text, "^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
		patch = patch or "0"
		prerelease = ""
	end
	if not major or not minor then
		return nil
	end
	return {
		major = tonumber(major) or 0,
		minor = tonumber(minor) or 0,
		patch = tonumber(patch) or 0,
		prerelease = if prerelease ~= nil and prerelease ~= "" then prerelease else nil,
		raw = text,
	}
end

--- Returns -1, 0 or 1. A prerelease sorts below its final release.
function Version.compare(a: any, b: any): number
	local left = Version.parse(a)
	local right = Version.parse(b)
	if not left or not right then
		return 0
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "major", "minor", "patch" }) do
		if left[key] ~= right[key] then
			return if left[key] > right[key] then 1 else -1
		end
	end
	if left.prerelease and not right.prerelease then
		return -1
	elseif right.prerelease and not left.prerelease then
		return 1
	elseif left.prerelease and right.prerelease then
		if left.prerelease == right.prerelease then
			return 0
		end
		return if left.prerelease > right.prerelease then 1 else -1
	end
	return 0
end

function Version.isNewer(candidate: any, current: any?): boolean
	return Version.compare(candidate, current or Version.VERSION) > 0
end

function Version.display(value: any?): string
	local text = Version.clean(value or Version.VERSION)
	return "v" .. text
end

return Version

files.name: Main
files.source:
--[[
	VFX Studio - plugin entry point.

	Creates the toolbar button and the dock widget, then hands control to the
	App shell. The UI folder is resolved at start time (not captured) so the
	in-Studio updater can replace Core/Presets/UI and the editor can be rebuilt
	against the new modules without restarting Studio.
]]

local TOOLBAR_NAME = "VFX Studio"
local WIDGET_ID = "VFXStudioMain"

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar(TOOLBAR_NAME)
local button = toolbar:CreateButton(
	"VFX Studio",
	"Open the VFX Studio effect editor",
	"rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
)
button.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

local widgetInfo = DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(
	Enum.InitialDockState.Float,
	false,
	false,
	1180,
	780,
	860,
	560
)
local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui(WIDGET_ID, widgetInfo)
widget.Title = "VFX Studio"
widget.Name = "VFX Studio"
widget.Enabled = false

local app = nil

local function showFatalError(message: string)
	pcall(function()
		for _, child in ipairs(widget:GetChildren()) do
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 11, 16)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = widget

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 24)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 18
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Text = "VFX Studio could not start"
	title.Parent = frame

	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 58)
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, -90)
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	body.TextSize = 13
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(233, 238, 247)
	body.Text = message
	body.Parent = frame
end

-- Re-resolved on every (re)start so a hot update is picked up.
local function resolveUI(): Instance?
	return script.Parent and script.Parent:FindFirstChild("UI")
end

local buildApp

local function restart()
	if app then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			app:destroy()
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] previous editor failed to shut down cleanly")
		end
		app = nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(buildApp)
	if ok then
		app = result
	else
		warn("[VFX Studio] rebuild after update failed: " .. tostring(result))
		showFatalError("The updated editor failed to start.\n\n" .. tostring(result) .. "\n\nReplace the plugin file with the previous version, or open the Output window for the traceback.")
	end
end

buildApp = function()
	local ui = resolveUI()
	if not ui then
		error("the UI folder is missing from the plugin")
	end
	local App = require(ui.App)
	return App.new(plugin, widget, script.Parent, restart)
end

local function ensureApp(): boolean
	if app then
		return true
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(buildApp)
	if not ok then
		warn("[VFX Studio] startup failed: " .. tostring(result))
		showFatalError(tostring(result) .. "\n\nOpen the Output window for the full traceback.")
		return false
	end
	app = result
	return true
end

local function toggle()
	if not ensureApp() then
		widget.Enabled = true
		return
	end
	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled
	button:SetActive(widget.Enabled)
end

button.Click:Connect(toggle)

widget:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
	button:SetActive(widget.Enabled)
end)

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	if app then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			app:destroy()
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] cleanup error: " .. tostring(err))
		end
		app = nil
	end
end)

-- Studio remembers whether the widget was open; do not force it open on load.
if widget.Enabled then
	ensureApp()
end

warn("[VFX Studio] loaded. Click the VFX Studio button in the Plugins tab to open the editor.")

files.name: Presets
files.source:
--[[
	Presets - the indexed, validated preset library.

	Every category file returns an array of specs built with the DSL. This
	module assigns stable ids, builds search indexes and validates the whole
	library at load time so a malformed preset can never reach the viewport.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Core.Util)
local DSL = require(script.DSL)

local Presets = {}

Presets.order = {
	"Explosions",
	"Fire",
	"Smoke",
	"Lightning",
	"Magic",
	"Auras",
	"Trails",
	"Particles",
	"Impacts",
	"Weapons",
	"Portals",
	"Weather",
	"Energy",
	"Environmental",
}

local modules = {
	Explosions = script.Explosions,
	Fire = script.Fire,
	Smoke = script.Smoke,
	Lightning = script.Lightning,
	Magic = script.Magic,
	Auras = script.Auras,
	Trails = script.Trails,
	Particles = script.Particles,
	Impacts = script.Impacts,
	Weapons = script.Weapons,
	Portals = script.Portals,
	Weather = script.Weather,
	Energy = script.Energy,
	Environmental = script.Environmental,
}

Presets.all = {}
Presets.byId = {}
Presets.byCategory = {}
Presets.categories = {}
Presets.tags = {}
Presets.errors = {}

local function describe(spec: any): string
	local emitters, beams, trails, lights, parts = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			emitters += 1
		elseif comp.kind == "beam" then
			beams += 1
		elseif comp.kind == "trail" then
			trails += 1
		elseif comp.kind == "light" then
			lights += 1
		elseif comp.kind == "part" then
			parts += 1
		end
	end
	local bits = {}
	local function push(count: number, singular: string, plural: string)
		if count > 0 then
			table.insert(bits, tostring(count) .. " " .. if count == 1 then singular else plural)
		end
	end
	push(emitters, "particle system", "particle systems")
	push(beams, "beam", "beams")
	push(trails, "trail", "trails")
	push(lights, "light", "lights")
	push(parts, "mesh part", "mesh parts")
	if #bits == 0 then
		table.insert(bits, "no geometry")
	end
	return string.format(
		"%s preset running %s over %s.",
		spec.category,
		table.concat(bits, ", "),
		Util.formatDuration(spec.duration)
	)
end

--- Structural validation. Returns a flat list of human-readable problems.
function Presets.validate(spec: any, id: string?): { string }
	local problems = {}
	local label = id or tostring(spec and spec.name)

	local function fail(message: string)
		table.insert(problems, label .. ": " .. message)
	end

	if type(spec) ~= "table" then
		table.insert(problems, tostring(id) .. ": preset is not a table")
		return problems
	end
	if type(spec.name) ~= "string" or Util.trim(spec.name) == "" then
		fail("missing name")
	end
	if type(spec.category) ~= "string" or not table.find(Presets.order, spec.category) then
		fail("unknown category " .. tostring(spec.category))
	end
	if type(spec.duration) ~= "number" or spec.duration <= 0 or spec.duration > 60 then
		fail("duration must be between 0 and 60 seconds")
	end
	if type(spec.components) ~= "table" or #spec.components == 0 then
		fail("has no components")
		return problems
	end

	local seenNames = {}
	for index, comp in ipairs(spec.components) do
		local where = "component " .. index
		if type(comp) ~= "table" then
			fail(where .. " is not a table")
			continue
		end
		if type(comp.name) ~= "string" or Util.trim(comp.name) == "" then
			fail(where .. " has no name")
		elseif seenNames[comp.name] then
			fail("duplicate component name '" .. comp.name .. "'")
		else
			seenNames[comp.name] = true
		end
		if not table.find({ "particle", "beam", "trail", "light", "part", "tween" }, comp.kind) then
			fail(where .. " has unknown kind " .. tostring(comp.kind))
			continue
		end
		if type(comp.startTime) ~= "number" or comp.startTime < 0 then
			fail(where .. " has a negative startTime")
		end
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			if type(comp.rate) ~= "number" or comp.rate < 0 then
				fail(where .. " has an invalid rate")
			end
			local lifetime = comp.lifetime
			if type(lifetime) ~= "table" or #lifetime ~= 2 or (lifetime :: any)[1] <= 0 or (lifetime :: any)[2] < (lifetime :: any)[1] then
				fail(where .. " has an invalid lifetime range")
			end
			local speed = comp.speed
			if type(speed) ~= "table" or #speed ~= 2 or (speed :: any)[2] < (speed :: any)[1] then
				fail(where .. " has an invalid speed range")
			end
			if type(comp.texture) ~= "string" or comp.texture == "" then
				fail(where .. " has no texture")
			end
			if (comp.rate > 0 or comp.burst > 0) and comp.duration <= 0 then
				fail(where .. " cannot emit with a zero duration")
			end
		end
		if comp.kind == "light" then
			if type(comp.range) ~= "number" or comp.range <= 0 then
				fail(where .. " has an invalid light range")
			end
		end
		if comp.kind == "tween" then
			if not table.find({ "spin", "float", "brightness", "transparency", "scale", "color" }, comp.property) then
				fail(where .. " has unknown tween property " .. tostring(comp.property))
			end
		end
	end
	return problems
end

-- Build the index.
for _, categoryName in ipairs(Presets.order) do
	local moduleScript = modules[categoryName]
	local specs = {}
	if not moduleScript then
		table.insert(Presets.errors, "missing category module: " .. categoryName)
	else
		local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			specs = result
		else
			table.insert(Presets.errors, "category '" .. categoryName .. "' failed to load: " .. tostring(result))
		end
	end

	local bucket = {}
	Presets.byCategory[categoryName] = bucket

	for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do
		local id = Util.slug(categoryName) .. "_" .. Util.slug(spec.name)
		if Presets.byId[id] then
			local suffix = 2
			while Presets.byId[id .. "_" .. suffix] do
				suffix += 1
			end
			id = id .. "_" .. suffix
		end
		spec.id = id
		spec.category = categoryName
		spec.tags = spec.tags or {}
		spec.description = spec.hint or describe(spec)

		local problems = Presets.validate(spec, id)
		for _, problem in ipairs(problems) do
			table.insert(Presets.errors, problem)
		end

		table.insert(bucket, spec)
		table.insert(Presets.all, spec)
		Presets.byId[id] = spec

		for _, tag in ipairs(spec.tags) do
			Presets.tags[tag] = (Presets.tags[tag] or 0) + 1
		end
	end

	local displayNames = {
		Explosions = "Explosions",
		Fire = "Fire",
		Smoke = "Smoke & Fog",
		Lightning = "Lightning",
		Magic = "Magic",
		Auras = "Auras",
		Trails = "Trails",
		Particles = "Particles",
		Impacts = "Impacts",
		Weapons = "Weapons",
		Portals = "Portals",
		Weather = "Weather",
		Energy = "Energy",
		Environmental = "Environmental",
	}
	table.insert(Presets.categories, {
		name = categoryName,
		label = displayNames[categoryName] or categoryName,
		count = #bucket,
	})
end

Presets.tagList = Util.fromSet(Presets.tags)

if #Presets.errors > 0 then
	warn("[VFX Studio] preset validation found " .. #Presets.errors .. " issue(s):")
	for _, problem in ipairs(Presets.errors) do
		warn("  - " .. problem)
	end
end

function Presets.get(id: string): any?
	return Presets.byId[id]
end

function Presets.count(): number
	return #Presets.all
end

local function scoreMatch(spec: any, query: string): number
	local name = string.lower(spec.name)
	if string.sub(name, 1, #query) == query then
		return 3
	elseif string.find(name, query, 1, true) then
		return 2
	end
	for _, tag in ipairs(spec.tags) do
		if string.find(string.lower(tag), query, 1, true) then
			return 1
		end
	end
	return 0
end

--- Search + filter. `options`: { category, favorites, favoritesOnly, tags, sort }
function Presets.search(query: string?, options: any?): { any }
	local opts = options or {}
	local favorites = opts.favorites or {}
	local terms = Util.trim(string.lower(query or ""))
	local results = {}

	for _, spec in ipairs(Presets.all) do
		local include = true
		if opts.category and opts.category ~= "All" and spec.category ~= opts.category then
			include = false
		end
		if include and opts.favoritesOnly and not favorites[spec.id] then
			include = false
		end
		if include and opts.tag and opts.tag ~= "" then
			local hasTag = false
			for _, tag in ipairs(spec.tags) do
				if tag == opts.tag then
					hasTag = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not hasTag then
				include = false
			end
		end
		if include and terms ~= "" then
			local haystack = string.lower(
				spec.name .. " " .. spec.category .. " " .. table.concat(spec.tags, " ") .. " " .. spec.description
			)
			if not string.find(haystack, terms, 1, true) then
				include = false
			end
		end
		if include then
			table.insert(results, spec)
		end
	end

	table.sort(results, function(a, b)
		local favoriteA = favorites[a.id] and 1 or 0
		local favoriteB = favorites[b.id] and 1 or 0
		if favoriteA ~= favoriteB then
			return favoriteA > favoriteB
		end
		local scoreA = scoreMatch(a, terms)
		local scoreB = scoreMatch(b, terms)
		if scoreA ~= scoreB then
			return scoreA > scoreB
		end
		if a.category ~= b.category then
			return (table.find(Presets.order, a.category) or 99) < (table.find(Presets.order, b.category) or 99)
		end
		return string.lower(a.name) < string.lower(b.name)
	end)

	return results
end

return Presets

DSL
files.source:
--[[
	DSL - the authoring layer used by the preset library.

	Presets are written as compact component builders (`P{ ... }`) and this
	module expands them into the canonical, fully-populated spec format the
	editor and compiler understand. Every field is always present, which is
	what lets the properties panel render any component generically.

	Stored values stay JSON-safe: colours are "#rrggbb" strings, sequences are
	`{ {time, value}, ... }` arrays, ranges are `{min, max}`.
]]

local Assets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Assets)

local DSL = {}

local function clamp01(value: number): number
	if value ~= value then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
end

local function number(value: any, fallback: number): number
	local parsed = tonumber(value)
	if parsed == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	return parsed
end

--- Colour list -> keypoints. Accepts "#fff", {"#fff","#f00"}, {{0,"#fff"}}.
local function colorKeypoints(color: any): { any }
	if type(color) == "string" then
		return { { 0, color }, { 1, color } }
	end
	if type(color) ~= "table" or #color == 0 then
		return { { 0, "#ffffff" }, { 1, "#ffffff" } }
	end
	local points = {}
	for index, value in ipairs(color) do
		if type(value) == "table" then
			table.insert(points, { clamp01(number(value[1], 0)), tostring(value[2] or "#ffffff") })
		elseif type(value) == "string" then
			local time = if #color == 1 then 0 else (index - 1) / (#color - 1)
			table.insert(points, { time, value })
		elseif type(value) == "number" then
			-- Single channel grey shorthand: 0..1 -> hex.
			local c = math.floor(clamp01(value) * 255 + 0.5)
			local hex = string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", c, c, c)
			local time = if #color == 1 then 0 else (index - 1) / (#color - 1)
			table.insert(points, { time, hex })
		end
	end
	if #points == 0 then
		return { { 0, "#ffffff" }, { 1, "#ffffff" } }
	elseif #points == 1 then
		table.insert(points, { 1, points[1][2] })
	end
	return points
end

--- Numbers -> keypoints. `{0.5, 2}` means "grow from 0.5 to 2".
local function numberKeypoints(values: any, fallback: { any }): { any }
	if type(values) == "number" then
		return { { 0, values }, { 1, values } }
	end
	if type(values) ~= "table" or #values == 0 then
		return fallback
	end
	local points = {}
	for index, value in ipairs(values) do
		if type(value) == "table" then
			table.insert(points, { clamp01(number(value[1], 0)), math.max(0, number(value[2], 0)) })
		else
			local time = if #values == 1 then 0 else (index - 1) / (#values - 1)
			table.insert(points, { time, math.max(0, number(value, 0)) })
		end
	end
	if #points == 1 then
		table.insert(points, { 1, points[1][2] })
	end
	return points
end

local function range(values: any, fallbackMin: number, fallbackMax: number): { number }
	if type(values) == "number" then
		return { values, values }
	end
	if type(values) ~= "table" then
		return { fallbackMin, fallbackMax }
	end
	local min = number(values[1], fallbackMin)
	local max = number(values[2], min)
	if max < min then
		min, max = max, min
	end
	return { min, max }
end

local function vec3(values: any, fallbackY: number?): { number }
	if type(values) == "number" then
		return { values, values, values }
	end
	if type(values) ~= "table" then
		return { 0, fallbackY or 0, 0 }
	end
	return { number(values[1], 0), number(values[2], fallbackY or 0), number(values[3], 0) }
end

local function vec2(values: any, fallbackY: number?): { number }
	if type(values) == "number" then
		return { values, values }
	end
	if type(values) ~= "table" then
		return { 0, fallbackY or 0 }
	end
	return { number(values[1], 0), number(values[2], fallbackY or 0) }
end

--- Maps author-friendly short keys onto canonical spec field names.
local KEY_ALIASES = {
	tex = "texture",
	col = "color",
	colours = "color",
	colors = "color",
	trn = "transparency",
	alpha = "transparency",
	sz = "size",
	life = "lifetime",
	spd = "speed",
	sprd = "spread",
	rot = "rotation",
	rotspd = "rotSpeed",
	accel = "acceleration",
	le = "lightEmission",
	li = "lightInfluence",
	off = "offset",
	off0 = "offset0",
	off1 = "offset1",
	at = "startTime",
	dur = "duration",
	z = "zOffset",
	fb = "flipbookLayout",
	fbr = "flipbookFramerate",
	fbrnd = "flipbookRandom",
	locked = "lockedToPart",
	inherit = "velocityInheritance",
	ts = "timeScale",
	io = "shapeInOut",
	partial = "shapePartial",
	dir = "emissionDirection",
	style = "shapeStyle",
	orient = "orientation",
	wind = "windAffectsDrag",
	reps = "repeats",
	shadows = "shadows",
	bright = "brightness",
	curve = "curveSize0",
	curve1 = "curveSize1",
	texlen = "textureLength",
	texspd = "textureSpeed",
	seg = "segments",
	w0 = "width0",
	w1 = "width1",
	mat = "material",
};

local function expand(opts: { [string]: any }): { [string]: any }
	local out = {}
	for key, value in pairs(opts) do
		local canonical = KEY_ALIASES[key] or key
		out[canonical] = value
	end
	return out
end

local PARTICLE_DEFAULTS = {
	kind = "particle",
	name = "Particles",
	offset = { 0, 0, 0 },
	startTime = 0,
	duration = 1,
	texture = "sparkle",
	color = { { 0, "#ffffff" }, { 1, "#ffffff" } },
	transparency = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 1 } },
	size = { { 0, 1 }, { 1, 0 } },
	lifetime = { 0.5, 1 },
	speed = { 4, 8 },
	spread = { 0, 0 },
	rotation = { 0, 0 },
	rotSpeed = { 0, 0 },
	drag = 0,
	acceleration = { 0, 0, 0 },
	rate = 20,
	burst = 0,
	repeats = 1,
	lightEmission = 0.5,
	lightInfluence = 0.2,
	shape = "Sphere",
	shapeStyle = "Volume",
	shapeInOut = "Outward",
	shapePartial = 1,
	emissionDirection = "Top",
	zOffset = 0,
	squash = 0,
	windAffectsDrag = false,
	orientation = "FacingCamera",
	flipbookLayout = "None",
	flipbookFramerate = { 30, 30 },
	flipbookRandom = true,
	lockedToPart = false,
	velocityInheritance = 0,
	timeScale = 1,
};

local BEAM_DEFAULTS = {
	kind = "beam",
	name = "Beam",
	offset0 = { 0, 0, 0 },
	offset1 = { 0, 1, 0 },
	startTime = 0,
	duration = 1,
	texture = "glow",
	color = { { 0, "#ffffff" }, { 1, "#ffffff" } },
	transparency = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 } },
	width0 = 0.4,
	width1 = 0.4,
	curveSize0 = 0,
	curveSize1 = 0,
	segments = 10,
	brightness = 1,
	lightEmission = 1,
	lightInfluence = 0,
	textureLength = 0.5,
	textureSpeed = 0,
	textureMode = "Stretch",
	faceCamera = true,
	zOffset = 0,
};

local TRAIL_DEFAULTS = {
	kind = "trail",
	name = "Trail",
	offset0 = { 0, 0.4, 0 },
	offset1 = { 0, -0.4, 0 },
	startTime = 0,
	duration = 1,
	texture = "glow",
	color = { { 0, "#ffffff" }, { 1, "#ffffff" } },
	transparency = { { 0, 0.1 }, { 1, 1 } },
	lifetime = 0.5,
	minLength = 0.1,
	widthScale = 1,
	faceCamera = true,
	lightEmission = 0.6,
};

local LIGHT_DEFAULTS = {
	kind = "light",
	name = "Light",
	offset = { 0, 0, 0 },
	startTime = 0,
	duration = 1,
	color = "#ffffff",
	brightness = 2,
	range = 16,
	shadows = false,
};

local PART_DEFAULTS = {
	kind = "part",
	name = "Mesh",
	offset = { 0, 0, 0 },
	startTime = 0,
	duration = 1,
	size = { 1, 1, 1 },
	color = "#ffffff",
	transparency = 0.2,
	material = "Neon",
	shape = "Ball",
	rotation = { 0, 0, 0 },
	spin = { 0, 0, 0 },
	float = 0,
	texture = "",
};

local TWEEN_DEFAULTS = {
	kind = "tween",
	name = "Animation",
	target = "rig",
	property = "spin",
	from = 0,
	to = 360,
	startTime = 0,
	duration = 1,
	easing = "Quad",
	direction = "Out",
	repeatCount = 0,
	reverse = false,
};

local function merge(defaults: { [string]: any }, opts: { [string]: any }): { [string]: any }
	local merged = {}
	for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	for key, value in pairs(opts) do
		merged[key] = value
	end
	return merged
end

--- Particle emitter component.
function DSL.P(opts: { [string]: any })
	local raw = expand(opts or {})
	local comp = merge(PARTICLE_DEFAULTS, raw)
	comp.kind = "particle"
	comp.texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture)
	comp.color = colorKeypoints(comp.color)
	comp.transparency = numberKeypoints(comp.transparency, { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 1 } })
	comp.size = numberKeypoints(comp.size, { { 0, 1 }, { 1, 0 } })
	comp.lifetime = range(comp.lifetime, 0.5, 1)
	comp.speed = range(comp.speed, 0, 0)
	comp.spread = vec2(comp.spread, 0)
	comp.rotation = range(comp.rotation, 0, 0)
	comp.rotSpeed = range(comp.rotSpeed, 0, 0)
	comp.acceleration = vec3(comp.acceleration, 0)
	comp.offset = vec3(comp.offset, 0)
	comp.rate = math.max(0, number(comp.rate, 0))
	comp.burst = math.max(0, number(comp.burst, 0))
	comp.repeats = math.max(1, math.floor(number(comp.repeats, 1)))
	comp.lightEmission = clamp01(number(comp.lightEmission, 0))
	comp.lightInfluence = clamp01(number(comp.lightInfluence, 0))
	comp.shapePartial = clamp01(number(comp.shapePartial, 1))
	comp.squash = clamp01(number(comp.squash, 0))
	comp.velocityInheritance = clamp01(number(comp.velocityInheritance, 0))
	comp.flipbookFramerate = range(comp.flipbookFramerate, 30, 30)
	comp.zOffset = number(comp.zOffset, 0)
	comp.startTime = math.max(0, number(comp.startTime, 0))
	comp.duration = math.max(0, number(comp.duration, 0))
	comp.drag = math.max(0, number(comp.drag, 0))
	comp.timeScale = math.max(0.05, number(comp.timeScale, 1))
	return comp
end

function DSL.B(opts: { [string]: any })
	local comp = merge(BEAM_DEFAULTS, expand(opts or {}))
	comp.kind = "beam"
	comp.texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture)
	comp.color = colorKeypoints(comp.color)
	comp.transparency = numberKeypoints(comp.transparency, { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 } })
	comp.offset0 = vec3(comp.offset0, 0)
	comp.offset1 = vec3(comp.offset1, 1)
	comp.width0 = math.max(0, number(comp.width0, 0.4))
	comp.width1 = math.max(0, number(comp.width1, 0.4))
	comp.curveSize0 = math.clamp(number(comp.curveSize0, 0), -5, 5)
	comp.curveSize1 = math.clamp(number(comp.curveSize1, 0), -5, 5)
	comp.segments = math.clamp(math.floor(number(comp.segments, 10)), 1, 100)
	comp.brightness = math.max(0, number(comp.brightness, 1))
	comp.lightEmission = clamp01(number(comp.lightEmission, 1))
	comp.lightInfluence = clamp01(number(comp.lightInfluence, 0))
	comp.textureLength = math.max(0.01, number(comp.textureLength, 0.5))
	comp.textureSpeed = number(comp.textureSpeed, 0)
	comp.zOffset = number(comp.zOffset, 0)
	comp.startTime = math.max(0, number(comp.startTime, 0))
	comp.duration = math.max(0, number(comp.duration, 0))
	return comp
end

function DSL.T(opts: { [string]: any })
	local comp = merge(TRAIL_DEFAULTS, expand(opts or {}))
	comp.kind = "trail"
	comp.texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture)
	comp.color = colorKeypoints(comp.color)
	comp.transparency = numberKeypoints(comp.transparency, { { 0, 0.1 }, { 1, 1 } })
	comp.offset0 = vec3(comp.offset0, 0.4)
	comp.offset1 = vec3(comp.offset1, -0.4)
	comp.lifetime = math.clamp(number(comp.lifetime, 0.5), 0, 10)
	comp.minLength = math.max(0, number(comp.minLength, 0.1))
	comp.widthScale = math.max(0, number(comp.widthScale, 1))
	comp.lightEmission = clamp01(number(comp.lightEmission, 0.6))
	comp.startTime = math.max(0, number(comp.startTime, 0))
	comp.duration = math.max(0, number(comp.duration, 0))
	return comp
end

function DSL.L(opts: { [string]: any })
	local comp = merge(LIGHT_DEFAULTS, expand(opts or {}))
	comp.kind = "light"
	comp.offset = vec3(comp.offset, 0)
	comp.brightness = math.max(0, number(comp.brightness, 2))
	comp.range = math.max(0, number(comp.range, 16))
	comp.startTime = math.max(0, number(comp.startTime, 0))
	comp.duration = math.max(0, number(comp.duration, 0))
	return comp
end

function DSL.M(opts: { [string]: any })
	local comp = merge(PART_DEFAULTS, expand(opts or {}))
	-- Mesh-part components reuse the `size` key as a vector, not a sequence.
	comp.kind = "part"
	comp.offset = vec3(comp.offset, 0)
	comp.size = vec3(comp.size, 1)
	comp.rotation = vec3(comp.rotation, 0)
	comp.spin = vec3(comp.spin, 0)
	comp.transparency = math.clamp(number(comp.transparency, 0.2), 0, 1)
	comp.float = number(comp.float, 0)
	comp.startTime = math.max(0, number(comp.startTime, 0))
	comp.duration = math.max(0, number(comp.duration, 0))
	return comp
end

function DSL.A(opts: { [string]: any })
	local comp = merge(TWEEN_DEFAULTS, expand(opts or {}))
	comp.kind = "tween"
	comp.from = number(comp.from, 0)
	comp.to = number(comp.to, 1)
	comp.startTime = math.max(0, number(comp.startTime, 0))
	comp.duration = math.max(0.05, number(comp.duration, 1))
	comp.repeatCount = math.floor(number(comp.repeatCount, 0))
	return comp
end

--- Component names must be unique inside a preset: they are the instance
--- names, the inspector keys and what motion tracks target. Presets that use
--- several emitters without naming them would all be called "Particles", so
--- the surplus ones get a numeric suffix. A tween that targeted the original
--- name keeps pointing at the first component of that name, which is the only
--- component it could have meant before the rename existed.
local function uniqueNames(list: { any }): { any }
	local used = {}
	for _, comp in ipairs(list) do
		local base = tostring(comp.name or comp.kind or "Component")
		if used[base] then
			local index = 2
			while used[base .. " " .. index] do
				index += 1
			end
			comp.name = base .. " " .. index
			used[comp.name] = true
		else
			used[base] = true
		end
	end
	return list
end

--- Declares a preset. `extra` supports { loop, hint }.
function DSL.preset(name: string, category: string, tags: { string }?, duration: any, components: { any }?, extra: any?)
	local list = components
	if type(duration) == "table" then
		-- preset(name, category, tags, components, extra)
		list = duration
		duration = nil
	end
	return {
		name = name,
		category = category,
		tags = tags or {},
		duration = math.max(0.1, number(duration, 1.5)),
		loop = type(extra) == "table" and extra.loop == true,
		hint = type(extra) == "table" and extra.hint or nil,
		components = uniqueNames(list or {}),
	}
end

DSL.helpers = {
	colorKeypoints = colorKeypoints,
	numberKeypoints = numberKeypoints,
	range = range,
	vec3 = vec3,
	vec2 = vec2,
}

return DSL

	energy, with a spin track so the ring reads as rotating geometry.

local function gate(colors: { string }, radius: number, discColor: string, extra: any?): { any }
	local options = extra or {}
	local comps = {
		M { name = "Surface", col = discColor, transparency = 0.55, size = { radius * 2, 0.15, radius * 2 }, material = "Neon", dur = options.duration or 3 },
		P { name = "Rim", tex = "glow", col = colors, trn = { 0.2, 0.75, 1 }, sz = { 0.5, 1.6 }, life = { 0.8, 1.6 }, spd = { 1, 3 }, sprd = { 4, 4 }, shape = "Cylinder", style = "Surface", partial = 0.3, rate = 70, radius = radius, light = 1.4, off = { 0, 0.2, 0 }, dur = options.duration or 3 },
		P { name = "Motes", tex = "sparkle", col = colors, trn = { 0.2, 0.8, 1 }, sz = { 0.06, 0.25 }, life = { 1, 2.2 }, spd = { 0.5, 2.5 }, sprd = { 180, 180 }, rate = 24, accel = { 0, 2, 0 }, light = 1.2, dur = options.duration or 3 },
		A { name = "GateSpin", target = "rig", property = "spin", from = 0, to = 360, dur = options.spin or 4, easing = "Linear" },
		L { name = "GateLight", col = options.lightColor or colors[#colors], bright = 3, range = 16, dur = options.duration or 3 },
	}
	return comps
end

--[[
	Trails - 24 ribbon effects. Every trail includes a motion track so the two
	attachments sweep through space and the ribbon actually renders; in game
	the trail follows whatever the rig is welded to.
]]

local DSL = require(script.Parent.DSL)

local P, B, T, L, M, A = DSL.P, DSL.B, DSL.T, DSL.L, DSL.M, DSL.A

local function preset(name: string, tags: { string }, duration: number, components: { any }, extra: any?)
	return DSL.preset(name, "Trails", tags, duration, components, extra)
end

local function ribbon(colors: { string }, width: number, light: number, extra: any?)
	local spec = {
		tex = "glow",
		col = colors,
		trn = { 0, 0.35, 1 },
		lifetime = 0.5,
		minLength = 0.1,
		widthScale = width,
		light = light,
		off0 = { 0, 0.3, 0 },
		off1 = { 0, -0.3, 0 },
		dur = 1,
	}
	for key, value in pairs(extra or {}) do
		spec[key] = value
	end
	return T(spec)
end
