--[[
	App - the editor shell.

	Owns the layout (resizable library / stage / inspector), the toolbar, the
	toast stack, modals, keyboard shortcuts and the heartbeat that drives the
	playhead. Panels are created defensively so a failure in one never takes
	the whole plugin down.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Assets)
local Store = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Store)
local Presets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Presets)
local Decompiler = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Decompiler)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)
local Library = require(script.Parent.Library)
local Preview = require(script.Parent.Preview)
local Timeline = require(script.Parent.Timeline)
local Inspector = require(script.Parent.Inspector)
local AssetsPanel = require(script.Parent.AssetsPanel)
local ExportDialog = require(script.Parent.ExportDialog)
local UpdateDialog = require(script.Parent.UpdateDialog)
local Version = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Version)
local Updater = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Updater)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local App = {}
App.__index = App

local TOP_HEIGHT = 48
local STATUS_HEIGHT = 22
local TIMELINE_HEIGHT = 172
local MIN_LEFT = 230
local MAX_LEFT = 400
local MIN_RIGHT = 280
local MAX_RIGHT = 440

function App.new(pluginInstance: Plugin, widget: DockWidgetPluginGui, pluginRoot: Instance?, onRestart: (() -> ())?)
	local self = setmetatable({}, App)
	self.plugin = pluginInstance
	self.widget = widget
	self.pluginRoot = pluginRoot or script.Parent.Parent
	self.onRestart = onRestart
	self.connections = {}
	self.leftEnabled = true
	self.rightEnabled = true
	self.leftWidth = 286
	self.rightWidth = 322

	local store = Store.new(pluginInstance, Presets)
	Assets.setCustom(store:getPref("customAssets", {}))
	store.prefs.background = store:getPref("background", "studio")
	self.store = store
	self.updater = Updater.new(pluginInstance, self.pluginRoot)

	Kit.setOverlay(nil)

	local root = Kit.frame(widget, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	self.root = root
	Kit.setOverlay(root)

	self.toastLayer = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -312, 1, -STATUS_HEIGHT - 8),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
		ZIndex = 60,
	})
	self.toastLayer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	local toastLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	toastLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	toastLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	toastLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	toastLayout.Parent = self.toastLayer

	local ctx = {
		plugin = pluginInstance,
		store = store,
		presets = Presets,
		toast = function(message: string, kind: string?)
			self:toast(message, kind)
		end,
		closeModal = function()
			self:closeModal()
		end,
		openPanel = function(name: string)
			if self.inspector then
				self.inspector:showTab(name)
			end
		end,
		openAssetPicker = function(callback: (string) -> ())
			self:openAssetPicker(callback)
		end,
		promptSavePreset = function()
			self:promptSavePreset()
		end,
		importSelection = function()
			self:importSelection()
		end,
		reloadPreset = function()
			self:reloadPreset()
		end,
	}
	self.ctx = ctx
	ctx.updater = self.updater
	ctx.onUpdated = onRestart
	ctx.openUpdates = function()
		self:openUpdateDialog()
	end

	-- Top bar -----------------------------------------------------------------
	local topBar = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TOP_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.topBar = topBar
	Theme.stroke(topBar, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.35)

	local logo = Kit.frame(topBar, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 11),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.accent,
	})
	Theme.corner(logo, Theme.radius.sm)
	Kit.label(logo, "\u{273b}", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.white,
		TextSize = 15,
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
	})
	local logoGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	logoGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Theme.color.accentBright, Theme.color.accentDeep)
	logoGradient.Rotation = 130
	logoGradient.Parent = logo

	Kit.label(topBar, "VFX Studio", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 8),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 18),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.title,
	})
	Kit.caption(topBar, "Roblox visual effects editor", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 26),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 12),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	self.leftToggle = Kit.iconButton(topBar, "\u{25a4}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Toggle the preset library",
		onClick = function()
			self.leftEnabled = not self.leftEnabled
			self:refreshLayout()
		end,
	})
	self.leftToggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(206, 11)

	self.rightToggle = Kit.iconButton(topBar, "\u{25a5}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Toggle the inspector",
		onClick = function()
			self.rightEnabled = not self.rightEnabled
			self:refreshLayout()
		end,
	})
	self.rightToggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(236, 11)

	local rightGroup = Kit.hlist(topBar, 6, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 10),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	})
	rightGroup.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	rightGroup.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28)
	rightGroup.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	rightGroup.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 10)

	self.undoButton = Kit.iconButton(rightGroup, "\u{21b6}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
		tooltip = "Undo  (Ctrl+Z)",
		onClick = function()
			self.store:undo()
		end,
	})
	self.redoButton = Kit.iconButton(rightGroup, "\u{21b7}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
		tooltip = "Redo  (Ctrl+Y)",
		onClick = function()
			self.store:redo()
		end,
	})

	Kit.button(rightGroup, "Import", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 28,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 28),
		tooltip = "Import the selected instance",
		onClick = function()
			self:importSelection()
		end,
	})
	self.assetsButton = Kit.button(rightGroup, "Assets", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 28,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 28),
		onClick = function()
			self:openAssetPicker(nil)
		end,
	})
	self.exportButton = Kit.button(rightGroup, "Export", {
		variant = "primary",
		height = 28,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 28),
		onClick = function()
			self:openExportDialog()
		end,
	})
	self.versionButton = Kit.button(rightGroup, Version.display(Version.VERSION), {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 28,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 28),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		tooltip = "Installed version - check for updates",
		onClick = function()
			self:openUpdateDialog()
		end,
	})
	self.versionButton.TextColor3 = Theme.color.textDim

	-- Panels ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local leftPanel = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.leftWidth, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TOP_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.leftPanel = leftPanel

	local rightPanel = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.rightWidth, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -self.rightWidth, 0, TOP_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.rightPanel = rightPanel

	local center = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TOP_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	self.center = center

	local stage = Kit.frame(center, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -TIMELINE_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	self.stage = stage

	local timelineHolder = Kit.frame(center, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TIMELINE_HEIGHT),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -TIMELINE_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	Theme.stroke(timelineHolder, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.4)

	local leftResizer = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.leftWidth, TOP_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = 20,
	})
	self.leftResizer = leftResizer

	local rightResizer = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -self.rightWidth - 5, 0, TOP_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = 20,
	})
	self.rightResizer = rightResizer

	local leftGrip = Kit.frame(leftResizer, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -0.5, 0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.line,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
	})
	local rightGrip = Kit.frame(rightResizer, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -0.5, 0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.line,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
	})

	Kit.drag(leftResizer, {
		begin = function()
			self.resizing = "left"
		end,
		move = function(x)
			local width = math.clamp(x - root.AbsolutePosition.X, MIN_LEFT, MAX_LEFT)
			self.leftWidth = width
			self:refreshLayout()
		end,
		finish = function()
			self.resizing = nil
			self.store:setPref("leftWidth", self.leftWidth, { silent = true })
		end,
	})
	Kit.drag(rightResizer, {
		begin = function()
			self.resizing = "right"
		end,
		move = function(x)
			local width = math.clamp(root.AbsolutePosition.X + root.AbsoluteSize.X - x, MIN_RIGHT, MAX_RIGHT)
			self.rightWidth = width
			self:refreshLayout()
		end,
		finish = function()
			self.resizing = nil
			self.store:setPref("rightWidth", self.rightWidth, { silent = true })
		end,
	})

	-- Status bar ---------------------------------------------------------------
	local status = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, STATUS_HEIGHT),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -STATUS_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	Theme.stroke(status, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.6)
	self.statusText = Kit.caption(status, "", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	local shortcuts = Kit.caption(status, "Space play  \u{00b7}  R restart  \u{00b7}  Del remove  \u{00b7}  Ctrl+Z undo", {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -12, 1, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	-- Modal layer --------------------------------------------------------------
	local modalLayer = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.black,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
		Visible = false,
		ZIndex = 50,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	self.modalLayer = modalLayer

	-- Panels ------------------------------------------------------------------
	self.ctx.store = store
	store.signals:on("status", function(message: string)
		self:toast(message, "info")
	end)

	local okLibrary, libraryOrError = pcall(Library.new, leftPanel, ctx)
	if okLibrary then
		self.library = libraryOrError
	else
		warn("[VFX Studio] library failed: " .. tostring(libraryOrError))
		Kit.label(leftPanel, "The preset library failed to load.\n" .. tostring(libraryOrError), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 80),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 60),
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		})
	end

	local okPreview, previewOrError = pcall(Preview.new, stage, ctx)
	if okPreview then
		self.preview = previewOrError
		ctx.preview = self.preview
	else
		warn("[VFX Studio] preview failed: " .. tostring(previewOrError))
		Kit.label(stage, "The live preview failed to start.\n" .. tostring(previewOrError), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 100),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 40),
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		})
	end

	local okTimeline, timelineOrError = pcall(Timeline.new, timelineHolder, ctx)
	if okTimeline then
		self.timeline = timelineOrError
	else
		warn("[VFX Studio] timeline failed: " .. tostring(timelineOrError))
		Kit.label(timelineHolder, "Timeline unavailable: " .. tostring(timelineOrError), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad,
		})
	end

	local okInspector, inspectorOrError = pcall(Inspector.new, rightPanel, ctx)
	if okInspector then
		self.inspector = inspectorOrError
	else
		warn("[VFX Studio] inspector failed: " .. tostring(inspectorOrError))
		Kit.label(rightPanel, "The inspector failed to load.\n" .. tostring(inspectorOrError), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 80),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 44),
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		})
	end

	self:bindHistory()
	self:bindShortcuts()
	self:refreshLayout()
	self:updateStatus()
	self:startHeartbeat()
	store:scheduleSave()
	self:scheduleUpdateCheck()
	return self
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- layout
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function App:refreshLayout()
	local width = self.root.AbsoluteSize.X
	local showLeft = self.leftEnabled and width >= 780
	local showRight = self.rightEnabled and width >= 700

	if showLeft ~= self.leftVisible then
		self.leftVisible = showLeft
	end
	if showRight ~= self.rightVisible then
		self.rightVisible = showRight
	end

	local leftWidth = if showLeft then self.leftWidth else 0
	local rightWidth = if showRight then self.rightWidth else 0

	self.leftPanel.Visible = showLeft
	self.leftPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, leftWidth, 1, -TOP_HEIGHT - STATUS_HEIGHT)
	self.leftResizer.Visible = showLeft
	self.leftResizer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(leftWidth, TOP_HEIGHT)
	self.leftResizer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -TOP_HEIGHT - STATUS_HEIGHT)

	self.rightPanel.Visible = showRight
	self.rightPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, rightWidth, 1, -TOP_HEIGHT - STATUS_HEIGHT)
	self.rightPanel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightWidth, 0, TOP_HEIGHT)
	self.rightResizer.Visible = showRight
	self.rightResizer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightWidth - 5, 0, TOP_HEIGHT)
	self.rightResizer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -TOP_HEIGHT - STATUS_HEIGHT)

	self.center.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(leftWidth, TOP_HEIGHT)
	self.center.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(leftWidth + rightWidth), 1, -TOP_HEIGHT - STATUS_HEIGHT)

	self.leftToggle.TextColor3 = if showLeft then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.textFaint
	self.rightToggle.TextColor3 = if showRight then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.textFaint
	Kit.setOverlay(self.root)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- history + status
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function App:bindHistory()
	self.store.signals:on("history", function()
		if self.undoButton then
			self.undoButton.TextColor3 = if self.store.history:canUndo() then Theme.color.text else Theme.color.textFaint
		end
		if self.redoButton then
			self.redoButton.TextColor3 = if self.store.history:canRedo() then Theme.color.text else Theme.color.textFaint
		end
		self:updateStatus()
	end)
	self.store.signals:on("spec", function()
		self:updateStatus()
	end)
	self.store.signals:on("selection", function()
		self:updateStatus()
	end)
	self.store.signals:on("pref", function()
		self:updateStatus()
	end)
	self.undoButton.TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint
	self.redoButton.TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint
end

function App:updateStatus()
	if not self.statusText then
		return
	end
	local spec = self.store:working()
	local undoLabel = self.store.history:peekUndo()
	self.statusText.Text = string.format(
		"%d presets  \u{00b7}  %s  \u{00b7}  %d/%d components%s",
		#self.store.presets.all + #self.store.custom,
		tostring(spec.name or "Untitled"),
		self.store.selection,
		#spec.components,
		if undoLabel then "  \u{00b7}  undo: " .. tostring(undoLabel) else ""
	)
end

function App:startHeartbeat()
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not self.preview or not self.timeline then
			return
		end
		local fraction = self.preview:progress()
		local duration = math.max(0.1, tonumber(self.store:working().duration) or 1)
		self.timeline:setProgress(fraction, fraction * duration)
		if self.preview.syncPlayState then
			self.preview:syncPlayState()
		end
	end))

	table.insert(self.connections, self.root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		self:refreshLayout()
	end))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- shortcuts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function App:bindShortcuts()
	table.insert(self.connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return
		end
		local key = input.KeyCode
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
			if self.preview then
				self.preview:togglePlay()
			end
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.R then
			if self.preview then
				self.preview:restart()
			end
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
			if #self.store:working().components > 1 then
				self.store:removeComponent(self.store.selection)
			else
				self:toast("An effect needs at least one component", "warn")
			end
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Z and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
			self.store:undo()
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Y and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
			self.store:redo()
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.D and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
			self.store:duplicateComponent(self.store.selection)
		end
	end))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- toasts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function App:toast(message: string, kind: string?)
	if not message or message == "" then
		return
	end
	local color = Theme.color.accent
	if kind == "success" then
		color = Theme.color.good
	elseif kind == "error" then
		color = Theme.color.bad
	elseif kind == "warn" then
		color = Theme.color.warn
	end

	local toast = Kit.frame(self.toastLayer, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 61,
	})
	Theme.corner(toast, Theme.radius.sm)
	Theme.stroke(toast, Theme.color.lineBright, 1, 0.4)

	local stripe = Kit.frame(toast, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
	})
	Kit.label(toast, message, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 0),
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	})

	task.delay(3.4, function()
		if not toast.Parent then
			return
		end
		Util.tween(toast, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.25)
		task.delay(0.28, function()
			if toast.Parent then
				toast:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- modals
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function App:closeModal()
	if self.modalContent then
		pcall(function()
			self.modalContent:destroy()
		end)
		self.modalContent = nil
	end
	if self.modalCard then
		self.modalCard:Destroy()
		self.modalCard = nil
	end
	self.modalLayer.Visible = false
end

function App:openModal(width: number, height: number, kind: string?): Frame
	self:closeModal()
	self.modalLayer.Visible = true
	local card = Kit.frame(self.modalLayer, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0.5, -height / 2),
		BackgroundColor3 = if kind == "assets" then Theme.color.bg1 else Theme.color.bg1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 51,
	})
	Theme.corner(card, Theme.radius.lg)
	Theme.stroke(card, Theme.color.lineBright, 1, 0.3)
	self.modalCard = card
	return card
end

function App:openAssetPicker(callback: ((string) -> ())?)
	local card = self:openModal(660, 560, "assets")
	local panel = AssetsPanel.new(card, {
		store = self.store,
		toast = function(message: string, kind: string?)
			self:toast(message, kind)
		end,
		closeModal = function()
			self:closeModal()
		end,
	}, function(uri: string)
		self:closeModal()
		if callback then
			callback(uri)
		else
			self:toast("Texture selected: " .. uri, "info")
		end
	end)
	self.modalContent = panel
end

function App:openExportDialog()
	local card = self:openModal(600, 640)
	local dialog = ExportDialog.new(card, self.ctx)
	self.modalContent = dialog
end

function App:openUpdateDialog()
	local card = self:openModal(560, 620)
	local dialog = UpdateDialog.new(card, self.ctx)
	self.modalContent = dialog
end

function App:updateVersionChip(hasUpdate: boolean)
	if not self.versionButton then
		return
	end
	local display = Version.display(Version.VERSION)
	self.versionButton.Text = if hasUpdate then display .. "  \u{2191}" else display
	self.versionButton.TextColor3 = if hasUpdate then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.textDim
end

function App:scheduleUpdateCheck()
	if not self.updater then
		return
	end
	task.delay(4, function()
		if not self.root.Parent or not self.updater:shouldAutoCheck() then
			return
		end
		local ok, info = pcall(function()
			return self.updater:check()
		end)
		if not ok or not self.root.Parent then
			return
		end
		if info and self.updater:hasUpdate() then
			self:updateVersionChip(true)
			self:toast("VFX Studio " .. Version.display(info.version) .. " is available - open the version button to update", "info")
		end
	end)
end

function App:promptSavePreset()
	local card = self:openModal(380, 216)
	local store = self.store

	local header = Kit.hlist(card, 8, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 14),
	})
	header.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24)
	Kit.label(header, "Save as preset", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.title,
	})
	Kit.caption(card, "Stored in this Studio install and available under My Presets.", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 14),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 40),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	local nameBox = Kit.textBox(card, tostring(store:working().name or "My Effect"), {
		placeholder = "Preset name",
		size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 30),
	})
	;(nameBox :: TextBox).Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 62)

	local actions = Kit.hlist(card, 8, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -46),
	})
	actions.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	actions.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 30)

	Kit.button(actions, "Cancel", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 30,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 30),
		onClick = function()
			self:closeModal()
		end,
	})
	Kit.button(actions, "Save preset", {
		variant = "primary",
		height = 30,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 30),
		onClick = function()
			local saved = store:saveCustomPreset(nameBox.Text)
			if self.library then
				self.library:refreshCategories()
				self.library:refresh()
			end
			self:toast("Saved preset \"" .. tostring(saved.name) .. "\"", "success")
			self:closeModal()
		end,
	})

	nameBox:CaptureFocus()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- actions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function App:importSelection()
	local selection = Util.Selection:Get()
	if #selection == 0 then
		self:toast("Select a ParticleEmitter, model or effect in the Explorer first", "warn")
		return
	end

	local spec
	local errors = {}
	for _, instance in ipairs(selection) do
		local ok, result = pcall(Decompiler.fromInstance, instance)
		if ok and result then
			spec = result
			break
		elseif not ok then
			table.insert(errors, tostring(result))
		end
	end

	if not spec then
		self:toast("Nothing importable in that selection", "error")
		if errors[1] then
			warn("[VFX Studio] import failed: " .. errors[1])
		end
		return
	end

	self.store:applyPreset(spec, "Import " .. tostring(spec.name))
	self:toast(string.format("Imported %d component(s)", #spec.components), "success")
end

function App:reloadPreset()
	local id = self.store.prefs.lastPresetId
	local spec = Presets.get(id) or self.store:findCustom(id)
	if not spec then
		self:toast("This effect has no stored preset to reload", "info")
		return
	end
	self.store:applyPreset(spec, "Reload " .. tostring(spec.name))
	self:toast("Reloaded " .. tostring(spec.name), "info")
end

function App:destroy()
	if self.updater then
		pcall(function()
			self.updater:destroy()
		end)
	end
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	if self.preview then
		pcall(function()
			self.preview:destroy()
		end)
	end
	if self.timeline then
		pcall(function()
			self.timeline:destroy()
		end)
	end
	if self.inspector then
		pcall(function()
			self.inspector:destroy()
		end)
	end
	if self.library then
		pcall(function()
			self.library:destroy()
		end)
	end
	self.store:save()
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return App

files.source:
--[[
	AssetsPanel - the texture manager.

	Browse the catalogue, add any Roblox texture by id, pull textures already
	used in the place, and validate every asset against the content provider so
	a missing decal is caught before it ships as an invisible effect.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Assets)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local AssetsPanel = {}
AssetsPanel.__index = AssetsPanel

local GROUPS = { "All", "Fire", "Smoke", "Magic", "Energy", "Utility", "Mine" }

function AssetsPanel.new(parent: Instance, ctx: any, onPick: ((string) -> ())?)
	local self = setmetatable({}, AssetsPanel)
	self.ctx = ctx
	self.store = ctx.store
	self.onPick = onPick
	self.query = ""
	self.group = "All"
	self.status = {}
	self.cards = {}

	local root = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.root = root

	local header = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Kit.label(header, "Texture assets", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 18),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.title,
	})
	Kit.caption(header, "Particle, beam and trail textures. Validate before shipping.", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 25),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 14),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	local closeButton = Kit.iconButton(header, "\u{00d7}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Close",
		onClick = function()
			self.ctx.closeModal()
		end,
	})
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 8)
	closeButton.TextColor3 = Theme.color.textDim

	local searchHolder = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 48),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	self.search = Kit.searchBox(searchHolder, "Search textures, tags or asset ids...", function(text)
		self.query = text
		self:render()
	end)

	local filters = Kit.hlist(root, 4, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 84),
	})
	filters.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	filters.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22)
	self.filterButtons = {}
	for _, group in ipairs(GROUPS) do
		local button = Kit.chip(filters, group, function()
			self.group = group
			self:render()
			self:refreshFilters()
		end, group == self.group)
		table.insert(self.filterButtons, { name = group, button = button })
	end

	local addRow = Kit.hlist(root, 6, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 112),
	})
	addRow.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	addRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28)
	local idBox = Kit.textBox(addRow, "", {
		placeholder = "Paste an asset id or rbxassetid://...",
		size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 28),
		onSubmit = function(text)
			self:addAsset(text)
		end,
	})
	idBox.Parent = addRow
	Kit.button(addRow, "Add", {
		variant = "primary",
		height = 28,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 28),
		onClick = function()
			self:addAsset(idBox.Text)
		end,
	})

	local tools = Kit.hlist(root, 6, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 146),
	})
	tools.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	tools.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 24)
	Kit.button(tools, "Validate all", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 22,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		tooltip = "Preload every texture and flag anything that fails",
		onClick = function()
			self:validateAll()
		end,
	})
	Kit.button(tools, "Import from selection", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 22,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(126, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			self:importFromSelection()
		end,
	})
	self.summary = Kit.caption(tools, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0, 22),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	local scroll = Kit.scroll(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -184),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 178),
	}, 12)
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	self.scroll = scroll

	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0, 108)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 2
	grid.Parent = scroll
	self.grid = grid

	self:render()
	return self
end

function AssetsPanel:refreshFilters()
	for _, entry in ipairs(self.filterButtons) do
		local active = entry.name == self.group
		entry.button.BackgroundColor3 = if active then Theme.color.accentSoft else Theme.color.bg3
		entry.button.TextColor3 = if active then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.textDim
	end
end

function AssetsPanel:visibleAssets(): { any }
	local list = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.search(self.query)) do
		local include = true
		if self.group ~= "All" then
			include = if self.group == "Mine" then entry.custom == true else entry.group == self.group
		end
		if include then
			table.insert(list, entry)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function AssetsPanel:render()
	Kit.clear(self.scroll)
	self.cards = {}
	local list = self:visibleAssets()

	local okCount, missingCount, unknownCount = 0, 0, 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local status = self.status[entry.uri] or "unknown"
		if status == "ok" then
			okCount += 1
		elseif status == "missing" then
			missingCount += 1
		else
			unknownCount += 1
		end
	end
	self.summary.Text = string.format("%d textures  \u{00b7}  %d ok  \u{00b7}  %d unverified  \u{00b7}  %d failed", #list, okCount, unknownCount, missingCount)

	for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
		self:createCard(entry, index)
	end

	if #list == 0 then
		Kit.caption(self.scroll, "No textures match that search.", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40),
			LayoutOrder = 1,
		})
	end
end

function AssetsPanel:createCard(entry: any, order: number)
	local card = Kit.frame(self.scroll, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 108),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	card.LayoutOrder = order
	Theme.corner(card, Theme.radius.md)
	Theme.stroke(card, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.35)

	local preview = Kit.frame(card, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -10)
	image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 5)
	image.Image = entry.uri
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	image.ImageTransparency = 0.05
	image.Parent = preview

	local name = Kit.label(card, entry.name, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 66),
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		Font = Theme.font.medium,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	})

	local meta = Kit.caption(card, string.format("%s \u{00b7} %s", entry.group or "Custom", if entry.builtin then "built in" else "asset"), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 12),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 80),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	local status = self.status[entry.uri] or "unknown"
	local statusColor = if status == "ok" then Theme.color.good elseif status == "missing" then Theme.color.bad else Theme.color.warn
	local badge = Kit.label(card, if status == "ok" then "OK" elseif status == "missing" then "MISSING" else "VERIFY", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 12),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 68),
		TextColor3 = statusColor,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local use = Kit.button(card, if self.onPick then "Use" else "Copy id", {
		variant = "accentSoft",
		height = 20,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 20),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			if self.onPick then
				self.onPick(entry.uri)
			else
				self.ctx.toast(entry.uri, "info")
			end
		end,
	})
	use.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 84)

	local check = Kit.iconButton(card, "\u{2713}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
		tooltip = "Validate this texture",
		onClick = function()
			self:validateOne(entry, badge)
		end,
	})
	check.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 42)
	check.TextColor3 = Theme.color.white
	check.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0
	check.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	check.ZIndex = 4

	if entry.custom then
		local remove = Kit.iconButton(card, "\u{00d7}", {
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
			tooltip = "Remove from my textures",
			onClick = function()
				self:removeAsset(entry.uri)
			end,
		})
		remove.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 44)
		remove.Visible = false
		remove.TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad
		card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			remove.Visible = true
		end)
		card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			remove.Visible = false
		end)
		remove.ZIndex = 5
	end

	self.cards[entry.uri] = { badge = badge, image = image, status = status }
end

function AssetsPanel:validateOne(entry: any, badge: TextLabel?)
	if badge then
		badge.Text = "..."
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local status = Assets.validate(entry.uri, self.root)
		self.status[entry.uri] = status
		self:render()
	end)
end

function AssetsPanel:validateAll()
	local list = self:visibleAssets()
	self.summary.Text = "Validating " .. #list .. " textures..."
	task.spawn(function()
		local failed = 0
		for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
			local status = Assets.validate(entry.uri, self.root)
			self.status[entry.uri] = status
			if status == "missing" then
				failed += 1
			end
		end
		self:render()
		if failed > 0 then
			self.ctx.toast(string.format("%d texture(s) failed to load", failed), "error")
		else
			self.ctx.toast("All textures loaded", "success")
		end
	end)
end

function AssetsPanel:addAsset(raw: string)
	local text = Util.trim(raw or "")
	if text == "" then
		return
	end
	local uri = Assets.resolve(text)
	if uri == "" then
		self.ctx.toast("That does not look like an asset id", "warn")
		return
	end

	for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.all()) do
		if entry.uri == uri then
			self.ctx.toast("That texture is already in the library", "info")
			return
		end
	end

	local custom = table.clone(Assets.custom)
	table.insert(custom, {
		id = "custom_" .. Util.slug(Assets.describe(uri)),
		name = Assets.describe(uri),
		uri = uri,
		group = "Utility",
		custom = true,
		tags = { "custom" },
	})
	Assets.setCustom(custom)
	self.store:setPref("customAssets", custom, { silent = true })
	self.ctx.toast("Added " .. Assets.describe(uri), "success")
	self:render()
end

function AssetsPanel:removeAsset(uri: string)
	local custom = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.custom) do
		if entry.uri ~= uri then
			table.insert(custom, entry)
		end
	end
	Assets.setCustom(custom)
	self.store:setPref("customAssets", custom, { silent = true })
	self:render()
end

function AssetsPanel:importFromSelection()
	local selection = Util.Selection:Get()
	if #selection == 0 then
		self.ctx.toast("Select an effect in the Explorer first", "warn")
		return
	end

	local found = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, root in ipairs(selection) do
		local candidates = { root }
		for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			table.insert(candidates, descendant)
		end
		for _, instance in ipairs(candidates) do
			if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or instance:IsA("Beam") or instance:IsA("Trail") then
				local uri = instance.Texture
				if uri and uri ~= "" and not seen[uri] then
					seen[uri] = true
					table.insert(found, uri)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #found == 0 then
		self.ctx.toast("No texture-bearing instances in the selection", "info")
		return
	end

	local custom = table.clone(Assets.custom)
	for _, uri in ipairs(found) do
		local already = false
		for _, entry in ipairs(Assets.all()) do
			if entry.uri == uri then
				already = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not already then
			table.insert(custom, {
				id = "custom_" .. Util.slug(Assets.describe(uri)) .. "_" .. #custom,
				name = Assets.describe(uri),
				uri = uri,
				group = "Utility",
				custom = true,
				tags = { "imported" },
			})
		end
	end
	Assets.setCustom(custom)
	self.store:setPref("customAssets", custom, { silent = true })
	self.ctx.toast(string.format("Imported %d texture(s)", #found), "success")
	self:render()
end

function AssetsPanel:destroy()
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return AssetsPanel

files.name: ExportDialog
files.source:
--[[
	ExportDialog - the shipping step.

	Pick a destination, review the pre-flight checks, generate the controller
	ModuleScript and either insert the effect into the place or save it as a
	.rbxm. Nothing happens until the developer presses Export.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Exporter = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Exporter)
local ScriptGenerator = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.ScriptGenerator)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local ExportDialog = {}
ExportDialog.__index = ExportDialog

function ExportDialog.new(parent: Instance, ctx: any)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ExportDialog)
	self.ctx = ctx
	self.store = ctx.store
	self.destination = "ReplicatedStorage"
	self.withController = true

	local root = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.root = root

	local header = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Kit.label(header, "Export effect", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 9),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.title,
	})
	Kit.caption(header, "Real instances, a working controller and an undo step.", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 27),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 14),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	local close = Kit.iconButton(header, "\u{00d7}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Close",
		onClick = function()
			ctx.closeModal()
		end,
	})
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 10)

	local body = Kit.scroll(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -108),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46),
	}, 16)
	self.body = body

	local actionBar = Kit.hlist(root, 8, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 34),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -48),
	})
	actionBar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	actionBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 34)

	self.exportButton = Kit.button(actionBar, "Export to place", {
		variant = "primary",
		height = 34,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 34),
		onClick = function()
			self:export()
		end,
	})
	Kit.button(actionBar, "Save .rbxm", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 34,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 34),
		tooltip = "Save the effect as a model file through Studio's save dialog",
		onClick = function()
			self:saveFile()
		end,
	})
	self.actionHint = Kit.caption(actionBar, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -260, 0, 34),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	self:render()
	return self
end

function ExportDialog:render()
	Kit.clear(self.body)
	local spec = self.store:working()

	-- Preset summary
	local title = Kit.frame(self.body, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
	})
	Theme.corner(title, Theme.radius.md)
	Kit.label(title, tostring(spec.name or "Effect"), {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 7),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16),
		Font = Theme.font.medium,
		TextSize = Theme.text.body,
	})
	Kit.caption(title, string.format(
		"%s  \u{00b7}  %d components  \u{00b7}  %s  \u{00b7}  %s",
		tostring(spec.category or "Custom"),
		#(spec.components or {}),
		Util.formatDuration(spec.duration or 1),
		if spec.loop then "looping" else "one-shot"
	), {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 25),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	-- Destination
	Kit.sectionTitle(self.body, "Destination")
	local destinationRow, destinationHolder = Kit.row(self.body, "Parent to", "Where the exported Model is inserted.", 30)
	local destinationDropdown = Kit.dropdown(destinationHolder, {
		options = Exporter.DESTINATIONS,
		value = self.destination,
		height = 28,
		onChange = function(value)
			self.destination = tostring(value)
		end,
	})
	destinationDropdown.Parent = destinationHolder

	local nameRow, nameHolder = Kit.row(self.body, "Model name", "Duplicate names get a numeric suffix.", 30)
	local nameBox = Kit.textBox(nameHolder, tostring(spec.name or "VFX Effect"), {
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
		onSubmit = function(text)
			self.customName = Util.trim(text)
		end,
	})
	nameBox.Parent = nameHolder

	local controllerRow, controllerHolder = Kit.row(self.body, "Controller script", "Adds VFXController, a ready-to-use ModuleScript that plays the effect.", 30)
	local controllerToggle = Kit.toggle(controllerHolder, self.withController, function(value)
		self.withController = value
	end)
	controllerToggle.Parent = controllerHolder

	-- Validation
	Kit.sectionTitle(self.body, "Pre-flight checks")
	local issues = Exporter.validate(spec)
	for _, issue in ipairs(issues) do
		local color = if issue.severity == "high"
			then Theme.color.bad
			elseif issue.severity == "medium"
			then Theme.color.warn
			elseif issue.severity == "ok"
			then Theme.color.good
			else Theme.color.textMuted
		local row = Kit.frame(self.body, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
			ClipsDescendants = false,
		})
		Theme.corner(row, Theme.radius.xs)
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
		pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
		pad.Parent = row

		local dot = Kit.frame(row, {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6),
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
		})
		Theme.corner(dot, Theme.radius.pill)

		Kit.label(row, issue.message, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextSize = Theme.text.small,
			TextColor3 = if issue.severity == "ok" then Theme.color.good else Theme.color.text,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		})
	end

	-- Controller source
	Kit.sectionTitle(self.body, "Generated controller")
	local sourceCard = Kit.frame(self.body, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 168),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	Theme.corner(sourceCard, Theme.radius.sm)
	Theme.stroke(sourceCard, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.4)

	local source = Kit.textBox(sourceCard, ScriptGenerator.generate(spec), {
		size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
		font = Theme.font.mono,
		textSize = 10,
	})
	source.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
	source.TextWrapped = false
	source.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	source.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	source.ClearTextOnFocus = false

	Kit.sectionTitle(self.body, "Usage")
	local usageCard = Kit.frame(self.body, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 128),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	Theme.corner(usageCard, Theme.radius.sm)
	local usage = Kit.textBox(usageCard, ScriptGenerator.usage(spec), {
		size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
		font = Theme.font.mono,
		textSize = 10,
	})
	usage.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
	usage.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	usage.TextWrapped = false

	Kit.caption(self.body, "Tip: select the exported model and press Import in the Inspector to pull it back in for more edits.", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
end

function ExportDialog:export()
	local spec = self.store:working()
	local model, err = Exporter.export(spec, {
		destination = self.destination,
		name = self.customName or spec.name,
		withController = self.withController,
	})
	if not model then
		self.ctx.toast(err or "Export failed", "error")
		return
	end
	Util.Selection:Set({ model })
	self.ctx.toast("Exported " .. model:GetFullName(), "success")
	self.ctx.closeModal()
end

function ExportDialog:saveFile()
	local ok, err = Exporter.saveToFile(self.store:working(), self.ctx.plugin)
	if not ok then
		self.ctx.toast(err or "Save failed", "error")
		return
	end
	self.ctx.toast("Save dialog opened", "info")
end

function ExportDialog:destroy()
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return ExportDialog

files.name: Inspector
files.source:
--[[
	Inspector - the right-hand panel.

	Three tabs:
	  Properties  effect metadata, the component stack (drag to reorder) and
	              every real property of the selected component.
	  Curves      colour gradient editor, opacity curve and size curve, with a
	              real HSV picker and per-keypoint editing.
	  Cost        live performance report with actionable fixes.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Format = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Format)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Assets)
local Performance = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Performance)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Inspector = {}
Inspector.__index = Inspector

local KIND_LABELS = {
	particle = "Particles",
	beam = "Beam",
	trail = "Trail",
	light = "Light",
	part = "Mesh part",
	tween = "Motion",

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- colour helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function sampleColor(points: { any }, alpha: number): Color3
	if not points or #points == 0 then
		return Theme.color.white
	end
	if #points == 1 then
		return Util.hex(points[1][2])
	end
	local low = points[1]
	local high = points[#points]
	for index = 1, #points - 1 do
		if alpha >= (points[index][1] or 0) and alpha <= (points[index + 1][1] or 0) then
			low = points[index]
			high = points[index + 1]
			break
		end
	end
	local timeLow = tonumber(low[1]) or 0
	local timeHigh = tonumber(high[1]) or 1
	local span = timeHigh - timeLow
	local fraction = if span <= 0 then 0 else (alpha - timeLow) / span
	return Util.hex(low[2]):Lerp(Util.hex(high[2]), math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1))
end

local function sampleNumber(points: { any }, alpha: number): number
	if not points or #points == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	if #points == 1 then
		return tonumber(points[1][2]) or 0
	end
	local low = points[1]
	local high = points[#points]
	for index = 1, #points - 1 do
		if alpha >= (points[index][1] or 0) and alpha <= (points[index + 1][1] or 0) then
			low = points[index]
			high = points[index + 1]
			break
		end
	end
	local timeLow = tonumber(low[1]) or 0
	local timeHigh = tonumber(high[1]) or 1
	local span = timeHigh - timeLow
	local fraction = if span <= 0 then 0 else (alpha - timeLow) / span
	return Util.lerp(tonumber(low[2]) or 0, tonumber(high[2]) or 0, math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1))
end

local function sorted(points: { any }): { any }
	local copy = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do
		table.insert(copy, { tonumber(point[1]) or 0, point[2] })
	end
	table.sort(copy, function(a, b)
		return a[1] < b[1]
	end)
	return copy
end

		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),

		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Visible = false,
	}, 9)
	self.cost = cost

	self:bind()
	self:rebuild()
	return self
end

function Inspector:bind()
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("spec", function()
		self:rebuild()
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("selection", function()
		self:rebuild()
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("field", function(payload)
		if self.tab == "Cost" then
			self:renderCost()
		end
		if payload and payload.key == "color" and self.tab == "Curves" and not self.interacting then
			self:renderCurves()
		end
	end))
end

function Inspector:showTab(name: string)
	self.tab = name
	for tabName, button in pairs(self.tabButtons) do
		button.TextColor3 = if tabName == name then Theme.color.text else Theme.color.textMuted
	end
	self.properties.Visible = name == "Properties"
	self.curves.Visible = name == "Curves"
	self.cost.Visible = name == "Cost"
	if name == "Curves" then
		self:renderCurves()
	elseif name == "Cost" then
		self:renderCost()
	else
		self:rebuild()
	end
end

function Inspector:rebuild()
	Kit.clear(self.properties)
	self:renderMeta()
	self:renderComponentStack()
	self:renderFields()
	if self.tab == "Curves" then
		self:renderCurves()
	elseif self.tab == "Cost" then
		self:renderCost()
	end
end

	if #spec.components == 0 then
		Kit.caption(stack, "No components yet - add one above.", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
		})

	local rows = {}
	for index, comp in ipairs(spec.components) do
		local active = index == self.store.selection
		local row = Kit.frame(stack, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
			BackgroundColor3 = if active then Theme.color.accentSoft else Theme.color.bg2,
			BackgroundTransparency = if active then 0 else 0.25,
		})
		row.LayoutOrder = index
		Theme.corner(row, Theme.radius.xs)

		local handle = Kit.label(row, "\u{2261}", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 26),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0),
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		})
		handle.ZIndex = 4

		Kit.label(row, string.format("%s  %s", KIND_GLYPHS[comp.kind] or "\u{25c6}", tostring(comp.name)), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0),
			TextColor3 = if active then Theme.color.text else Theme.color.textDim,
			TextSize = Theme.text.small,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		})

		local duplicate = Kit.iconButton(row, "\u{29c9}", {
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
			tooltip = "Duplicate component",
			onClick = function()
				self.store:duplicateComponent(index)
			end,
		})
		duplicate.Position = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0, 3)
		duplicate.ZIndex = 4

		local remove = Kit.iconButton(row, "\u{00d7}", {
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
			tooltip = "Delete component",
			onClick = function()
				self.store:removeComponent(index)
			end,
		})
		remove.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 3)
		remove.ZIndex = 4
		remove.TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad

		local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
		click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		click.Text = ""
		click.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
		click.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0)
		click.ZIndex = 2
		click.Parent = row
		click.Activated:Connect(function()
			self.store:select(index)
		end)

		Kit.drag(handle, {
			begin = function()
				self.store:select(index)
				self.dragRow = index
			end,
			move = function(_, y)
				if not self.dragRow then
					return
				end
				local target = math.clamp(math.floor((y - stack.AbsolutePosition.Y) / 28) + 1, 1, #spec.components)
				if target ~= self.dragRow then
					self.store:moveComponent(self.dragRow, target)
					self.dragRow = target
				end
			end,
			finish = function()
				self.dragRow = nil
			end,
		})

		rows[index] = row
	end

	local divider = Kit.divider(self.properties)
	divider.LayoutOrder = 9
end

function Inspector:renderFields()
	local spec = self.store:working()
	local comp = spec.components[self.store.selection]
	local header = Kit.sectionTitle(self.properties, if comp then "Properties - " .. tostring(comp.name) else "Properties")
	header.LayoutOrder = 10

	if not comp then
		Kit.caption(self.properties, "Select a component to edit it.", { LayoutOrder = 11 })
		return
	end

	local schema = SCHEMA[comp.kind] or {}
	local order = 10

	-- Component name + timing are shared by every kind.
	order += 1
	local nameRow, nameHolder = Kit.row(self.properties, "Name")
	nameRow.LayoutOrder = order
	local nameBox = Kit.textBox(nameHolder, tostring(comp.name), {
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		onSubmit = function(text)
			self.store:renameComponent(self.store.selection, text)
		end,
	})
	nameBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)

	order += 1
	local startRow, startHolder = Kit.row(self.properties, "Start time", "When this component begins emitting, in seconds.")
	startRow.LayoutOrder = order
	local startBox = Kit.numberBox(startHolder, tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0, {
		min = 0,
		max = 30,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		onChange = function(value)
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "startTime", value, true)
		end,
	})
	startBox.Parent = startHolder

	order += 1
	local durationRow, durationHolder = Kit.row(self.properties, "Duration", "How long the component stays active. 0 means a single burst.")
	durationRow.LayoutOrder = order
	local compDuration = Kit.numberBox(durationHolder, tonumber(comp.duration) or 0, {
		min = 0,
		max = 30,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		onChange = function(value)
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "duration", value, true)
		end,
	})
	compDuration.Parent = durationHolder

	if comp.kind == "particle" then
		order += 1
		local burstRow, burstHolder = Kit.row(self.properties, "Burst count", "Particles emitted at once when the component starts.")
		burstRow.LayoutOrder = order
		local burstBox = Kit.numberBox(burstHolder, tonumber(comp.burst) or 0, {
			min = 0,
			max = 2000,
			size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
			onChange = function(value)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "burst", value, true)
			end,
		})
		burstBox.Parent = burstHolder

		order += 1
		local repeatsRow, repeatsHolder = Kit.row(self.properties, "Burst repeats", "How many bursts play across the duration.")
		repeatsRow.LayoutOrder = order
		local repeatsBox = Kit.numberBox(repeatsHolder, tonumber(comp.repeats) or 1, {
			min = 1,
			max = 50,
			size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
			onChange = function(value)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "repeats", math.max(1, math.floor(value)), true)
			end,
		})
		repeatsBox.Parent = repeatsHolder
	end

	if comp.kind == "tween" then
		order += 1
		local reverseRow, reverseHolder = Kit.row(self.properties, "Reverse")
		reverseRow.LayoutOrder = order
		local reverseToggle = Kit.toggle(reverseHolder, comp.reverse == true, function(value)
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "reverse", value, true)
		end)
		reverseToggle.Parent = reverseHolder
	end

	for _, field in ipairs(schema) do
		order += 1
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			self:renderField(field, comp, order)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] field '" .. tostring(field.key) .. "' failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

function Inspector:renderField(field: any, comp: any, order: number)
	local key = field.key
	local label = field.label
	local value = comp[key]

	if field.type == "number" then
		local row, holder = Kit.row(self.properties, label, field.hint)
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		local box = Kit.numberBox(holder, tonumber(value) or 0, {
			min = field.min,
			max = field.max,
			size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
			onChange = function(newValue)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, newValue)
			end,
		})
		box.Parent = holder
		return
	elseif field.type == "boolean" then
		local row, holder = Kit.row(self.properties, label, field.hint)
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		local toggle = Kit.toggle(holder, value == true, function(newValue)
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, newValue, true)
		end)
		toggle.Parent = holder
		return
	elseif field.type == "range" then
		local row = Kit.vlist(self.properties, 3)
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		local head = Kit.hlist(row, 6)
		head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
		Kit.caption(head, label, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0) })
		local minValue = tonumber((value or {})[1]) or 0
		local maxValue = tonumber((value or {})[2]) or minValue
		Kit.label(head, string.format("%s - %s", Util.pretty(minValue), Util.pretty(maxValue)), {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 14),
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
			Font = Theme.font.mono,
			TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		})
		local controls = Kit.hlist(row, 4)
		controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		local minBox = Kit.numberBox(controls, minValue, {
			min = field.min,
			max = field.max,
			size = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 0, 24),
			onChange = function(newMin)
				local current = comp[key] or { 0, 0 }
				local upper = tonumber(current[2]) or newMin
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, { newMin, math.max(newMin, upper) })
			end,
		})
		minBox.Parent = controls
		local maxBox = Kit.numberBox(controls, maxValue, {
			min = field.min,
			max = field.max,
			size = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 0, 24),
			onChange = function(newMax)
				local current = comp[key] or { 0, 0 }
				local lower = tonumber(current[1]) or 0
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, { math.min(lower, newMax), newMax })
			end,
		})
		maxBox.Parent = controls
		return
	elseif field.type == "vector2" or field.type == "vector3" then
		local row = Kit.vlist(self.properties, 3)
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		Kit.caption(row, label, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14) })
		local controls = Kit.hlist(row, 4)
		controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		local count = if field.type == "vector2" then 2 else 3
		local axes = { "X", "Y", "Z" }
		local boxes = {}
		for index = 1, count do
			local holder = Kit.frame(controls, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -3, 0, 24),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
			})
			Theme.corner(holder, Theme.radius.xs)
			local box = Kit.numberBox(holder, tonumber((value or {})[index]) or 0, {
				min = field.min,
				max = field.max,
				size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
				onChange = function(newValue)
					local current = {}
					for i = 1, count do
						current[i] = tonumber((comp[key] or {})[i]) or 0
					end
					current[index] = newValue
					self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, current)
				end,
			})
			box.Parent = holder
			table.insert(boxes, box)
		end
		return
	elseif field.type == "enum" then
		local row, holder = Kit.row(self.properties, label)
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		local enumType = (Enum :: any)[field.enum]
		local options = {}
		if enumType then
			for _, item in ipairs(enumType:GetEnumItems()) do
				table.insert(options, { value = item.Name, label = item.Name })
			end
		end
		local dropdown = Kit.dropdown(holder, {
			options = options,
			value = tostring(value or ""),
			height = 24,
			maxHeight = 150,
			onChange = function(newValue)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, tostring(newValue), true)
			end,
		})
		dropdown.Parent = holder
		return
	elseif field.type == "options" then
		local row, holder = Kit.row(self.properties, label)
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		local options = {}
		for _, option in ipairs(field.options) do
			table.insert(options, { value = option, label = option })
		end
		local dropdown = Kit.dropdown(holder, {
			options = options,
			value = tostring(value or field.options[1]),
			height = 24,
			maxHeight = 150,
			onChange = function(newValue)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, tostring(newValue), true)
			end,
		})
		dropdown.Parent = holder
		return
	elseif field.type == "target" then
		local row, holder = Kit.row(self.properties, label, "Which component this motion track drives.")
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		local options = { { value = "rig", label = "Whole effect" } }
		for _, other in ipairs(self.store:working().components) do
			if other.kind ~= "tween" then
				table.insert(options, { value = other.name, label = other.name })
			end
		end
		local dropdown = Kit.dropdown(holder, {
			options = options,
			value = tostring(value or "rig"),
			height = 24,
			maxHeight = 150,
			onChange = function(newValue)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, tostring(newValue), true)
			end,
		})
		dropdown.Parent = holder
		return
	elseif field.type == "texture" then
		self:renderTextureField(field, comp, order)
		return
	elseif field.type == "color" or field.type == "curve01" or field.type == "curve" then
		self:renderCurveField(field, comp, order)
		return
	elseif field.type == "swatch" then
		local block = Kit.vlist(self.properties, 4)
		block.LayoutOrder = order
		block.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)

		local head = Kit.hlist(block, 6)
		head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)

		local swatch = Kit.colorSwatch(head, Util.hex(tostring(value or "#ffffff")), UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24))
		local hexBox = Kit.textBox(head, tostring(value or "#ffffff"), {
			size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 24),
			font = Theme.font.mono,
			onSubmit = function(text)
				local trimmed = Util.trim(text)
				if string.match(trimmed, "^#?%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then
					local normalized = "#" .. string.gsub(trimmed, "#", "")
					self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, normalized, true)
					swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Util.hex(normalized)
				else
					self.ctx.toast("Enter a hex colour like #ff8800", "warn")
				end
			end,
		})
		hexBox.Parent = head

		local palette = Kit.hlist(block, 4)
		palette.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
		for _, preset in ipairs(COLOR_PRESETS) do
			local dot = Kit.colorSwatch(palette, Util.hex(preset.colors[2]), UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18))
			local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
			click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			click.Text = ""
			click.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			click.Parent = dot
			click.Activated:Connect(function()
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, preset.colors[2], true)
				swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Util.hex(preset.colors[2])
				hexBox.Text = preset.colors[2]
			end)
			Kit.tooltip(click, preset.name)
		end
		return
	end
end

	})
	container.LayoutOrder = order

	Kit.caption(container, field.label, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
	})

	local preview = Kit.frame(container, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 38),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	Theme.corner(preview, Theme.radius.xs)

	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8)

	local browse = Kit.button(container, "Change", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 38,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 38),
		textSize = Theme.text.small,
		onClick = function()
			self.ctx.openAssetPicker(function(uri: string)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, field.key, uri, true)

			end)

	browse.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 18)

function Inspector:renderCurveField(field: any, comp: any, order: number)
	local container = Kit.frame(self.properties, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	container.LayoutOrder = order

	Kit.caption(container, field.label, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 14),
	})

	local edit = Kit.button(container, "Edit", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 16,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			self.curveMode = if field.type == "color" then "color" elseif field.key == "size" then "size" else "transparency"
			self.showTab("Curves")
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})
	edit.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, -1)

	local strip = Kit.frame(container, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	Theme.corner(strip, Theme.radius.xs)

	if field.type == "color" then
		local keypoints = sorted(comp[field.key] or {})
		for index = 1, 32 do
			local alpha = (index - 1) / 31
			local sample = Kit.frame(strip, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / 32, 1, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / 32, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = sampleColor(keypoints, alpha),
			})
		end
	else
		local keypoints = comp[field.key] or {}
		local peak = 0.0001
		if field.key == "transparency" then
			peak = 1
		else
			for _, kp in ipairs(keypoints) do
				peak = math.max(peak, tonumber(kp[2]) or 0)
			end
		end
		for index = 1, 32 do
			local alpha = (index - 1) / 31
			local value = sampleNumber(keypoints, alpha)
			local height = math.clamp(if field.key == "transparency" then 1 - value else value / (peak * 1.15), 0, 1)
			local bar = Kit.frame(strip, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / 32, 1, height, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / 32, 0, 1, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = if field.key == "transparency" then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.accent,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
			})
			bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		end
	end
end
