function Inspector:renderCurves()
	Kit.clear(self.curves)
	local comp = self.store:currentComponent()

	local modeRow = Kit.hlist(self.curves, 4)
	modeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	local modes = {
		{ key = "color", label = "Colour" },
		{ key = "transparency", label = "Opacity" },
		{ key = "size", label = "Size" },
	}
	for _, mode in ipairs(modes) do
		local button = Kit.button(modeRow, mode.label, {
			variant = if self.curveMode == mode.key then "accentSoft" else "ghost",
			height = 22,
			size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 22),
			textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
			onClick = function()
				self.curveMode = mode.key
				self.activeStop = 1
				self:renderCurves()
			end,
		})
	end

	if not comp then
		Kit.caption(self.curves, "Select a component first.")
		return
	end

	if self.curveMode == "color" then
		self:renderColorEditor(comp)
	else
		self:renderNumberCurve(comp, self.curveMode)
	end
end

function Inspector:renderColorEditor(comp: any)
	local single = self.colorSingle
	local keypoints = sorted(comp.color or {})
	self.activeStop = math.clamp(self.activeStop, 1, math.max(1, #keypoints))

	local header = Kit.hlist(self.curves, 6)
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	Kit.caption(header, "GRADIENT", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0), Font = Theme.font.bold, TextSize = Theme.text.tiny })
	local countLabel = Kit.caption(header, string.format("%d stops", #keypoints), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(62, 18),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local bar = Kit.frame(self.curves, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	Theme.corner(bar, Theme.radius.xs)
	self.gradientBar = bar

	for index = 1, 40 do
		local alpha = (index - 1) / 39
		Kit.frame(bar, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1 / 40, 1, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / 40, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = sampleColor(keypoints, alpha),
		})
	end

	local stopMarkers = {}
	for index, point in ipairs(keypoints) do
		local marker = Kit.frame(bar, {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 40),
			Position = UDim2.new(tonumber(point[1]) or 0, -5, 0, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = if index == self.activeStop then Theme.color.white else Theme.color.black,
			BackgroundTransparency = if index == self.activeStop then 0 else 0.55,
			ZIndex = 3,
		})
		Theme.stroke(marker, if index == self.activeStop then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.white, 1, 0)
		marker.ZIndex = 3

		local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
		click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		click.Text = ""
		click.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		click.ZIndex = 4
		click.Parent = marker
		click.Activated:Connect(function()
			self.activeStop = index
			self:renderCurves()
		end)

		local startTime = tonumber(point[1]) or 0
		Kit.drag(marker, {
			begin = function()
				self.store:pushHistory("Move colour stop")
				self.activeStop = index
			end,
			move = function(x)
				local fraction = Kit.fractionAlong(bar, x)
				local points = comp.color
				points[index][1] = math.floor(fraction * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "color", sorted(points))
			end,
			finish = function()
				comp.color = sorted(comp.color)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "color", comp.color, true)
				self:renderCurves()
			end,
		})

		table.insert(stopMarkers, marker)
	end

	local actions = Kit.hlist(self.curves, 6)
	actions.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	Kit.button(actions, "+ Add stop", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 22,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			self.store:pushHistory("Add colour stop")
			local points = comp.color
			local insertAt = 0.5
			local color = sampleColor(points, insertAt)
			table.insert(points, { insertAt, Util.toHex(color) })
			comp.color = sorted(points)
			self.activeStop = 1
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "color", comp.color)
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})
	local removeButton = Kit.button(actions, "Remove stop", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 22,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			if #comp.color <= 2 then
				self.ctx.toast("A gradient needs at least two stops", "warn")
				return
			end
			self.store:pushHistory("Remove colour stop")
			table.remove(comp.color, self.activeStop)
			self.activeStop = math.clamp(self.activeStop, 1, #comp.color)
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "color", comp.color)
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})
	removeButton.TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad

	-- HSV picker ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local selected = keypoints[self.activeStop]
	local currentColor = Util.hex(selected and selected[2] or "#ffffff")
	local h, s, v = currentColor:ToHSV()

	local sv = Kit.frame(self.curves, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 110),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1),
	})
	Theme.corner(sv, Theme.radius.xs)

	local whiteOverlay = Kit.frame(sv, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0,
	})
	local whiteGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	whiteGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	whiteGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	whiteGradient.Rotation = 0
	whiteGradient.Parent = whiteOverlay

	local blackOverlay = Kit.frame(sv, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	})
	local blackGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	blackGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
	blackGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	blackGradient.Rotation = 90
	blackGradient.Parent = blackOverlay

	local cursor = Kit.frame(sv, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		Position = UDim2.new(s, -5, 1 - v, -5),
		BackgroundColor3 = currentColor,
		ZIndex = 4,
	})
	Theme.corner(cursor, Theme.radius.pill)
	Theme.stroke(cursor, Theme.color.white, 2, 0)

	local function commitColor(newColor: Color3)
		local points = comp.color
		if not points[self.activeStop] then
			return
		end
		points[self.activeStop][2] = Util.toHex(newColor)
		self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "color", sorted(points))
	end

	local function updateFromPosition(x: number, y: number)
		local sx = Kit.fractionAlong(sv, x)
		local height = math.max(1, sv.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		local sy = 1 - math.clamp((y - sv.AbsolutePosition.Y) / height, 0, 1)
		cursor.Position = UDim2.new(sx, -5, 1 - sy, -5)
		local newColor = Color3.fromHSV(h, sx, sy)
		cursor.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
		commitColor(newColor)
	end

	local svHit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	svHit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	svHit.Text = ""
	svHit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	svHit.ZIndex = 3
	svHit.Parent = sv
	Kit.drag(svHit, {
		begin = function(x, y)
			self.store:pushHistory("Pick colour")
			updateFromPosition(x, y)
		end,
		move = function(x, y)
			updateFromPosition(x, y)
		end,
		finish = function()
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})

	-- Hue strip
	local hueStrip = Kit.frame(self.curves, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1),
	})
	Theme.corner(hueStrip, Theme.radius.pill)
	local hueGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	hueGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1 / 6, Color3.fromHSV(1 / 6, 1, 1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2 / 6, Color3.fromHSV(2 / 6, 1, 1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3 / 6, Color3.fromHSV(3 / 6, 1, 1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4 / 6, Color3.fromHSV(4 / 6, 1, 1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5 / 6, Color3.fromHSV(5 / 6, 1, 1)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(1, 1, 1)),
	})
	hueGradient.Parent = hueStrip

	local hueCursor = Kit.frame(hueStrip, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(h, -1, 0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.white,
		ZIndex = 3,
	})

	local hueHit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hueHit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hueHit.Text = ""
	hueHit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	hueHit.ZIndex = 2
	hueHit.Parent = hueStrip
	Kit.drag(hueHit, {
		begin = function(x)
			self.store:pushHistory("Pick hue")
		end,
		move = function(x)
			local fraction = Kit.fractionAlong(hueStrip, x)
			h = fraction
			hueCursor.Position = UDim2.new(fraction, -1, 0, 0)
			sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
			local newColor = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
			cursor.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
			commitColor(newColor)
		end,
		finish = function()
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})

	-- Hex + presets --------------------------------------------------------------
	local hexRow = Kit.hlist(self.curves, 6)
	hexRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
	Kit.caption(hexRow, "Hex", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 26) })
	local hexBox = Kit.textBox(hexRow, Util.toHex(currentColor), {
		size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26),
		onSubmit = function(text)
			local trimmed = Util.trim(text)
			if string.match(trimmed, "^#?%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then
				self.store:pushHistory("Set hex colour")
				commitColor(Util.hex(trimmed))
				self:renderCurves()
			else
				self.ctx.toast("Enter a hex colour like #ff8800", "warn")
				hexBox.Text = Util.toHex(currentColor)
			end
		end,
	})
	hexBox.Parent = hexRow

	Kit.caption(self.curves, "PALETTES", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Font = Theme.font.bold, TextSize = Theme.text.tiny })
	local presetGrid = Kit.frame(self.curves, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 24)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.Parent = presetGrid

	for index, preset in ipairs(COLOR_PRESETS) do
		local button = Kit.button(presetGrid, preset.name, {
			variant = "secondary",
			height = 24,
			size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
			textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
			onClick = function()
				self.store:pushHistory("Apply palette")
				local points = {}
				for stopIndex, hex in ipairs(preset.colors) do
					table.insert(points, { (stopIndex - 1) / (#preset.colors - 1), hex })
				end
				comp.color = points
				self.activeStop = 1
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, "color", points)
				self:renderCurves()
			end,
		})
		button.LayoutOrder = index
		button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7)
		pad.Parent = button

		local dots = Kit.hlist(button, 2, {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		})
		dots.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -5)
		for _, hex in ipairs(preset.colors) do
			Kit.colorSwatch(dots, Util.hex(hex), UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9))
		end
	end
end

function Inspector:renderNumberCurve(comp: any, mode: string)
	local key = mode
	local keypoints = comp[key]
	if type(keypoints) ~= "table" then
		Kit.caption(self.curves, "This component has no " .. mode .. " curve.")
		return
	end

	if #keypoints < 2 then
		table.insert(keypoints, { 1, tonumber(keypoints[1] and keypoints[1][2]) or 0 })
	end

	local peak = 1
	if mode == "size" then
		peak = 0.0001
		for _, kp in ipairs(keypoints) do
			peak = math.max(peak, tonumber(kp[2]) or 0)
		end
		peak *= 1.2
	end

	local header = Kit.hlist(self.curves, 6)
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	Kit.caption(header, string.upper(mode == "size" and "SIZE CURVE" or "OPACITY CURVE"), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	Kit.caption(header, string.format("%d keys", #keypoints), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 18),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local area = Kit.frame(self.curves, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 108),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Theme.corner(area, Theme.radius.xs)
	self.curveArea = area

	-- Grid lines
	for index = 1, 4 do
		Kit.frame(area, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, index / 4, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.line,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
		})
	end

	-- Bars
	for index = 1, 32 do
		local alpha = (index - 1) / 31
		local value = sampleNumber(keypoints, alpha)
		local fraction = math.clamp(if mode == "transparency" then 1 - value else value / peak, 0, 1)
		Kit.frame(area, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1 / 32, 1, math.max(0.004, fraction), 0),
			Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / 32, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = if mode == "transparency" then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		})
	end

	local function valueFromY(y: number): number
		local height = math.max(1, area.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		local fraction = math.clamp(1 - (y - area.AbsolutePosition.Y) / height, 0, 1)
		if mode == "transparency" then
			return Util.round(1 - fraction, 3)
		end
		return Util.round(fraction * peak, 3)
	end

	for index, kp in ipairs(keypoints) do
		local time = tonumber(kp[1]) or 0
		local value = tonumber(kp[2]) or 0
		local yFraction = if mode == "transparency" then 1 - value else math.clamp(value / peak, 0, 1)

		local dot = Kit.frame(area, {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
			Position = UDim2.new(time, -4, 1 - yFraction, -4),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.white,
			ZIndex = 4,
		})
		Theme.corner(dot, Theme.radius.pill)
		Theme.stroke(dot, Theme.color.accent, 2, 0)

		Kit.drag(dot, {
			begin = function()
				self.store:pushHistory("Edit " .. mode .. " curve")
			end,
			move = function(x, y)
				local newTime = math.clamp(Util.round(Kit.fractionAlong(area, x), 3), 0, 1)
				local newValue = valueFromY(y)
				keypoints[index][1] = newTime
				keypoints[index][2] = newValue
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, keypoints)
			end,
			finish = function()
				comp[key] = sorted(keypoints)
				self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, comp[key], true)
				self:renderCurves()
			end,
		})
	end

	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	hit.ZIndex = 2
	hit.Parent = area
	hit.Activated:Connect(function()
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local newTime = math.clamp(Util.round(Kit.fractionAlong(area, mouse.X), 3), 0, 1)
		local newValue = valueFromY(mouse.Y)
		self.store:pushHistory("Add curve key")
		table.insert(keypoints, { newTime, newValue })
		comp[key] = sorted(keypoints)
		self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, comp[key])
		self:renderCurves()
	end)

	local actions = Kit.hlist(self.curves, 6)
	actions.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	Kit.button(actions, "+ Add key", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 22,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			self.store:pushHistory("Add curve key")
			local last = keypoints[#keypoints]
			table.insert(keypoints, { 1, tonumber(last and last[2]) or 0 })
			comp[key] = sorted(keypoints)
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, comp[key])
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})
	Kit.button(actions, "Reset", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 22,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			self.store:pushHistory("Reset curve")
			if mode == "transparency" then
				comp[key] = { { 0, 0 }, { 1, 1 } }
			else
				comp[key] = { { 0, 1 }, { 1, 0 } }
			end
			self.store:setField(self.store.selection, key, comp[key])
			self:renderCurves()
		end,
	})

	Kit.caption(self.curves, "Click the graph to add a key, drag keys to shape the curve.", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- cost tab
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Inspector:renderCost()
	Kit.clear(self.cost)
	local report = Performance.analyze(self.store:working())

	local scoreCard = Kit.frame(self.cost, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
	})
	Theme.corner(scoreCard, Theme.radius.md)

	local gradeColor = Theme.color.good
	if report.grade == "B" then
		gradeColor = Theme.color.accentBright
	elseif report.grade == "C" then
		gradeColor = Theme.color.warn
	elseif report.grade == "D" then
		gradeColor = Theme.color.bad
	end

	Kit.label(scoreCard, report.grade, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6),
		TextColor3 = gradeColor,
		Font = Theme.font.display,
		TextSize = 34,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
	})
	Kit.label(scoreCard, string.format("%d / 100", math.floor(report.score)), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 18),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 10),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.subtitle,
	})
	Kit.caption(scoreCard, string.format("%d concurrent particles", math.floor(report.alive)), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 14),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 28),
	})
	local bar = Kit.progressBar(scoreCard, 6)
	bar.track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 48)
	bar.track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 6)
	bar.Set(report.score / 100, gradeColor)

	local stats = Kit.frame(self.cost, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local statsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	statsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1)
	statsLayout.Parent = stats

	local rows = {
		{ "Components", tostring(report.components) },
		{ "Emitters", tostring(report.emitters) },
		{ "Peak alive", tostring(math.floor(report.alive)) },
		{ "Burst peak", tostring(math.floor(report.burstPeak)) },
		{ "Beams", tostring(report.beams) },
		{ "Trails", tostring(report.trails) },
		{ "Lights", tostring(report.lights) },
		{ "Parts", tostring(report.parts) },
		{ "Unique textures", tostring(report.textures) },
		{ "Remote textures", tostring(report.remoteTextures), report.remoteTextures > 0 and Theme.color.warn or nil },
	}
	for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
		local stat = Kit.statRow(stats, row[1], row[2], row[3])
		stat.Parent = stats
	end

	Kit.sectionTitle(self.cost, string.format("Issues (%d)", #report.issues))

	if #report.issues == 0 then
		Kit.caption(self.cost, "No problems found. This effect is within a healthy budget.", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.good,
		})
	end

	for _, issue in ipairs(report.issues) do
		local card = Kit.frame(self.cost, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
			ClipsDescendants = false,
		})
		Theme.corner(card, Theme.radius.sm)
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 7)
		pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 7)
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9)
		pad.Parent = card

		local color = if issue.severity == "high" then Theme.color.bad elseif issue.severity == "medium" then Theme.color.warn else Theme.color.accentBright
		local stripe = Kit.frame(card, {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
		})
		Theme.corner(stripe, Theme.radius.pill)

		local body = Kit.vlist(card, 2, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0),
		})
		body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

		Kit.label(body, issue.title, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15),
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.text,
			TextSize = Theme.text.small,
			Font = Theme.font.medium,
		})
		Kit.caption(body, issue.detail, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		})
		if issue.fix then
			Kit.caption(body, "\u{2192} " .. issue.fix, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				TextWrapped = true,
				TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
				TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
			})
		end
	end

	local actions = Kit.vlist(self.cost, 6)
	actions.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	actions.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

	Kit.button(actions, "Optimise effect", {
		variant = "primary",
		height = 30,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		onClick = function()
			local optimized, changes = Performance.optimize(self.store:working())
			if not optimized or #changes == 0 then
				self.ctx.toast("Already optimised - nothing to change", "info")
				return
			end
			self.store:pushHistory("Optimise effect")
			self.store.spec = optimized
			self.store.signals:fire("spec")
			self.ctx.toast(string.format("Applied %d optimisation(s)", #changes), "success")
		end,
	})

	Kit.button(actions, "Analyse selection", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 28,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
		tooltip = "Score the instances currently selected in Explorer",
		onClick = function()
			local selection = Util.Selection:Get()
			if #selection == 0 then
				self.ctx.toast("Select an effect in the Explorer first", "warn")
				return
			end
			local total = { alive = 0, components = 0, emitters = 0, lights = 0 }
			for _, instance in ipairs(selection) do
				local result = Performance.analyzeInstances(instance)
				total.alive += result.alive
				total.components += result.components
				total.emitters += result.emitters
				total.lights += result.lights
			end
			self.ctx.toast(string.format(
				"Selection: %d emitters, ~%d particles alive",
				total.emitters,
				math.floor(total.alive)
			), "info")
		end,
	})

	Kit.caption(self.cost, "Estimates use emitter rate x average lifetime plus burst peaks. Test on a low-end device before shipping.", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
end

function Inspector:destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return Inspector

files.name: Kit
files.source:
--[[
	Kit - the widget toolkit every VFX Studio panel is built from.

	Everything here is real interactive UI: buttons with hover animation,
	sliders with drag handling, dropdowns that expand inline, toggles, tabs,
	number fields, tooltips, drag-and-drop, and scroll containers that behave
	inside Roblox Studio's dock widgets.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Kit = {}

Kit.Theme = Theme
Kit.new = Util.new

local overlay: Frame? = nil

--- All tooltips and floating menus render into this full-size overlay.
function Kit.setOverlay(root: Frame?)
	overlay = root
end

local function guard(connection: RBXScriptConnection, object: GuiObject): RBXScriptConnection
	return connection
end

function Kit.disconnectAll(list: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in ipairs(list) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- containers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Kit.frame(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }?): Frame
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true
	if props then
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			(frame :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	frame.Parent = parent
	return frame
end

function Kit.transparent(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }?): Frame
	local frame = Kit.frame(parent, props)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.ClipsDescendants = false
	return frame
end

--- ScrollFrame with a vertical list layout and padding baked in.
function Kit.scroll(parent: Instance, props: { [string]: any }?, padding: number?): (ScrollingFrame, Frame)
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.color.lineBright
	scroll.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.35
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true
	scroll.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never
	if props then
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			(scroll :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	scroll.Parent = parent

	local pad = padding or 10
	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	list.Parent = scroll

	local paddingObject = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	paddingObject.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, pad)
	paddingObject.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, pad + 4)
	paddingObject.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, pad)
	paddingObject.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, pad)
	paddingObject.Parent = scroll

	return scroll, scroll
end

function Kit.hlist(parent: Instance, gap: number?, props: { [string]: any }?): Frame
	local frame = Kit.transparent(parent, props)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 6)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	layout.Parent = frame
	return frame
end

function Kit.vlist(parent: Instance, gap: number?, props: { [string]: any }?): Frame
	local frame = Kit.transparent(parent, props)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 6)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = frame
	return frame
end

function Kit.divider(parent: Instance, opacity: number?): Frame
	local frame = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.line,
		BackgroundTransparency = opacity or 0.35,
	})
	return frame
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- text
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Kit.label(parent: Instance, text: string, props: { [string]: any }?): TextLabel
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Theme.color.text
	label.Font = Theme.font.body
	label.TextSize = Theme.text.body
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.RichText = false
	if props then
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			(label :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

function Kit.caption(parent: Instance, text: string, props: { [string]: any }?): TextLabel
	local label = Kit.label(parent, text, {
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textDim,
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		Font = Theme.font.body,
	})
	if props then
		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			(label :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	return label
end

function Kit.sectionTitle(parent: Instance, text: string, accessory: GuiObject?): Frame
	local row = Kit.hlist(parent, 8)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	local label = Kit.label(row, string.upper(text), {
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
	})
	label.LayoutOrder = 1
	if accessory then
		accessory.LayoutOrder = 2
		accessory.Parent = row
	end
	return row
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hover helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Kit.hoverFX(object: GuiObject, normal: Color3, hover: Color3, duration: number?)
	local active = Util.tween
	object.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if object.BackgroundColor3 == normal then
			active(object, { BackgroundColor3 = hover }, duration or 0.12)
		end
	end)
	object.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if object.BackgroundColor3 == hover then
			active(object, { BackgroundColor3 = normal }, duration or 0.12)
		end
	end)
end

function Kit.tooltip(object: GuiObject, text: string)
	if not text or text == "" then
		return
	end
	local tip: TextLabel? = nil
	object.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if not overlay or tip then
			return
		end
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		label.BorderSizePixel = 0
		label.Text = text
		label.TextColor3 = Theme.color.text
		label.Font = Theme.font.body
		label.TextSize = Theme.text.small
		label.TextWrapped = true
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		label.ZIndex = 200
		Theme.corner(label, Theme.radius.sm)
		Theme.stroke(label, Theme.color.lineBright, 1, 0.2)
		local paddingObject = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		paddingObject.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
		paddingObject.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5)
		paddingObject.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7)
		paddingObject.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7)
		paddingObject.Parent = label
		local constraint = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
		constraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(260, 200)
		constraint.Parent = label
		label.Parent = overlay
		tip = label

		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local rootPosition = overlay.AbsolutePosition
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X - rootPosition.X + 14, mouse.Y - rootPosition.Y + 20)
	end)
	object.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if tip then
			tip:Destroy()
			tip = nil
		end
	end)
end

export type ButtonOptions = {
	variant: string?,
	width: number?,
	height: number?,
	icon: string?,
	tooltip: string?,
	onClick: (() -> ())?,
	size: UDim2?,
	font: Enum.Font?,
	textSize: number?,
}

function Kit.button(parent: Instance, text: string, options: ButtonOptions?): TextButton
	local opts = options or {}
	local variant = opts.variant or "secondary"
	local height = opts.height or 28

	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Font = opts.font or Theme.font.medium
	button.TextSize = opts.textSize or Theme.text.body
	button.TextColor3 = Theme.color.text
	button.Text = text
	button.Size = opts.size or UDim2.new(opts.width and 0 or 1, opts.width or 0, 0, height)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg3
	button.ClipsDescendants = true

	if variant == "primary" then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.accent
		button.TextColor3 = Theme.color.white
		button.Font = Theme.font.bold
	elseif variant == "ghost" then
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		button.TextColor3 = Theme.color.textDim
	elseif variant == "danger" then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.badSoft
		button.TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad
	elseif variant == "accentSoft" then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.accentSoft
		button.TextColor3 = Theme.color.accentBright
	end

	Theme.corner(button, Theme.radius.sm)
	button.Parent = parent

	local normalColor = button.BackgroundColor3
	local hoverColor = if variant == "primary"
		then Theme.color.accentBright
		elseif variant == "ghost"
		then Theme.color.bg3
		elseif variant == "danger"
		then Theme.color.bad
		else Theme.color.bg4

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if variant == "ghost" then
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		end
		Util.tween(button, { BackgroundColor3 = hoverColor }, 0.1)
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		Util.tween(button, { BackgroundColor3 = normalColor }, 0.12)
		if variant == "ghost" then
			Util.tween(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12)
		end
	end)

	if opts.onClick then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(opts.onClick :: () -> ())
			if not ok then
				warn("[VFX Studio] button error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)
	end
	if opts.tooltip then
		Kit.tooltip(button, opts.tooltip)
	end
	return button
end

function Kit.iconButton(parent: Instance, glyph: string, options: ButtonOptions?): TextButton
	local opts = options or {}
	local button = Kit.button(parent, glyph, {
		variant = opts.variant or "ghost",
		size = opts.size or UDim2.fromOffset(opts.width or 26, opts.height or 26),
		onClick = opts.onClick,
		tooltip = opts.tooltip,
		font = Theme.font.bold,
		textSize = opts.textSize or 14,
	})
	button.TextColor3 = if opts.variant == "primary" then Theme.color.white else Theme.color.textDim
	return button
end

--- Numeric field with commit-on-enter and optional drag-free steppers.
function Kit.numberBox(parent: Instance, value: number, options: any?): (Frame, any)
	local opts = options or {}
	local wrapper = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = opts.size or UDim2.fromOffset(64, 26),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	Theme.corner(wrapper, Theme.radius.xs)
	Theme.stroke(wrapper, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.45)

	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
	box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0)
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.Text = tostring(Util.round(value, 3))
	box.TextColor3 = Theme.color.text
	box.Font = Theme.font.mono
	box.TextSize = Theme.text.small
	box.TextXAlignment = if opts.align == "right" then Enum.TextXAlignment.Right else Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	box.Parent = wrapper

	local api = { value = value }

	local function commit(text: string)
		local parsed = tonumber(text)
		if parsed == nil then
			box.Text = tostring(Util.round(api.value, 3))
			return
		end
		if opts.min then
			parsed = math.max(opts.min, parsed)
		end
		if opts.max then
			parsed = math.min(opts.max, parsed)
		end
		api.value = parsed
		box.Text = tostring(Util.round(parsed, 3))
		if opts.onChange then
			local ok, err = pcall(opts.onChange, parsed)
			if not ok then
				warn("[VFX Studio] number field error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end

	box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
		commit(box.Text)
	end)

	function api.Set(newValue: number)
		api.value = newValue
		box.Text = tostring(Util.round(newValue, 3))
	end

	function api.Get(): number
		return api.value
	end

	return wrapper, api
end

export type SliderOptions = {
	min: number?,
	max: number?,
	step: number?,
	value: number?,
	onChange: ((number) -> ())?,
	onStart: (() -> ())?,
	onFinish: (() -> ())?,
	height: number?,
	showValue: boolean?,
	format: ((number) -> string)?,
}

function Kit.slider(parent: Instance, options: SliderOptions): any
	local opts = options
	local min = opts.min or 0
	local max = opts.max or 1
	if max <= min then
		max = min + 1
	end
	local step = opts.step or 0
	local value = math.clamp(opts.value or min, min, max)

	local container = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, opts.height or 22),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})

	local track = Kit.frame(container, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0, 5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -2),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg4,
	})
	Theme.corner(track, Theme.radius.pill)

	local fill = Kit.frame(track, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.accent,
	})
	Theme.corner(fill, Theme.radius.pill)

	local knob = Kit.frame(container, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -5),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.white,
	})
	Theme.corner(knob, Theme.radius.pill)

	local valueLabel = Kit.label(container, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, 0),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textDim,
		Font = Theme.font.mono,
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local api = { value = value }
	local dragging = false

	local function format(v: number): string
		if opts.format then
			return opts.format(v)
		end
		return Util.pretty(v)
	end

	local function applyVisual(newValue: number)
		local alpha = (newValue - min) / (max - min)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, -5, 0.5, -5)
		valueLabel.Text = format(newValue)
	end

	local function quantize(raw: number): number
		local clamped = math.clamp(raw, min, max)
		if step > 0 then
			clamped = min + math.floor((clamped - min) / step + 0.5) * step
		end
		return math.clamp(clamped, min, max)
	end

	local function setFromInput(inputX: number)
		local absolute = track.AbsolutePosition.X
		local width = math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X)
		local alpha = math.clamp((inputX - absolute) / width, 0, 1)
		local newValue = quantize(min + alpha * (max - min))
		if newValue == api.value then
			return
		end
		api.value = newValue
		applyVisual(newValue)
		if opts.onChange then
			local ok, err = pcall(opts.onChange, newValue)
			if not ok then
				warn("[VFX Studio] slider error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end

	local hitArea = Kit.frame(container, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -46, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	hitArea.ZIndex = 3

	hitArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			if opts.onStart then
				opts.onStart()
			end
			setFromInput(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)

	local moveConnection: RBXScriptConnection
	moveConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			setFromInput(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	local endConnection: RBXScriptConnection
	endConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
			if opts.onFinish then
				opts.onFinish()
			end
		end
	end)

	container.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not container.Parent then
			moveConnection:Disconnect()
			endConnection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)

	function api.Set(newValue: number)
		api.value = quantize(newValue)
		applyVisual(api.value)
	end

	function api.Get(): number
		return api.value
	end

	applyVisual(value)
	return api
end

	value: any?,

--- Inline-expanding dropdown (no clipping issues inside scroll frames).
function Kit.dropdown(parent: Instance, options: DropdownOptions): any
	local opts = options
	local choices = opts.options or {}
	local current = opts.value

	local container = Kit.vlist(parent, 2)
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)

	local button = Kit.button(container, "", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = opts.height or 26,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, opts.height or 26),
	})
	button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	button.Text = ""

	local paddingObject = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	paddingObject.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9)
	paddingObject.Parent = button

	local caret = Kit.label(button, "\u{25be}", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		TextSize = 12,
	})

	local list = Kit.frame(container, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
		Visible = false,
	})
	Theme.corner(list, Theme.radius.sm)
	Theme.stroke(list, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.25)

	local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1)
	listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	listLayout.Parent = list

	local listPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	listPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
	listPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
	listPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
	listPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
	listPadding.Parent = list

	local scroller = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroller.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroller.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroller.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	scroller.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroller.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	scroller.Parent = list

	local scrollerLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	scrollerLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1)
	scrollerLayout.Parent = scroller

	local api = { value = current, open = false }

	local function labelFor(value: any): string
		for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
			if choice.value == value then
				return choice.label or tostring(choice.value)
			end
		end
		return opts.placeholder or "Select..."
	end

	local function render()
		for _, child in ipairs(scroller:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local count = 0
		for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
			count += 1
			local selected = choice.value == api.value
			local option = Kit.button(scroller, choice.label or tostring(choice.value), {
				variant = if selected then "accentSoft" else "ghost",
				height = 24,
				size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 24),
				textSize = Theme.text.small,
				onClick = function()
					api.value = choice.value
					button.Text = labelFor(api.value)
					api.open = false
					list.Visible = false
					if opts.onChange then
						opts.onChange(choice.value)
					end
					render()
				end,
			})
			option.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			option.LayoutOrder = count
			local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
			pad.Parent = option
		end
		list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(opts.maxHeight or 160, 32 + count * 25))
		list.Visible = api.open
		scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 25)
	end

	button.Text = labelFor(api.value)
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		api.open = not api.open
		list.Visible = api.open
		if api.open then
			render()
		end
	end)

	function api.Set(value: any)
		api.value = value
		button.Text = labelFor(value)
		if api.open then
			render()
		end
	end

	function api.Get(): any
		return api.value
	end

	render()
	list.Visible = false
	return api
end

function Kit.toggle(parent: Instance, value: boolean, onChange: ((boolean) -> ())?): any
	local track = Kit.frame(parent, {

		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.white,
	})
	Theme.corner(knob, Theme.radius.pill)

	local button = Kit.frame(track, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	button.ZIndex = 2

	local api = { value = value }
	local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
	click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	click.Text = ""
	click.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

	local function apply(newValue: boolean)
		api.value = newValue
		Util.tween(track, { BackgroundColor3 = if newValue then Theme.color.accent else Theme.color.bg4 }, 0.12)
		knob.Position = if newValue then UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) else UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
	end

	click.Activated:Connect(function()
		apply(not api.value)
		if onChange then
			onChange(api.value)
		end
	end)

	function api.Set(newValue: boolean)
		apply(newValue)
	end

	function api.Get(): boolean
		return api.value
	end

	return api
end

export type DragCallbacks = {
	begin: ((number, number) -> ())?,
	move: ((number, number) -> ())?,
	finish: ((number, number) -> ())?,
}

--- Mouse drag tracking for a GuiObject. Coordinates are absolute screen pixels.
function Kit.drag(object: GuiObject, callbacks: DragCallbacks)
	local dragging = false
	local startX, startY = 0, 0

	local beginConnection = object.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		dragging = true
		startX = input.Position.X
		startY = input.Position.Y
		if callbacks.begin then
			callbacks.begin(startX, startY)
		end
	end)

	local moveConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			return
		end
		if callbacks.move then
			callbacks.move(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		end
	end)

	local endConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		dragging = false
		if callbacks.finish then
			callbacks.finish(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		end
	end)

	object.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not object.Parent then
			beginConnection:Disconnect()
			moveConnection:Disconnect()
			endConnection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

--- Converts a mouse X coordinate into 0..1 along a GuiObject.
function Kit.fractionAlong(object: GuiObject, mouseX: number): number
	local width = math.max(1, object.AbsoluteSize.X)
	return math.clamp((mouseX - object.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1)
end
