	local api = { track = track, fill = fill }
	function api.Set(fraction: number, color: Color3?)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1), 1)
		if color then
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
		end
	end
	return api
end

function Kit.chip(parent: Instance, text: string, onClick: (() -> ())?, active: boolean?): TextButton
	local button = Kit.button(parent, text, {
		variant = if active then "accentSoft" else "secondary",
		height = 22,
		width = 0,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = onClick,
	})
	button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9)
	pad.Parent = button
	return button
end

function Kit.clear(container: Instance)
	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") and not child:IsA("UIGridLayout") and not child:IsA("UIGradient") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function Kit.applyListPadding(scroll: ScrollingFrame, amount: number)
	local existing = scroll:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	if existing then
		existing.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, amount)
		existing.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, amount + 4)
		existing.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, amount)
		existing.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, amount)
	end
end

function Kit.colorSwatch(parent: Instance, color: Color3, size: UDim2?): Frame
	local swatch = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = size or UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
	})
	Theme.corner(swatch, Theme.radius.xs)
	Theme.stroke(swatch, Theme.color.black, 1, 0.7)
	return swatch
end

--- Small key/value stat line used by the cost panel and export dialog.
function Kit.statRow(parent: Instance, labelText: string, valueText: string, color: Color3?): Frame
	local row = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Kit.caption(row, labelText, { Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0) })
	Kit.label(row, valueText, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 0),
		TextColor3 = color or Theme.color.text,
		Font = Theme.font.mono,
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})
	return row
end

return Kit

files.name: Library
files.source:
--[[
	Library - the preset browser.

	Categories, instant search, favourites, "my presets" and a paged card grid
	with thumbnails generated from each effect's real texture and palette.
	324 presets are paged 24 at a time so the panel stays instant in Studio.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Assets)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local Library = {}
Library.__index = Library

local PAGE_SIZE = 24

local function primaryTexture(spec: any): (string, Color3, Color3)
	local texture = Assets.defaultUri
	local firstColor = Theme.color.accent
	local lastColor = Theme.color.accentDeep

	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			texture = Assets.resolve(comp.texture)
			local points = comp.color or {}
			if #points > 0 then
				firstColor = Util.hex(points[1][2] or "#ffffff")
				lastColor = Util.hex(points[#points][2] or "#ffffff")
			end
			break
		end
	end
	return texture, firstColor, lastColor
end

local function glyphFor(spec: any): string
	local hasParticle, hasBeam, hasTrail, hasLight = false, false, false, false
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			hasParticle = true
		elseif comp.kind == "beam" then
			hasBeam = true
		elseif comp.kind == "trail" then
			hasTrail = true
		elseif comp.kind == "light" then
			hasLight = true
		end
	end
	if hasBeam then
		return "\u{2726}"
	elseif hasTrail then
		return "\u{2192}"
	elseif hasLight then
		return "\u{2600}"
	elseif hasParticle then
		return "\u{273b}"
	end
	return "\u{25c6}"
end

function Library.new(parent: Instance, ctx: any)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Library)
	self.ctx = ctx
	self.store = ctx.store
	self.query = ""
	self.category = "All"
	self.page = 1
	self.showFavoritesOnly = false
	self.cards = {}

	local root = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.root = root

	-- header ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local header = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	local title = Kit.label(header, "VFX Library", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.title,
	})
	self.countLabel = Kit.label(header, "", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 26),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 14),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	local favButton = Kit.iconButton(header, "\u{2605}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Show favourites only",
		onClick = function()
			self.showFavoritesOnly = not self.showFavoritesOnly
			favButton.TextColor3 = if self.showFavoritesOnly then Theme.color.warn else Theme.color.textDim
			self.page = 1
			self:refresh()
		end,
	})
	favButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 10)
	self.favButton = favButton

	-- search ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local searchHolder = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 48),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	self.search = Kit.searchBox(searchHolder, "Search 324 effects, tags, categories...", function(text)
		self.query = text
		self.page = 1
		self:refresh()
	end)

	-- categories --------------------------------------------------------------
	local categoryScroll = Kit.scroll(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 116),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 84),
	}, 6)
	categoryScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	self.categoryHolder = categoryScroll
	categoryScroll.ClipsDescendants = true

	local categoryList = Kit.frame(categoryScroll, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	})
	self.categoryList = categoryList

	-- results -----------------------------------------------------------------
	local resultHeader = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 22),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 206),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	self.resultHeader = resultHeader
	self.resultLabel = Kit.label(resultHeader, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
	})
	self.sortLabel = Kit.label(resultHeader, "A-Z", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 20),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 1),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local gridScroll, gridContent = Kit.scroll(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -232),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 230),
	}, 8)
	self.gridScroll = gridScroll

	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -7, 0, 96)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 2
	grid.Parent = gridScroll
	self.gridLayout = grid

	-- load more --------------------------------------------------------------
	self.moreButton = Kit.button(root, "Load more effects", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 26,
		size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 26),
		onClick = function()
			self.page += 1
			self:renderGrid(true)
		end,
	})
	self.moreButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -34)
	self.moreButton.Visible = false

	self.signals = {}
	self:bindStore()
	self:refreshCategories()
	self:refresh()
	return self
end

function Library:bindStore()
	local connections = {}
	table.insert(connections, self.store.signals:on("custom", function()
		self:refreshCategories()
		self:refresh()
	end))
	table.insert(connections, self.store.signals:on("favorites", function()
		self:refreshCategories()
		self:refresh()
	end))
	table.insert(connections, self.store.signals:on("pref", function(payload)
		if payload.key == "lastPresetId" then
			self:refreshSelection()
		end
	end))
	self.connections = connections
end

function Library:refreshCategories()
	Kit.clear(self.categoryList)
	local categories = self.store:categories()
	local index = 0
	for _, category in ipairs(categories) do
		index += 1
		local active = self.category == category.name
		local row = Kit.button(self.categoryList, "", {
			variant = if active then "accentSoft" else "ghost",
			height = 24,
			size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
			onClick = function()
				self.category = category.name
				self.page = 1
				self:refreshCategories()
				self:refresh()
			end,
		})
		row.LayoutOrder = index
		row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9)
		pad.Parent = row

		Kit.label(row, category.label or category.name, {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0),
			TextColor3 = if active then Theme.color.text else Theme.color.textDim,
			TextSize = Theme.text.small,
			Font = if active then Theme.font.medium else Theme.font.body,
		})

		local countText = tostring(category.count or 0)
		Kit.label(row, countText, {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 24),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 0),
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint,
			TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			Font = Theme.font.mono,
		})
	end
end

function Library:refresh()
	self:renderGrid(false)
	self:refreshSelection()
end

function Library:refreshSelection()
	for id, card in pairs(self.cards) do
		local active = self.store.prefs.lastPresetId == id
		card.stroke.Color = if active then Theme.color.accent else Theme.color.line
		card.stroke.Thickness = if active then 2 else 1
		card.stroke.Transparency = if active then 0 else 0.45
		card.frame.BackgroundColor3 = if active then Theme.color.bg3 else Theme.color.bg2
	end
end

function Library:renderGrid(append: boolean)
	if not append then
		Kit.clear(self.gridScroll)
		self.cards = {}
	end

	local results = self.store:search(self.query, {
		category = self.category,
		favoritesOnly = self.showFavoritesOnly,
	})

	self.countLabel.Text = string.format("%d effects - %d categories", #self.store.presets.all + #self.store.custom, #self.store.presets.categories)
	self.resultLabel.Text = string.upper(self.category == "All" and "All effects" or self.category) .. "  \u{00b7}  " .. #results .. " results"

	local limit = math.min(#results, self.page * PAGE_SIZE)
	local start = if append then (self.page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1 else 1

	if #results == 0 then
		if not append then
			local empty = Kit.label(self.gridScroll, "No effects match this search.\nTry a tag like \"fire\", \"magic\" or \"impact\".", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 60),
				TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
				TextWrapped = true,
				TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
				TextSize = Theme.text.small,
			})
			empty.LayoutOrder = 1
		end
		self.moreButton.Visible = false
		return
	end

	for index = start, limit do
		local spec = results[index]
		if spec then
			self:createCard(spec, index)
		end
	end

	self.moreButton.Visible = limit < #results
	self.moreButton.Text = string.format("Load %d more", math.min(PAGE_SIZE, #results - limit))
end

function Library:createCard(spec: any, order: number)
	local texture, colorA, colorB = primaryTexture(spec)

	local cardFrame = Kit.frame(self.gridScroll, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 96),
		BackgroundColor3 = if self.store.prefs.lastPresetId == spec.id then Theme.color.bg3 else Theme.color.bg2,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	cardFrame.LayoutOrder = order
	local stroke = Theme.stroke(cardFrame, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.45)
	Theme.corner(cardFrame, Theme.radius.md)

	local thumb = Kit.frame(cardFrame, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	local thumbGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	thumbGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Theme.shade(colorB, 0.55), Theme.color.bg0)
	thumbGradient.Rotation = 115
	thumbGradient.Parent = thumb

	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, -8)
	image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 2)
	image.Image = texture
	image.ImageColor3 = colorA
	image.ImageTransparency = 0.05
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	image.Parent = thumb

	local glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
	glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
	glow.Image = texture
	glow.ImageColor3 = colorA
	glow.ImageTransparency = 0.62
	glow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	glow.Parent = thumb

	local glyph = Kit.label(thumb, glyphFor(spec), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 5),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.white,
		TextTransparency = 0.35,
		TextSize = 11,
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
	})

	local nameLabel = Kit.label(cardFrame, spec.name, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 55),
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		Font = Theme.font.medium,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	})

	local meta = Kit.label(cardFrame, string.format("%s  \u{00b7}  %ds", spec.category, math.max(1, math.floor(spec.duration + 0.5))), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 13),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 70),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	})

	local star = Kit.iconButton(cardFrame, if self.store:isFavorite(spec.id) then "\u{2605}" else "\u{2606}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
		tooltip = "Favourite",
		onClick = function()
			self.store:toggleFavorite(spec.id)
			star.Text = if self.store:isFavorite(spec.id) then "\u{2605}" else "\u{2606}"
			star.TextColor3 = if self.store:isFavorite(spec.id) then Theme.color.warn else Theme.color.textDim
		end,
	})
	star.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 57)
	star.TextColor3 = if self.store:isFavorite(spec.id) then Theme.color.warn else Theme.color.textDim
	star.ZIndex = 3

	local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
	click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	click.Text = ""
	click.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	click.ZIndex = 2
	click.Parent = cardFrame

	local hoverTween = function(target: Vector2?)
		Util.tween(cardFrame, { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg3 }, 0.1)
		Util.tween(image, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.12)
		Util.tween(glow, { ImageTransparency = 0.4 }, 0.12)
	end
	local leaveTween = function()
		Util.tween(cardFrame, { BackgroundColor3 = if self.store.prefs.lastPresetId == spec.id then Theme.color.bg3 else Theme.color.bg2 }, 0.12)
		Util.tween(image, { ImageTransparency = 0.05 }, 0.12)
		Util.tween(glow, { ImageTransparency = 0.62 }, 0.12)
	end

	click.MouseEnter:Connect(hoverTween)
	click.MouseLeave:Connect(leaveTween)

	click.Activated:Connect(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			self.store:applyPreset(spec)
			self.ctx.toast("Loaded " .. spec.name)
			self:refreshSelection()
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[VFX Studio] could not load preset: " .. tostring(err))
			self.ctx.toast("Could not load that preset", "error")
		end
	end)

	Kit.tooltip(click, spec.description or spec.name)

	self.cards[spec.id] = {
		frame = cardFrame,
		stroke = stroke,
	}
end

function Library:setQuery(query: string)
	self.search.Text = query
end

function Library:destroy()
	Kit.disconnectAll(self.connections or {})
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return Library

files.name: Preview
files.source:
--[[
	Preview - the live 3D stage.

	A ViewportFrame with a WorldModel renders the real compiled instances:
	ParticleEmitters, Beams, Trails and PointLights all behave exactly as they
	will in-game. Orbit with the mouse, zoom with the wheel or the buttons,
	play/pause the timeline, and switch the lighting rig for context.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Compiler = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Compiler)
local Player = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Player)
local Performance = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Performance)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Preview = {}
Preview.__index = Preview

local BACKGROUNDS = {
	{
		value = "studio",
		label = "Studio dark",
		ambient = Color3.fromRGB(66, 74, 92),
		light = Color3.fromRGB(150, 168, 200),
		direction = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6),
		background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 15, 22),
		floor = Color3.fromRGB(26, 32, 45),
		floorTransparency = 0.15,
	},
	{
		value = "night",
		label = "Night",
		ambient = Color3.fromRGB(38, 44, 66),
		light = Color3.fromRGB(96, 116, 168),
		direction = Vector3.new(-0.3, -1, 0.4),
		background = Color3.fromRGB(6, 8, 14),
		floor = Color3.fromRGB(16, 20, 32),
		floorTransparency = 0.3,
	},
	{
		value = "day",
		label = "Daylight",
		ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 156, 168),
		light = Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 230),
		direction = Vector3.new(-0.6, -1, -0.3),
		background = Color3.fromRGB(148, 164, 190),
		floor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 126, 136),
		floorTransparency = 0.05,
	},
	{
		value = "void",
		label = "Void",
		ambient = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 30),
		light = Color3.fromRGB(70, 80, 110),
		direction = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
		background = Color3.fromRGB(2, 3, 6),
		floor = Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 16),
		floorTransparency = 0.6,
	},
}

local SPEEDS = {
	{ value = 0.25, label = "0.25x" },
	{ value = 0.5, label = "0.5x" },
	{ value = 1, label = "1.0x" },
	{ value = 1.5, label = "1.5x" },
	{ value = 2, label = "2.0x" },
}

local function radiusOf(spec: any): number
	local radius = 3
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		local offset = comp.offset or comp.offset1 or { 0, 0, 0 }
		local reach = math.sqrt((tonumber(offset[1]) or 0) ^ 2 + (tonumber(offset[2]) or 0) ^ 2 + (tonumber(offset[3]) or 0) ^ 2)
		if comp.kind == "particle" then
			local largest = 0
			for _, kp in ipairs(comp.size or {}) do
				largest = math.max(largest, tonumber(kp[2]) or 0)
			end
			reach += largest * 0.5
		elseif comp.kind == "part" then
			local size = comp.size or { 1, 1, 1 }
			reach += math.sqrt((tonumber(size[1]) or 1) ^ 2 + (tonumber(size[2]) or 1) ^ 2 + (tonumber(size[3]) or 1) ^ 2) * 0.5
		elseif comp.kind == "beam" then
			reach += math.abs(tonumber(comp.width0) or 0) + math.abs(tonumber(comp.curveSize0) or 0)
		end
		radius = math.max(radius, reach)
	end
	return math.clamp(radius, 3, 80)
end

function Preview.new(parent: Instance, ctx: any)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Preview)
	self.ctx = ctx
	self.store = ctx.store
	self.azimuth = 32
	self.elevation = 16
	self.distance = 16
	self.target = Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
	self.autoFrame = true
	self.speed = 1
	self.playStarted = 0
	self.lastProgress = 0
	self.hovering = false
	self.dragging = false
	self.connections = {}

	local root = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	self.root = root

	local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	viewport.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -44)
	viewport.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	viewport.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0
	viewport.BorderSizePixel = 0
	viewport.Ambient = BACKGROUNDS[1].ambient
	viewport.LightColor = BACKGROUNDS[1].light
	viewport.LightDirection = BACKGROUNDS[1].direction
	viewport.Parent = root
	self.viewport = viewport

	local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
	world.Parent = viewport
	self.world = world

	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 50
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
	self.camera = camera

	local floor = Instance.new("Part")
	floor.Name = "PreviewFloor"
	floor.Anchored = true
	floor.CanCollide = false
	floor.CanQuery = false
	floor.CanTouch = false
	floor.CastShadow = false
	floor.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	floor.Color = BACKGROUNDS[1].floor
	floor.Transparency = BACKGROUNDS[1].floorTransparency
	floor.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 44, 44)
	floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -1.15, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
	floor.Parent = world
	self.floor = floor

	local rim = Instance.new("PointLight")
	rim.Brightness = 1.4
	rim.Range = 40
	rim.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 180, 255)
	rim.Shadows = false
	rim.Parent = floor

	-- Overlay: preset identity ------------------------------------------------
	local identity = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 42),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Theme.corner(identity, Theme.radius.sm)
	self.identity = identity

	self.nameLabel = Kit.label(identity, "Loading...", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 18),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.subtitle,
	})
	self.metaLabel = Kit.label(identity, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 22),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	self.costButton = Kit.button(identity, "", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 24,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 24),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		onClick = function()
			ctx.openPanel("Cost")
		end,
		tooltip = "Open the performance report",
	})
	self.costButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 9)

	-- Overlay: orbit hint ------------------------------------------------------
	self.hint = Kit.caption(viewport, "Drag to orbit  \u{00b7}  Scroll to zoom", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -20),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	-- Overlay: compile error ---------------------------------------------------
	self.errorFrame = Kit.frame(viewport, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -30),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.badSoft,
		Visible = false,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Theme.corner(self.errorFrame, Theme.radius.sm)
	self.errorLabel = Kit.label(self.errorFrame, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad,
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
	})

	-- Control bar --------------------------------------------------------------
	local bar = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -44),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.bar = bar
	Theme.stroke(bar, Theme.color.line, 1, 0.5)

	local controls = Kit.hlist(bar, 6, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
	})
	controls.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)

	self.playButton = Kit.button(controls, "\u{25b6}", {
		variant = "primary",
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 28),
		textSize = 13,
		tooltip = "Play / pause  (Space)",
		onClick = function()
			self:togglePlay()
		end,
	})
	self.restartButton = Kit.iconButton(controls, "\u{21bb}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
		tooltip = "Restart timeline  (R)",
		onClick = function()
			self:restart()
		end,
	})

	local speedHolder = Kit.frame(controls, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 28),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local speedDropdown = Kit.dropdown(speedHolder, {
		options = SPEEDS,
		value = 1,
		height = 28,
		maxHeight = 140,
		onChange = function(value)
			self:setSpeed(tonumber(value) or 1)
		end,
	})
	speedDropdown.Set(1)
	speedHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(74, 28)
	speedDropdown.Set(1)

	local loopToggle = Kit.toggle(controls, self.store:getPref("loop", false), function(value)
		self.store:setPref("loop", value)
		if self.player then
			self.player.loop = value
		end
		if value and self.player and not self.player:IsPlaying() then
			self:play()
		end
	end)
	Kit.tooltip(loopToggle :: any, "Loop the effect")
	self.loopToggle = loopToggle

	Kit.label(controls, "Loop", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 28),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	-- Spacer pushes the view controls to the right.
	local spacer = Kit.frame(controls, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 28),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	spacer.LayoutOrder = 50

	local zoomOut = Kit.iconButton(controls, "\u{2212}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Zoom out",
		onClick = function()
			self:zoom(1.18)
		end,
	})
	local zoomIn = Kit.iconButton(controls, "+", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Zoom in",
		onClick = function()
			self:zoom(1 / 1.18)
		end,
	})
	local frameButton = Kit.iconButton(controls, "\u{25a3}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Frame the effect",
		onClick = function()
			self:frameCamera()
		end,
	})

	local bgHolder = Kit.frame(controls, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 28),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local backgroundDropdown = Kit.dropdown(bgHolder, {
		options = (function()
			local list = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(BACKGROUNDS) do
				table.insert(list, { value = entry.value, label = entry.label })
			end
			return list
		end)(),
		value = self.store:getPref("background", "studio"),
		height = 28,
		maxHeight = 130,
		onChange = function(value)
			self:setBackground(tostring(value))
			self.store:setPref("background", tostring(value), { silent = true })
		end,
	})
	self.backgroundDropdown = backgroundDropdown

	-- Interactions -------------------------------------------------------------
	viewport.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		self.hovering = true
		self.hint.Visible = false
	end)
	viewport.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		self.hovering = false
	end)

	local orbitConnection
	viewport.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			self.dragging = true
			self.dragOrigin = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		end
	end)

	table.insert(self.connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and self.dragging and self.dragOrigin then
			local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - self.dragOrigin
			self.dragOrigin = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			self.azimuth -= delta.X * 0.45
			self.elevation = math.clamp(self.elevation + delta.Y * 0.35, -78, 82)
			self:updateCamera()
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and self.hovering then
			self:zoom(1 - input.Position.Z * 0.12)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(self.connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			self.dragging = false
		end
	end))

	-- Store bindings ------------------------------------------------------------
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("spec", function()
		self:rebuild(true)
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("field", function(payload)
		self:onField(payload)
	end))

	self:setBackground(self.store:getPref("background", "studio"))
	self:rebuild(true)
	return self
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- model lifecycle
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Preview:showError(message: string?)
	if message and message ~= "" then
		self.errorLabel.Text = "Preview error\n" .. message
		self.errorFrame.Visible = true
	else
		self.errorFrame.Visible = false
	end
end

function Preview:destroyModel()
	if self.player then
		pcall(function()
			self.player:Destroy()
		end)
		self.player = nil
	end
	if self.model then
		pcall(function()
			self.model:Destroy()
		end)
		self.model = nil
	end
end

function Preview:rebuild(restartPlayback: boolean?)
	local spec = self.store:working()
	local wasPlaying = self.player ~= nil and self.player:IsPlaying()

	if not self.model then
		local ok, result = pcall(Compiler.build, spec, self.world)
		if not ok then
			self:showError(tostring(result))
			self.ctx.toast("Could not build the preview", "error")
			return
		end
		self.model = result
	else
		local ok, err = pcall(Compiler.reconcile, self.model, spec)
		if not ok then
			-- A structural change it cannot reconcile: rebuild from scratch.
			self:destroyModel()
			local retryOk, result = pcall(Compiler.build, spec, self.world)
			if not retryOk then
				self:showError(tostring(result))
				return
			end
			self.model = result
			err = nil
		end
		if err then
			self:showError(tostring(err))
			return
		end
	end

	self:showError(nil)
	self.model.Name = tostring(spec.name or "Effect")

	local playerOk, playerOrError = pcall(Player.new, self.model, spec)
	if not playerOk then
		self:showError(tostring(playerOrError))
		return
	end
	if self.player then
		pcall(function()
			self.player:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	self.player = playerOrError
	self.player.loop = self.store:getPref("loop", false)
	self.player:SetSpeed(self.speed)

	self:updateIdentity()
	self:updateCost()

	local shouldPlay = wasPlaying or (restartPlayback and self.store:getPref("autoPlay", true))
	if shouldPlay then
		self:play()
	else
		self.player:Reset()
		self.lastProgress = 0
		self.playButton.Text = "\u{25b6}"
	end
end

function Preview:onField(payload: any)
	if not self.model then
		self:rebuild(false)
		return
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(Compiler.reconcile, self.model, self.store:working())
	if not ok then
		self:rebuild(false)
		return
	end
	if err then
		self:showError(tostring(err))
	else
		self:showError(nil)
	end
	if self.player then
		if payload and (payload.key == "startTime" or payload.key == "duration") then
			if self.player:IsPlaying() then
				self:play()
			end
		end
	end
	self:updateCost()
end

function Preview:updateIdentity()
	local spec = self.store:working()
	self.nameLabel.Text = tostring(spec.name or "Untitled")
	local tags = table.concat(spec.tags or {}, "  \u{00b7}  ")
	self.metaLabel.Text = string.format(
		"%s  \u{00b7}  %s  \u{00b7}  %d components",
		tostring(spec.category or "Custom"),
		Util.formatDuration(spec.duration or 1),
		#(spec.components or {})
	)
	if tags ~= "" then
		self.metaLabel.Text ..= "  \u{00b7}  " .. tags
	end
end

function Preview:updateCost()
	local report = Performance.analyze(self.store:working())
	local color = Theme.color.good
	if report.grade == "B" then
		color = Theme.color.accentBright
	elseif report.grade == "C" then
		color = Theme.color.warn
	elseif report.grade == "D" then
		color = Theme.color.bad
	end
	self.costButton.Text = string.format("%s  %d%%", report.grade, math.floor(report.score))
	self.costButton.TextColor3 = color
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- playback
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Preview:play()
	if not self.player then
		return
	end
	self.player.loop = self.store:getPref("loop", false)
	self.player:SetSpeed(self.speed)
	self.player:Reset()
	self.player:Play()
	self.playStarted = os.clock()
	self.lastProgress = 0
	self.playButton.Text = "\u{2016}\u{2016}"
end

function Preview:pause()
	if not self.player then
		return
	end
	self.lastProgress = self:progress()
	self.player:Stop()
	self.playButton.Text = "\u{25b6}"
end

function Preview:togglePlay()
	if not self.player then
		return
	end
	if self.player:IsPlaying() then
		self:pause()
	else
		self:play()
	end
end

function Preview:restart()
	self:play()
end

function Preview:setSpeed(speed: number)
	self.speed = math.clamp(speed or 1, 0.1, 4)
	if self.player then
		self.player:SetSpeed(self.speed)
	end
end

function Preview:progress(): number
	if not self.player or not self.player:IsPlaying() then
		return self.lastProgress or 0
	end
	local duration = math.max(0.1, tonumber(self.store:working().duration) or 1)
	local elapsed = (os.clock() - self.playStarted) * self.speed
	local fraction = elapsed / duration
	if self.player.loop then
		fraction = fraction % 1
	elseif fraction > 1 then
		fraction = 1
		self.lastProgress = 1
		self.playButton.Text = "\u{25b6}"
	end
	return math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1)
end

function Preview:isPlaying(): boolean
	return self.player ~= nil and self.player:IsPlaying()
end

--- Keeps the play glyph honest when a one-shot effect ends on its own.
function Preview:syncPlayState()
	if not self.player then
		return
	end
	local playing = self.player:IsPlaying()
	local glyph = if playing then "\u{2016}\u{2016}" else "\u{25b6}"
	if self.playButton.Text ~= glyph then
		self.playButton.Text = glyph
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- camera / environment
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Preview:updateCamera()
	local azimuth = math.rad(self.azimuth)
	local elevation = math.rad(self.elevation)
	local direction = Vector3.new(
		math.cos(elevation) * math.sin(azimuth),
		math.sin(elevation),
		math.cos(elevation) * math.cos(azimuth)
	)
	self.camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(self.target + direction * self.distance, self.target)
end

function Preview:frameCamera()
	local spec = self.store:working()
	local radius = radiusOf(spec)
	self.distance = math.clamp(radius * 2.7, 6, 220)
	self.target = Vector3.new(0, math.min(radius * 0.35, 8), 0)
	self:updateCamera()
end

function Preview:zoom(multiplier: number)
	self.distance = math.clamp(self.distance * multiplier, 3, 300)
	self:updateCamera()
end

function Preview:setBackground(name: string)
	local entry = BACKGROUNDS[1]
	for _, candidate in ipairs(BACKGROUNDS) do
		if candidate.value == name then
			entry = candidate
			break
		end
	end
	self.viewport.BackgroundColor3 = entry.background
	self.viewport.Ambient = entry.ambient
	self.viewport.LightColor = entry.light
	self.viewport.LightDirection = entry.direction
	self.floor.Color = entry.floor
	self.floor.Transparency = entry.floorTransparency
end

function Preview:destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	self:destroyModel()
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return Preview

files.name: Timeline
files.source:
--[[
	Timeline - the emission timeline.

	One row per component with a draggable bar: drag the body to slide it in
	time, drag either edge to change its window. The playhead follows the live
	preview, and clicking a row selects that component everywhere in the UI.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local Timeline = {}
Timeline.__index = Timeline

local ROW_HEIGHT = 24
local NAME_WIDTH = 118

local KIND_COLORS = {
	particle = Theme.color.accent,
	beam = Color3.fromRGB(96, 208, 255),
	trail = Color3.fromRGB(96, 226, 168),
	light = Theme.color.warn,
	part = Color3.fromRGB(184, 150, 255),
	tween = Theme.color.textMuted,
}

local KIND_GLYPHS = {
	particle = "\u{273b}",
	beam = "\u{2726}",
	trail = "\u{2192}",
	light = "\u{2600}",
	part = "\u{25c6}",
	tween = "\u{21bb}",
}

function Timeline.new(parent: Instance, ctx: any)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Timeline)
	self.ctx = ctx
	self.store = ctx.store
	self.preview = ctx.preview
	self.rows = {}
	self.span = 2
	self.progress = 0
	self.connections = {}

	local root = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	})
	self.root = root

	local header = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	local title = Kit.label(header, "Timeline", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 18),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
	})

	local durationLabel = Kit.caption(header, "Duration", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 6),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 18),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	local durationHolder = Kit.frame(header, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 22),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(142, 4),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local durationWrapper, durationField = Kit.numberBox(durationHolder, self.store:working().duration, {
		min = 0.2,
		max = 30,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
		onChange = function(value)
			self.store:setSpecField("duration", value, true)
		end,
	})
	self.durationField = durationField
	durationWrapper.Parent = durationHolder

	Kit.label(header, "s", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(204, 6),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 18),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	local fitButton = Kit.button(header, "Fit", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 20,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 20),
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		tooltip = "Set the duration to the last component end",
		onClick = function()
			local longest = 0.5
			for _, comp in ipairs(self.store:working().components) do
				longest = math.max(longest, (tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0) + (tonumber(comp.duration) or 0))
			end
			self.store:setSpecField("duration", math.max(0.5, Util.round(longest, 2)), true)
			self.durationField.Set(math.max(0.5, Util.round(longest, 2)))
			self:refresh()
		end,
	})
	fitButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(218, 4)

	self.progressLabel = Kit.label(header, "0.00s", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 18),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 6),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		Font = Theme.font.mono,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})
	self.playheadLabel = self.progressLabel

	local divider = Kit.divider(root)
	divider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)

	-- Ruler -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local ruler = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -NAME_WIDTH - 16, 0, 16),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_WIDTH + 8, 32),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	self.ruler = ruler

	-- Rows --------------------------------------------------------------------
	local scroll, content = Kit.scroll(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -84),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 50),
	}, 2)
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	self.scroll = scroll
	self.rowHolder = content

	local rowsFrame = Kit.frame(content, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	})
	local rowsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	rowsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1)
	rowsLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	rowsLayout.Parent = rowsFrame
	self.rowsFrame = rowsFrame

	-- Playhead spans the row area.
	local playhead = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_WIDTH + 8, 50),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.accentBright,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		ZIndex = 5,
	})
	playhead.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -86)
	self.playhead = playhead

	local headDot = Kit.frame(playhead, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, -3),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.accentBright,
		ZIndex = 6,
	})
	Theme.corner(headDot, Theme.radius.pill)

	-- Empty state / add --------------------------------------------------------
	local footer = Kit.hlist(root, 6, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -32),
	})
	footer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)

	self.addButton = Kit.button(footer, "+ Add component", {
		variant = "accentSoft",
		height = 24,
		size = UDim2.new(0, 132, 0, 24),
		textSize = Theme.text.small,
		onClick = function()
			self.store:addComponent("particle")
		end,
	})
	Kit.caption(footer, "Drag bars to retime  \u{00b7}  drag an edge to resize", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 24),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	self.rulerTicks = {}
	self:refresh()
	self:bind()
	return self
end

function Timeline:bind()
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("spec", function()
		self:refresh()
		if self.durationField then
			self.durationField.Set(self.store:working().duration)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("selection", function(index)
		self:highlight(index)
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.store.signals:on("field", function(payload)
		-- Never rebuild the rows while the developer is dragging one of them.
		if self.dragging then
			return
		end
		if payload and (payload.key == "startTime" or payload.key == "duration") then
			self:refresh()
		end
	end))
end

function Timeline:computeSpan(): number
	local spec = self.store:working()
	local span = math.max(0.5, tonumber(spec.duration) or 1)
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		span = math.max(span, (tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0) + (tonumber(comp.duration) or 0))
	end
	-- A little headroom so the last bar is not glued to the edge.
	return span * 1.04
end

function Timeline:refresh()
	Kit.clear(self.rowsFrame)
	self.rows = {}
	self.span = self:computeSpan()
	self:renderRuler()

	local spec = self.store:working()
	local index = 0
	for _, comp in ipairs(spec.components or {}) do
		index += 1
		self:createRow(comp, index)
	end

	self:highlight(self.store.selection)

	if #spec.components == 0 then
		local empty = Kit.label(self.rowsFrame, "No components. Add one below, or load a preset.", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 4),
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
			TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		})
		empty.LayoutOrder = -1
	end
end

function Timeline:renderRuler()
	for _, tick in ipairs(self.rulerTicks) do
		tick:Destroy()
	end
	self.rulerTicks = {}

	local span = self.span
	local steps = 6
	for index = 0, steps do
		local fraction = index / steps
		local x = math.floor(fraction * 1000) / 10
		local label = Kit.label(self.ruler, string.format("%.2fs", span * fraction), {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 14),
			Position = UDim2.new(fraction, -21, 0, 0),
			TextColor3 = Theme.color.textFaint,
			TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
			Font = Theme.font.mono,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		})
		table.insert(self.rulerTicks, label)
	end
end

function Timeline:createRow(comp: any, index: number)
	local row = Kit.frame(self.rowsFrame, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = if index % 2 == 0 then Theme.color.bg2 else Theme.color.bg1,
		BackgroundTransparency = if index % 2 == 0 then 0.35 else 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	row.LayoutOrder = index

	local color = KIND_COLORS[comp.kind] or Theme.color.textDim

	local dot = Kit.frame(row, {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
	})
	Theme.corner(dot, Theme.radius.pill)

	local name = Kit.label(row, string.format("%s %s", KIND_GLYPHS[comp.kind] or "\u{25c6}", tostring(comp.name)), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_WIDTH - 16, ROW_HEIGHT),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textDim,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	})
	Kit.tooltip(name, tostring(comp.name))

	local track = Kit.frame(row, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -NAME_WIDTH - 16, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_WIDTH, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})

	local lane = Kit.frame(track, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -4),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg3,
	})
	lane.ZIndex = 1
	Theme.corner(lane, Theme.radius.pill)

	local startTime = tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0
	local duration = tonumber(comp.duration) or 0
	local bar = Kit.frame(track, {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(0.006, duration / self.span), 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(startTime / self.span, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})
	Theme.corner(bar, Theme.radius.sm)
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(math.max(0.006, duration / self.span), 0, 0, 16)
	bar.Position = UDim2.new(startTime / self.span, 0, 0.5, -8)

	local barLabel = Kit.label(bar, if duration > 0.08 then string.format("%.2fs", duration) else "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.white,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		Font = Theme.font.mono,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	})

	local leftHandle = Kit.frame(bar, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.white,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
		ZIndex = 3,
	})
	local rightHandle = Kit.frame(bar, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.white,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
		ZIndex = 3,
	})

	local function trackWidth(): number
		return math.max(24, track.AbsoluteSize.X)
	end

	local dragState: any = nil

	local function beginDrag(mode: string, startX: number)
		self.store:pushHistory("Adjust timing")
		self.dragging = true
		dragState = {
			mode = mode,
			startX = startX,
			startTime = tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0,
			startDuration = tonumber(comp.duration) or 0,
		}
		self.store:select(index)
	end

	local function moveDrag(mouseX: number)
		if not dragState then
			return
		end
		local delta = (mouseX - dragState.startX) / trackWidth() * self.span
		if dragState.mode == "move" then
			local newStart = math.max(0, Util.round(dragState.startTime + delta, 2))
			comp.startTime = newStart
			self.store:setField(index, "startTime", newStart)
		elseif dragState.mode == "left" then
			local newStart = math.clamp(Util.round(dragState.startTime + delta, 2), 0, dragState.startTime + dragState.startDuration - 0.05)
			local newDuration = math.max(0.05, Util.round(dragState.startDuration - (newStart - dragState.startTime), 2))
			comp.startTime = newStart
			comp.duration = newDuration
			self.store:setField(index, "startTime", newStart)
			self.store:setField(index, "duration", newDuration)
		elseif dragState.mode == "right" then
			local newDuration = math.max(0.05, Util.round(dragState.startDuration + delta, 2))
			comp.duration = newDuration
			self.store:setField(index, "duration", newDuration)
		end
		self:updateBar(index, bar, barLabel)
	end

	local function finishDrag()
		dragState = nil
		self.dragging = false
		self:refresh()
	end

	Kit.drag(bar, {
		begin = function(x)
			beginDrag("move", x)
		end,
		move = function(x)
			moveDrag(x)
		end,
		finish = finishDrag,
	})
	Kit.drag(leftHandle, {
		begin = function(x)
			beginDrag("left", x)
		end,
		move = function(x)
			moveDrag(x)
		end,
		finish = finishDrag,
	})
	Kit.drag(rightHandle, {
		begin = function(x)
			beginDrag("right", x)
		end,
		move = function(x)
			moveDrag(x)
		end,
		finish = finishDrag,
	})

	local selectClick = Instance.new("TextButton")
	selectClick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	selectClick.Text = ""
	selectClick.Size = UDim2.new(1, -NAME_WIDTH, 1, 0)
	selectClick.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(NAME_WIDTH, 0)
	selectClick.ZIndex = 1
	selectClick.Parent = row
	selectClick.Activated:Connect(function()
		self.store:select(index)
	end)

	self.rows[index] = {
		frame = row,
		bar = bar,
		label = barLabel,
		comp = comp,
	}
end

function Timeline:updateBar(index: number, bar: Frame, label: TextLabel)
	local comp = self.rows[index] and self.rows[index].comp
	if not comp then
		return
	end
	local startTime = tonumber(comp.startTime) or 0
	local duration = tonumber(comp.duration) or 0
	bar.Position = UDim2.new(startTime / self.span, 0, 0.5, -8)
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(math.max(0.006, duration / self.span), 0, 0, 16)
	label.Text = if duration > 0.08 then string.format("%.2fs", duration) else ""
end

function Timeline:highlight(index: number)
	for rowIndex, row in pairs(self.rows) do
		if rowIndex == index then
			row.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg3
			row.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		else
			row.frame.BackgroundColor3 = if rowIndex % 2 == 0 then Theme.color.bg2 else Theme.color.bg1
			row.frame.BackgroundTransparency = if rowIndex % 2 == 0 then 0.35 else 1
		end
	end
end

function Timeline:setProgress(fraction: number, seconds: number)
	self.progress = math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1)
	local rulerWidth = self.ruler.AbsoluteSize.X
	self.playhead.Position = UDim2.new(
		0,
		NAME_WIDTH + 8 + math.floor(self.progress * rulerWidth),
		0,
		50
	)
	if self.playheadLabel then
		self.playheadLabel.Text = string.format("%.2fs", seconds or 0)
	end
end

function Timeline:destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return Timeline

files.name: UpdateDialog
files.source:
--[[
	UpdateDialog - release-synced updates, inside Studio.

	Shows the installed version, checks GitHub, applies a downloaded build to the
	running plugin without a restart, and offers the save-to-disk step that makes
	the update survive a Studio restart.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Util)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Theme)
local Version = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Version)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.Kit)

local UpdateDialog = {}
UpdateDialog.__index = UpdateDialog

function UpdateDialog.new(parent: Instance, ctx: any)
	local self = setmetatable({}, UpdateDialog)
	self.ctx = ctx
	self.updater = ctx.updater
	self.connections = {}

	local root = Kit.frame(parent, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg1,
	})
	self.root = root

	local header = Kit.frame(root, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
	})
	Kit.label(header, "Updates", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 10),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 20),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.title,
	})
	Kit.caption(header, "Synced with GitHub releases for " .. Version.REPO, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 30),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 14),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	local close = Kit.iconButton(header, "\u{00d7}", {
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		tooltip = "Close",
		onClick = function()
			ctx.closeModal()
		end,
	})
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 12)

	local body = Kit.vlist(root, 10, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 58),
	})
	body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

	-- Version card -------------------------------------------------------------
	local card = Kit.frame(body, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 72),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg2,
	})
	Theme.corner(card, Theme.radius.md)

	self.installedLabel = Kit.label(card, "Installed  " .. Version.display(Version.VERSION), {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16),
		TextSize = Theme.text.small,
		Font = Theme.font.medium,
	})
	self.latestLabel = Kit.caption(card, "Latest  -", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 26),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	self.stateLabel = Kit.label(card, "Ready.", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 44),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16),
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextWrapped = true,
	})

	-- Actions ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local actions = Kit.hlist(body, 8, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
	})
	actions.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	actions.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)

	self.checkButton = Kit.button(actions, "Check for updates", {
		variant = "secondary",
		height = 30,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(136, 30),
		onClick = function()
			self:check()
		end,
	})
	self.updateButton = Kit.button(actions, "Update now", {
		variant = "primary",
		height = 30,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 30),
		onClick = function()
			self:update()
		end,
	})
	self.saveButton = Kit.button(actions, "Save plugin file", {
		variant = "ghost",
		height = 30,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 30),
		tooltip = "Save the updated plugin model so it survives a Studio restart",
		onClick = function()
			self:save()
		end,
	})

	-- Auto-check ---------------------------------------------------------------
	local autoRow = Kit.hlist(body, 8, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
	})
	autoRow.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	autoRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
	local autoToggle = Kit.toggle(autoRow, self.updater:isAutoCheckEnabled(), function(value)
		self.updater:setAutoCheck(value)
		self:refresh()
	end)
	autoToggle.Parent = autoRow
	Kit.caption(autoRow, "Check for updates when Studio opens", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 22),
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})

	-- Notes --------------------------------------------------------------------
	Kit.caption(body, "RELEASE NOTES", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
	})

	local notesCard = Kit.frame(body, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 132),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.color.bg0,
	})
	Theme.corner(notesCard, Theme.radius.sm)
	self.notesBox = Kit.textBox(notesCard, "", {
		size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
		font = Theme.font.mono,
		textSize = 10,
	})
	self.notesBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
	self.notesBox.TextWrapped = true
	self.notesBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	self.notesBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	self.notesBox.Text = "Press \"Check for updates\" to fetch the latest build notes."

	-- Release link -------------------------------------------------------------
	Kit.caption(body, "RELEASES", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
		Font = Theme.font.bold,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
	})
	local linkBox = Kit.textBox(body, Version.RELEASES_URL, {
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		font = Theme.font.mono,
		textSize = Theme.text.tiny,
	})
	linkBox.TextEditable = true

	Kit.caption(body, "After updating, press \"Save plugin file\", choose VFXStudio.rbxmx in your Plugins folder and overwrite it. Studio has no API that writes plugin files directly, so this is the one manual step.", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted,
	})

	-- Footer -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local footer = Kit.hlist(root, 8, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 32),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -44),
	})
	footer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 32)

	self.closeButton = Kit.button(footer, "Done", {
		variant = "accentSoft",
		height = 32,
		size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 32),
		onClick = function()
			ctx.closeModal()
		end,
	})
	self.hintLabel = Kit.caption(footer, "", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 32),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextSize = Theme.text.tiny,
		TextWrapped = true,
	})

	table.insert(self.connections, self.updater.signals:on("state", function()
		self:refresh()
	end))

	self:refresh()
	return self
end

function UpdateDialog:refresh()
	if not self.root.Parent then
		return
	end
	local updater = self.updater
	local installed = Version.display(updater:installedVersion())
	self.installedLabel.Text = "Installed  " .. installed

	local info = updater.info
	if info then
		local newer = updater:hasUpdate()
		self.latestLabel.Text = string.format(
			"Latest  %s  (%s)",
			Version.display(info.version),
			if info.source == "release" then "GitHub release" else "main branch"
		)
		self.latestLabel.TextColor3 = if newer then Theme.color.accentBright else Theme.color.textMuted
		self.notesBox.Text = if info.notes ~= "" then info.notes else "No release notes."
		self.updateButton.Text = if newer then "Update to " .. Version.display(info.version) else "Up to date"
		self.updateButton.TextColor3 = if newer then Theme.color.white else Theme.color.textDim
		self.updateButton.BackgroundColor3 = if newer then Theme.color.accent else Theme.color.bg3
	else
		self.latestLabel.Text = "Latest  -"
		self.updateButton.Text = "Update now"
	end

	local busy = updater.state == "checking" or updater.state == "downloading" or updater.state == "applying"
	self.checkButton.Text = if updater.state == "checking" then "Checking..." else "Check for updates"
	self.checkButton.TextColor3 = if busy then Theme.color.textFaint else Theme.color.text

	local message = updater.stateMessage
	if updater.state == "error" then
		self.stateLabel.Text = "Error: " .. tostring(updater.lastError)
		self.stateLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.color.bad
		self.notesBox.Text = tostring(updater.lastError)
	elseif updater.state == "ready" then
		self.stateLabel.Text = "Updated in this Studio session. Save the plugin file to keep it."
		self.stateLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.color.good
	elseif busy then
		self.stateLabel.Text = message or "Working..."
		self.stateLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.color.accentBright
	else
		self.stateLabel.Text = if message then message else "Ready."
		self.stateLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.color.textMuted
	end

	self.hintLabel.Text = if updater.appliedManifest
		then "Running v" .. Version.clean(updater.appliedVersion or Version.VERSION) .. " from this update."
		else ""
end

function UpdateDialog:check()
	if self.updater.state == "checking" or self.updater.state == "downloading" then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, info = pcall(function()
			return self.updater:check()
		end)
		if not ok then
			self.ctx.toast("Update check failed", "error")
			self:refresh()
			return
		end
		self:refresh()
		if info then
			if self.updater:hasUpdate() then
				self.ctx.toast(string.format("v%s is available", Version.clean(info.version)), "info")
			else
				self.ctx.toast("You are on the latest version", "success")
			end
		else
			self.ctx.toast(self.updater.lastError or "Could not check for updates", "warn")
		end
	end)
end

function UpdateDialog:update()
	if self.updater.state == "downloading" or self.updater.state == "applying" then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local manifest, err = self.updater:downloadManifest()
		if not manifest then
			self.ctx.toast(err or "Download failed", "error")
			self:refresh()
			return
		end
		local ok, applyError = self.updater:apply(manifest)
		if not ok then
			self.ctx.toast(applyError or "Update failed", "error")
			self:refresh()
			return
		end
		self.ctx.toast("Updated to v" .. Version.clean(manifest.version) .. " in this session", "success")
		self:refresh()
		-- Rebuild the editor against the new modules.
		if self.ctx.onUpdated then
			task.defer(function()
				local callback = self.ctx.onUpdated
				if callback then
					callback()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

function UpdateDialog:save()
	local ok, err = self.updater:saveToDisk()
	if not ok then
		self.ctx.toast(err or "Could not open the save dialog", "error")
		return
	end
	self.ctx.toast("Choose your Plugins folder and overwrite VFXStudio.rbxmx", "info")
	self.hintLabel.Text = "Save dialog opened. Overwrite VFXStudio.rbxmx, then restart Studio."
end

function UpdateDialog:destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:disconnect()
		end)
	end
	self.root:Destroy()
end

return UpdateDialog
